================================================================================
FILE: ./build.bat
================================================================================

@echo off
setlocal

if not exist "build" mkdir "build"
if not exist "disk\EFI\BOOT" mkdir "disk\EFI\BOOT"
if not exist "disk\USER" mkdir "disk\USER"

set UFLAGS=-O2 -ffast-math -ffreestanding -fno-stack-protector -mno-stack-arg-probe -mno-red-zone -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -U_WIN32 -U_WIN64 -Iuser -Ikernel\include -Ikernel\include\libc -Iuser\lua
set USRCS=user\init.c user\ulibc\stdio.c user\ulibc\time.c user\ulibc\memory.c kernel\libc\string.c kernel\libc\stdlib.c kernel\libc\math.c kernel\libc\setjmp.c kernel\libc\locale_signal.c user\lua_runner.c

echo === [1/4] Compiling Ring 3 User-Mode INIT.BIN ===
gcc %UFLAGS% %USRCS% user\lua\*.c -nostdlib "-Wl,--disable-dynamicbase,--image-base,0x0,-T,user\user.ld" -o build\init.elf
if errorlevel 1 goto :error
objcopy -O binary build\init.elf disk\USER\INIT.BIN
if errorlevel 1 goto :error

set KSRCS=kernel\arch\gdt.c kernel\arch\paging.c kernel\arch\syscall.c kernel\drivers\ahci.c kernel\drivers\ata.c kernel\drivers\blockdev.c kernel\drivers\nvme.c kernel\drivers\pci.c kernel\drivers\usb_msc.c kernel\fs\fat32.c kernel\libc\memory.c kernel\libc\setjmp.c kernel\libc\string.c kernel\libc\time.c kernel\console.c kernel\desktop.c kernel\gfx.c kernel\kernel.c kernel\sched.c kernel\panic.c

echo === [2/4] Compiling Thin Ring 0 Kernel (UEFI) ===
gcc -O3 -ffast-math -ffreestanding -fno-stack-protector -mno-stack-arg-probe -fshort-wchar -mno-red-zone -nostdlib "-Wl,--subsystem,10" -e efi_main -Ikernel\include -Ikernel\include\libc boot\uefi\main.c %KSRCS% -o disk\EFI\BOOT\BOOTX64.EFI
if errorlevel 1 goto :error

echo === [3/4] Compiling Thin Ring 0 Kernel (BIOS) ===
where nasm >nul 2>nul
if %errorlevel%==0 (
    nasm -f bin boot\bios\boot.asm -o build\bios_boot.bin
    if errorlevel 1 goto :error
    nasm -f win64 boot\bios\entry64.asm -o build\entry64.o
    if errorlevel 1 goto :error

    for %%f in (boot\bios\bios_hal.c %KSRCS%) do (
        gcc -O3 -ffast-math -ffreestanding -fno-stack-protector -mno-stack-arg-probe -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -fno-unwind-tables -mno-red-zone -mno-avx -fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns -Ikernel\include -Ikernel\include\libc -c %%f -o build\%%~nf.o
        if errorlevel 1 goto :error
    )

    ld --disable-dynamicbase --image-base 0x10000 -T boot\bios\bios.ld -o build\bios_kernel.elf build\entry64.o build\bios_hal.o build\gdt.o build\paging.o build\syscall.o build\ahci.o build\ata.o build\blockdev.o build\nvme.o build\pci.o build\usb_msc.o build\fat32.o build\memory.o build\setjmp.o build\string.o build\time.o build\console.o build\desktop.o build\gfx.o build\kernel.o build\sched.o build\panic.o
    if errorlevel 1 goto :error

    python scripts\build_flat.py
    if errorlevel 1 goto :error

    copy /b build\bios_boot.bin + build\bios_kernel.bin build\sonionos_bios.img >nul
    fsutil file seteof build\sonionos_bios.img 2097152 >nul
    echo [OK] Built Ring 3 User Space + Thin Ring 0 Kernels!
) else (
    echo [SKIP] NASM not found!
)

echo === [4/4] Launching QEMU ===
set QEMU="C:\Program Files\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe"
set BIOS_FD="C:\Program Files\qemu\share\edk2-x86_64-code.fd"

if /i "%1"=="iso" (
    python scripts\make_iso.py
    if errorlevel 1 goto :error
    echo [READY] Share build\sonionOS.iso with your friend!
    goto :eof
)
if /i "%1"=="bios" (
    %QEMU% -cpu max -m 256M -drive file=build\sonionos_bios.img,format=raw,if=ide,index=0 -drive file=fat:rw:disk,format=raw,if=ide,index=1 -display sdl,grab-mod=lctrl-lalt -serial none
) else (
    %QEMU% -cpu max -m 256M -drive if=pflash,format=raw,readonly=on,file=%BIOS_FD% -drive file=fat:rw:disk,format=raw -display sdl,grab-mod=lctrl-lalt -serial none
)
goto :eof

:error
echo [ERROR] Build failed!
pause
exit /b 1
























================================================================================
FILE: ./build.sh
================================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

CC="${CC:-x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc}"
LD="${LD:-x86_64-w64-mingw32-ld}"
OBJCOPY="${OBJCOPY:-x86_64-w64-mingw32-objcopy}"

if ! command -v "$CC" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    CC="gcc"
    LD="ld"
    OBJCOPY="objcopy"
fi

for tool in "$CC" "$LD" "$OBJCOPY" python3; do
    if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[ERROR] $tool not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
done

QEMU="${QEMU:-qemu-system-x86_64}"
BIOS_FD="${BIOS_FD:-}"

if [ -z "$BIOS_FD" ]; then
    for candidate in \
        /usr/share/OVMF/OVMF_CODE.fd \
        /usr/share/edk2/ovmf/OVMF_CODE.fd \
        /usr/share/qemu/edk2-x86_64-code.fd
    do
        if [ -f "$candidate" ]; then
            BIOS_FD="$candidate"
            break
        fi
    done
fi

mkdir -p build disk/EFI/BOOT disk/USER

UFLAGS=(
    -O2
    -ffast-math
    -ffreestanding
    -fno-stack-protector
    -mno-stack-arg-probe
    -mno-red-zone
    -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables
    -U_WIN32
    -U_WIN64
    -Iuser
    -Ikernel/include
    -Ikernel/include/libc
    -Iuser/lua
)

USRCS=(
    user/init.c
    user/ulibc/stdio.c
    user/ulibc/time.c
    user/ulibc/memory.c
    kernel/libc/string.c
    kernel/libc/stdlib.c
    kernel/libc/math.c
    kernel/libc/setjmp.c
    kernel/libc/locale_signal.c
    user/lua_runner.c
)

echo "=== [1/4] Compiling Ring 3 User-Mode INIT.BIN ==="

"$CC" "${UFLAGS[@]}" \
    "${USRCS[@]}" \
    user/lua/*.c \
    -nostdlib \
    -Wl,--disable-dynamicbase,--image-base,0x0,-T,user/user.ld \
    -o build/init.elf

"$OBJCOPY" -O binary build/init.elf disk/USER/INIT.BIN

KSRCS=(
    kernel/kernel.c
    kernel/sched.c
    kernel/gfx.c
    kernel/desktop.c
    kernel/panic.c
    kernel/console.c
    kernel/arch/gdt.c
    kernel/arch/paging.c
    kernel/arch/syscall.c
    kernel/libc/string.c
    kernel/libc/memory.c
    kernel/libc/setjmp.c
    kernel/libc/time.c
    kernel/drivers/blockdev.c
    kernel/drivers/pci.c
    kernel/drivers/nvme.c
    kernel/drivers/ahci.c
    kernel/drivers/ata.c
    kernel/drivers/usb_msc.c
    kernel/fs/fat32.c
)

echo "=== [2/4] Compiling Thin Ring 0 Kernel (UEFI) ==="

"$CC" -O3 -ffast-math \
    -ffreestanding \
    -fno-stack-protector \
    -mno-stack-arg-probe \
    -fshort-wchar \
    -mno-red-zone \
    -nostdlib \
    -Wl,--subsystem,10 \
    -e efi_main \
    -Ikernel/include \
    -Ikernel/include/libc \
    boot/uefi/main.c \
    "${KSRCS[@]}" \
    -o disk/EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI

echo "=== [3/4] Compiling Thin Ring 0 Kernel (BIOS) ==="

if command -v nasm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nasm -f bin boot/bios/boot.asm -o build/bios_boot.bin
    nasm -f win64 boot/bios/entry64.asm -o build/entry64.o

    for src in boot/bios/bios_hal.c "${KSRCS[@]}"; do
        name=$(basename "$src" .c)
        "$CC" -O3 -ffast-math \
            -ffreestanding \
            -fno-stack-protector \
            -mno-stack-arg-probe \
            -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables \
            -fno-unwind-tables \
            -mno-red-zone \
            -mno-avx \
            -fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns \
            -Ikernel/include \
            -Ikernel/include/libc \
            -c "$src" \
            -o "build/$name.o"
    done

    "$LD" --disable-dynamicbase --image-base 0x10000 \
        -T boot/bios/bios.ld \
        -o build/bios_kernel.elf \
        build/entry64.o \
        build/bios_hal.o \
        build/kernel.o \
        build/sched.o \
        build/gfx.o \
        build/desktop.o \
        build/panic.o \
        build/console.o \
        build/gdt.o \
        build/paging.o \
        build/syscall.o \
        build/string.o \
        build/memory.o \
        build/setjmp.o \
        build/time.o \
        build/blockdev.o \
        build/pci.o \
        build/nvme.o \
        build/ahci.o \
        build/ata.o \
        build/usb_msc.o \
        build/fat32.o

    python3 scripts/build_flat.py
    cat build/bios_boot.bin build/bios_kernel.bin > build/sonionos_bios.img
    truncate -s 2097152 build/sonionos_bios.img
    echo "[OK] Built Ring 3 User Space + Thin Ring 0 Kernels!"
else
    echo "[SKIP] NASM not found!"
fi

echo "=== [4/4] Launching QEMU ==="

if [ "${1:-}" = "iso" ]; then
    python3 scripts/make_iso.py
    echo "[READY] Built build/sonionOS.iso!"
elif [ "${1:-}" = "bios" ]; then
    "$QEMU" \
        -cpu max \
        -m 256M \
        -drive file=build/sonionos_bios.img,format=raw,if=ide,index=0 \
        -drive file=fat:rw:disk,format=raw,if=ide,index=1 \
        -display sdl,grab-mod=lctrl-lalt \
        -serial none
else
    if [ -z "$BIOS_FD" ]; then
        echo "[ERROR] OVMF firmware not found! Set BIOS_FD to your OVMF_CODE.fd path."
        exit 1
    fi
    "$QEMU" \
        -cpu max \
        -m 256M \
        -drive if=pflash,format=raw,readonly=on,file="$BIOS_FD" \
        -drive file=fat:rw:disk,format=raw \
        -display sdl,grab-mod=lctrl-lalt \
        -serial none
fi

========== FILE: ./boot/bios/bios.ld ==========

ENTRY(_start32)

SECTIONS {
    . = 0x10000;

    .text ALIGN(0x1000) : {
        *(.text.trampoline)
        *(.text.entry)
        *(.text .text.*)
    }

    .rdata ALIGN(0x1000) : {
        *(.rdata .rdata.*)
        *(.rodata .rodata.*)
    }

    .data ALIGN(0x1000) : {
        *(.data .data.*)
    }

    . = 0x200000;
    .bss : {
        *(COMMON)
        *(.bss .bss.*)
    }

    /DISCARD/ : {
        *(.pdata)
        *(.xdata)
        *(.reloc)
        *(.eh_frame)
        *(.comment)
    }
}


========== FILE: ./boot/bios/bios_hal.c ==========

#include <stdint.h>
#include "bootinfo.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t attributes;
    uint8_t  window_a, window_b;
    uint16_t granularity, window_size, segment_a, segment_b;
    uint32_t win_func_ptr;
    uint16_t pitch;
    uint16_t width;
    uint16_t height;
    uint8_t  w_char, y_char, planes, bpp, banks, memory_model, bank_size, image_pages, reserved0;
    uint8_t  red_mask, red_pos, green_mask, green_pos, blue_mask, blue_pos, rsvd_mask, rsvd_pos, direct_color;
    uint32_t framebuffer;
} VesaModeInfo;

static inline uint8_t inb(uint16_t port) {
    uint8_t ret;
    __asm__ volatile ("inb %1, %0" : "=a"(ret) : "Nd"(port));
    return ret;
}

static inline void outb(uint16_t port, uint8_t val) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"(val), "Nd"(port));
}

static inline uint64_t rdtsc(void) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdtsc" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi));
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static const char scancode_ascii[128] = {
    0,  27, '1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9','0','-','=','\b',
    '\t','q','w','e','r','t','y','u','i','o','p',0x5B,0x5D,'\r',
    0,  'a','s','d','f','g','h','j','k','l',';','\'',0x60, 0,
    '\\','z','x','c','v','b','n','m',',','.','/', 0, '*', 0, ' '
};

static uint64_t tsc_ticks_per_ms = 2000000;

static void calibrate_tsc(void) {
    uint8_t gate = inb(0x61) & 0xFC;
    outb(0x61, gate);
    outb(0x43, 0xB0);
    outb(0x42, 0x9C);
    outb(0x42, 0x2E);
    outb(0x61, gate | 1);

    uint64_t t0 = rdtsc();
    uint32_t guard = 0;
    while (!(inb(0x61) & 0x20) && ++guard < 10000000);
    uint64_t t1 = rdtsc();

    if (guard < 10000000 && t1 > t0) tsc_ticks_per_ms = (t1 - t0) / 10;
}

void bios_poll_input(InputState *state) {
    state->key_char = 0;
    state->scan_code = 0;
    state->left_click = 0;
    while (inb(0x64) & 1) {
        uint8_t status = inb(0x64);
        uint8_t data   = inb(0x60);
        if (!(status & 0x20) && !(data & 0x80)) {
            if (data == 0x01) state->scan_code = 0x17;
            else if (data < 128) state->key_char = scancode_ascii[data];
        }
    }
    state->mouse_x = 400;
    state->mouse_y = 300;
}

void bios_sleep_ms(uint32_t ms) {
    uint64_t target = rdtsc() + (uint64_t)ms * tsc_ticks_per_ms;
    while (rdtsc() < target) {
        __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    }
}

void bios_reboot(void) {
    while (inb(0x64) & 0x02);
    outb(0x64, 0xFE);
    while (1) __asm__("hlt");
}

void bios_shutdown(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outw %0, %1" : : "a"((uint16_t)0x2000), "Nd"((uint16_t)0x604));
    while (1) __asm__("hlt");
}

__attribute__((section(".text.entry")))
void bios_entry(VesaModeInfo *vesa) {
    calibrate_tsc();

    BootInfo info;
    info.framebuffer = (uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)vesa->framebuffer;
    info.width       = vesa->width  ? vesa->width  : 800;
    info.height      = vesa->height ? vesa->height : 600;
    info.pitch       = vesa->pitch  ? (vesa->pitch / 4) : info.width;
    info.poll_input  = bios_poll_input;
    info.sleep_ms    = bios_sleep_ms;
    info.reboot      = bios_reboot;
    info.shutdown    = bios_shutdown;

    kernel_main(&info);
    while (1) __asm__("hlt");
}


========== FILE: ./boot/bios/boot.asm ==========

[bits 16]
[org 0x7C00]

jmp short start
kernel_chunks: dw 8

start:
    cli
    xor ax, ax
    mov ds, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov ss, ax
    mov sp, 0x7C00
    mov [boot_drive], dl

    mov cx, [kernel_chunks]
.read_loop:
    push cx
    mov si, dap
    mov ah, 0x42
    mov dl, [boot_drive]
    int 0x13
    jc disk_err
    add word [dap + 6], 0x0800
    add dword [dap + 8], 64
    pop cx
    loop .read_loop

    xor ax, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov di, 0x9000
    mov ax, 0x4F01
    mov cx, 0x4143
    int 0x10

    mov ax, 0x4F02
    mov bx, 0x4143
    int 0x10

    in al, 0x92
    or al, 2
    out 0x92, al

    lgdt [gdt32_desc]
    mov eax, cr0
    or eax, 1
    mov cr0, eax
    jmp dword 0x08:pm32_entry

disk_err:
    mov ax, 0x0E45
    int 0x10
    cli
    hlt

[bits 32]
pm32_entry:
    mov ax, 0x10
    mov ds, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov fs, ax
    mov gs, ax
    mov ss, ax
    mov esp, 0x90000
    jmp 0x10000

boot_drive: db 0
dap:
    db 0x10, 0
    dw 64, 0x0000, 0x1000
    dq 1

gdt32:
    dq 0
    dq 0x00CF9A000000FFFF
    dq 0x00CF92000000FFFF
gdt32_desc:
    dw gdt32_desc - gdt32 - 1
    dd gdt32

times 510 - ($ - $$) db 0
dw 0xAA55


========== FILE: ./boot/bios/entry64.asm ==========

[bits 32]
section .text.trampoline
global _start32
extern bios_entry

_start32:
    ; Zero out 16 MB of .bss RAM (0x200000 -> 0x1200000) so backbuf & globals are 100% clean
    mov edi, 0x200000
    xor eax, eax
    mov ecx, 2162688
    rep stosd

    ; Build 64-Bit Identity Page Tables at 0x1000 (maps first 4 GB)
    mov edi, 0x1000
    xor eax, eax
    mov ecx, 8192
    rep stosd

    mov dword [0x1000], 0x2003
    mov dword [0x2000], 0x3003
    mov dword [0x2008], 0x4003
    mov dword [0x2010], 0x5003
    mov dword [0x2018], 0x6003

    mov edi, 0x3000
    mov eax, 0x00000083
    mov ecx, 2048
.map_loop:
    mov [edi], eax
    add eax, 0x200000
    add edi, 8
    loop .map_loop

    ; Enable FPU & SSE
    mov eax, cr0
    and ax, 0xFFFB
    or ax, 0x2
    mov cr0, eax

    mov eax, cr4
    or eax, (1 << 5) | (1 << 9) | (1 << 10)
    mov cr4, eax

    ; Enable Long Mode (EFER.LME) & Paging
    mov eax, 0x1000
    mov cr3, eax

    mov ecx, 0xC0000080
    rdmsr
    or eax, 1 << 8
    wrmsr

    mov eax, cr0
    or eax, 1 << 31
    mov cr0, eax

    lgdt [gdt64_desc]
    jmp dword 0x08:lm64_ready

[bits 64]
lm64_ready:
    mov ax, 0x10
    mov ss, ax
    mov ds, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov fs, ax
    mov gs, ax

    ; Place 16-byte aligned stack safely at 0x1800000 (24 MB, well above .bss!)
    mov rsp, 0x007F8000
    mov rcx, 0x9000
    mov rdi, 0x9000
    mov rax, bios_entry
    call rax

.halt:
    hlt
    jmp .halt

align 8
gdt64:
    dq 0
    dq 0x00209A0000000000
    dq 0x0000920000000000
gdt64_desc:
    dw gdt64_desc - gdt64 - 1
    dd gdt64




========== FILE: ./boot/uefi/main.c ==========

#include <stdint.h>
#include "bootinfo.h"

typedef uint64_t UINTN; typedef uint64_t EFI_STATUS; typedef void* EFI_HANDLE; typedef uint16_t CHAR16;
typedef struct { uint32_t Data1; uint16_t Data2; uint16_t Data3; uint8_t Data4[8]; } EFI_GUID;
typedef struct { uint64_t Signature; uint32_t Revision; uint32_t HeaderSize; uint32_t CRC32; uint32_t Reserved; } EFI_TABLE_HEADER;
typedef struct { uint16_t ScanCode; CHAR16 UnicodeChar; } EFI_INPUT_KEY;
typedef struct _EFI_SIMPLE_TEXT_INPUT_PROTOCOL { void* Reset; EFI_STATUS (*ReadKeyStroke)(struct _EFI_SIMPLE_TEXT_INPUT_PROTOCOL *This, EFI_INPUT_KEY *Key); void* WaitForKey; } EFI_SIMPLE_TEXT_INPUT_PROTOCOL;
typedef struct { int32_t RelativeMovementX, RelativeMovementY, RelativeMovementZ; uint8_t LeftButton, RightButton; } EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_STATE;
typedef struct { uint64_t ResolutionX, ResolutionY, ResolutionZ; uint8_t LeftButton, RightButton; } EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_MODE;
typedef struct _EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_PROTOCOL { EFI_STATUS (*Reset)(struct _EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *This, uint8_t Ext); EFI_STATUS (*GetState)(struct _EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *This, EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_STATE *State); void* WaitForInput; EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_MODE *Mode; } EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_PROTOCOL;
typedef struct { uint32_t Version, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution, PixelFormat, PixelInformation[4], PixelsPerScanLine; } EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_MODE_INFORMATION;
typedef struct { uint32_t MaxMode, Mode; EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_MODE_INFORMATION *Info; UINTN SizeOfInfo; uint64_t FrameBufferBase; UINTN FrameBufferSize; } EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL_MODE;
typedef struct _EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL { void* QueryMode; void* SetMode; void* Blt; EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL_MODE *Mode; } EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL;
typedef struct { EFI_TABLE_HEADER Hdr; void *f1,*f2,*f3,*f4,*f5,*f6,*f7,*f8,*f9,*f10,*f11,*f12,*f13,*f14,*f15,*f16,*f17,*f18,*f19,*f20,*f21,*f22,*f23,*f24,*f25,*f26,*f27,*f28; EFI_STATUS (*Stall)(UINTN Microseconds); void *f30,*f31,*f32,*f33,*f34,*f35,*f36,*f37; EFI_STATUS (*LocateProtocol)(EFI_GUID *Protocol, void *Registration, void **Interface); } EFI_BOOT_SERVICES;
typedef struct { EFI_TABLE_HEADER Hdr; void *f1,*f2,*f3,*f4,*f5,*f6,*f7,*f8,*f9,*f10; void (*ResetSystem)(int ResetType, EFI_STATUS ResetStatus, UINTN DataSize, void *ResetData); } EFI_RUNTIME_SERVICES;
typedef struct { EFI_TABLE_HEADER Hdr; CHAR16 *FirmwareVendor; uint32_t FirmwareRevision; EFI_HANDLE ConsoleInHandle; EFI_SIMPLE_TEXT_INPUT_PROTOCOL *ConIn; EFI_HANDLE ConsoleOutHandle; void* ConOut; EFI_HANDLE StandardErrorHandle; void* StdErr; EFI_RUNTIME_SERVICES *RuntimeServices; EFI_BOOT_SERVICES *BootServices; } EFI_SYSTEM_TABLE;

static EFI_SYSTEM_TABLE *g_st = 0;
static EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *g_mouse = 0;
static int cur_mx = 400, cur_my = 300, max_w = 800, max_h = 600;

void uefi_poll_input(InputState *state) {
    state->key_char = 0;
    state->scan_code = 0;
    state->left_click = 0;

    EFI_INPUT_KEY key;
    if (g_st->ConIn->ReadKeyStroke(g_st->ConIn, &key) == 0) {
        state->key_char = (char)key.UnicodeChar;
        state->scan_code = key.ScanCode;
    }

    if (g_mouse) {
        EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_STATE ms;
        if (g_mouse->GetState(g_mouse, &ms) == 0) {
            int rx = (g_mouse->Mode && g_mouse->Mode->ResolutionX > 0) ? (int)g_mouse->Mode->ResolutionX : 1;
            int ry = (g_mouse->Mode && g_mouse->Mode->ResolutionY > 0) ? (int)g_mouse->Mode->ResolutionY : 1;
            int dx = (rx > 100) ? (ms.RelativeMovementX / (rx / 16 + 1)) : (ms.RelativeMovementX * 8);
            int dy = (ry > 100) ? (ms.RelativeMovementY / (ry / 16 + 1)) : (ms.RelativeMovementY * 8);
            if (dx == 0 && ms.RelativeMovementX != 0) dx = (ms.RelativeMovementX > 0) ? 2 : -2;
            if (dy == 0 && ms.RelativeMovementY != 0) dy = (ms.RelativeMovementY > 0) ? 2 : -2;
            cur_mx += dx; cur_my += dy;
            if (cur_mx < 0) cur_mx = 0; if (cur_mx >= max_w) cur_mx = max_w - 1;
            if (cur_my < 0) cur_my = 0; if (cur_my >= max_h) cur_my = max_h - 1;
            state->left_click = ms.LeftButton;
        }
    }
    state->mouse_x = cur_mx;
    state->mouse_y = cur_my;
}

void uefi_sleep_ms(uint32_t ms) { g_st->BootServices->Stall((UINTN)ms * 1000); }
void uefi_reboot(void) { g_st->RuntimeServices->ResetSystem(0, 0, 0, 0); }
void uefi_shutdown(void) { g_st->RuntimeServices->ResetSystem(2, 0, 0, 0); }

EFI_STATUS efi_main(EFI_HANDLE img, EFI_SYSTEM_TABLE *st) {
    g_st = st;
    EFI_GUID gop_guid = {0x9042a9de, 0x23dc, 0x4a38, {0x96,0xfb,0x7a,0xde,0xd0,0x80,0x51,0x6a}};
    EFI_GUID ptr_guid = {0x31878c87, 0x0b75, 0x11d5, {0x9a,0x4f,0x00,0x90,0x27,0x3f,0xc1,0x4d}};
    EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL *gop = 0;

    st->BootServices->LocateProtocol(&gop_guid, 0, (void**)&gop);
    st->BootServices->LocateProtocol(&ptr_guid, 0, (void**)&g_mouse);
    if (g_mouse) g_mouse->Reset(g_mouse, 0);

    max_w = gop->Mode->Info->HorizontalResolution;
    max_h = gop->Mode->Info->VerticalResolution;
    cur_mx = max_w / 2; cur_my = max_h / 2;

    BootInfo info;
    info.framebuffer = (uint32_t*)gop->Mode->FrameBufferBase;
    info.width       = max_w;
    info.height      = max_h;
    info.pitch       = gop->Mode->Info->PixelsPerScanLine;
    info.poll_input  = uefi_poll_input;
    info.sleep_ms    = uefi_sleep_ms;
    info.reboot      = uefi_reboot;
    info.shutdown    = uefi_shutdown;

    // Hand over control to the shared sonionOS kernel!
    kernel_main(&info);
    return 0;
}

========== FILE: ./kernel/arch/gdt.c ==========

#include "arch/gdt.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint32_t rsv0;
    uint64_t rsp0, rsp1, rsp2, rsv1;
    uint64_t ist[7];
    uint64_t rsv2;
    uint16_t rsv3, iomap_base;
} Tss64;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t limit;
    uint64_t base;
} Gdtr64;

static uint64_t gdt[7] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static Tss64    tss      __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static uint8_t  kstack[16384] __attribute__((aligned(16)));

void tss_set_rsp0(uint64_t rsp0) { tss.rsp0 = rsp0; }

void gdt_init(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) gdt[i] = 0;
    uint8_t *tp = (uint8_t *)&tss;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(tss); i++) tp[i] = 0;

    tss.rsp0       = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(kstack + sizeof(kstack));
    tss.iomap_base = sizeof(Tss64);

    gdt[1] = 0x00AF9A000000FFFFULL;
    gdt[2] = 0x00CF92000000FFFFULL;
    gdt[3] = 0x00CFF2000000FFFFULL;
    gdt[4] = 0x00AFFA000000FFFFULL;

    uint64_t base  = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&tss;
    uint64_t limit = sizeof(Tss64) - 1;
    gdt[5] = (limit & 0xFFFFULL) | ((base & 0xFFFFFFULL) << 16) |
               (0x89ULL << 40) | (((limit >> 16) & 0xFULL) << 48) | (((base >> 24) & 0xFFULL) << 56);
    gdt[6] = (base >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFFULL;

    Gdtr64 gdtr = { sizeof(gdt) - 1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)gdt };
    __asm__ volatile (
        "lgdt %0\n\t"
        "pushq $0x08\n\t"
        "leaq 1f(%%rip), %%rax\n\t"
        "pushq %%rax\n\t"
        "lretq\n\t"
        "1:\n\t"
        "movw $0x10, %%ax\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%ds\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%es\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%fs\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%gs\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%ss\n\t"
        : : "m"(gdtr) : "rax", "memory"
    );
    uint16_t tss_sel = GDT_TSS_SEL;
    __asm__ volatile ("ltr %0" : : "r"(tss_sel));
}


========== FILE: ./kernel/arch/paging.c ==========

#include "arch/paging.h"

#define PTE_PRESENT  (1ULL << 0)
#define PTE_WRITABLE (1ULL << 1)
#define PTE_USER     (1ULL << 2)
#define PTE_PS_2MB   (1ULL << 7)

static uint64_t pml4[512]       __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t pdpt[512]       __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t pd_low[4][512] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t pd_hi[512]      __attribute__((aligned(4096)));

void paging_init(BootInfo *info) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) { pml4[i] = 0; pdpt[i] = 0; pd_hi[i] = 0; }
    uint64_t pdpt_flags = PTE_PRESENT | PTE_WRITABLE | PTE_USER;
    pml4[0] = ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pdpt) | pdpt_flags;

    for (uint64_t g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
        pdpt[g] = ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pd_low[g]) | pdpt_flags;
        for (uint64_t m = 0; m < 512; m++) {
            uint64_t addr = (g << 30) | (m << 21);
            uint64_t flags = PTE_PRESENT | PTE_WRITABLE | PTE_PS_2MB;
            if (addr >= USER_BASE_ADDR && addr < USER_LIMIT_ADDR) flags |= PTE_USER;
            pd_low[g][m] = addr | flags;
        }
    }
    if (info && info->framebuffer) {
        uint64_t fb = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)info->framebuffer;
        uint64_t gb = fb >> 30;
        if (gb >= 4 && gb < 512) {
            pdpt[gb] = ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pd_hi) | (PTE_PRESENT | PTE_WRITABLE);
            uint64_t base_gb = gb << 30;
            for (uint64_t m = 0; m < 512; m++) {
                pd_hi[m] = (base_gb | (m << 21)) | (PTE_PRESENT | PTE_WRITABLE | PTE_PS_2MB);
            }
        }
    }

    uint64_t cr3 = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pml4;
    uint64_t cr0;
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %%cr0, %0" : "=r"(cr0));
    cr0 = (cr0 & ~((1ULL << 2) | (1ULL << 3))) | (1ULL << 1);
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %0, %%cr0" : : "r"(cr0));
    uint64_t cr4;
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %%cr4, %0" : "=r"(cr4));
    cr4 |= (1ULL << 7) | (1ULL << 9) | (1ULL << 10);
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %0, %%cr4" : : "r"(cr4));
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %0, %%cr3" : : "r"(cr3) : "memory");
}








========== FILE: ./kernel/arch/syscall.c ==========

#include "arch/syscall.h"
#include "arch/gdt.h"
#include "arch/paging.h"
#include "sysinfo_page.h"
#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <setjmp.h>
#include <time.h>
#include "console.h"
#include "blockdev.h"
#include "fs/fat32.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint64_t r10, r9, r8, rdx, rsi, rdi, rbp, rbx;
    uint64_t r11, rcx, user_rsp;
} SyscallFrame;

static BootInfo  *sc_info = 0;
static Fat32File *fd_tab[32];
static Fat32Dir  *dir_tab[8];
static jmp_buf    r3_ret_jmp[2];
static int        r3_exit_code[2];
static int        r3_depth = 0;

static uint8_t  sc_kstack[2][16384] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static uint64_t sc_kstack_top = 0;
static uint64_t sc_user_rsp   = 0;

static inline uint64_t rdmsr(uint32_t msr) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdmsr" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi) : "c"(msr));
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static inline void wrmsr(uint32_t msr, uint64_t val) {
    __asm__ volatile ("wrmsr" : : "c"(msr), "a"((uint32_t)val), "d"((uint32_t)(val >> 32)));
}

static void sys_hw_reboot(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("cli");
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"((uint8_t)0x06), "Nd"((uint16_t)0xCF9));
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"((uint8_t)0xFE), "Nd"((uint16_t)0x64));
    while (1) __asm__ volatile ("hlt");
}

uint64_t syscall_dispatch(SyscallFrame *f, uint64_t num) {
    uint64_t a1 = f->rdi, a2 = f->rsi, a3 = f->rdx;
    switch (num) {
        case SYS_EXIT:
            int d = (r3_depth > 0) ? (r3_depth - 1) : 0; r3_exit_code[d] = (int)a1;
            longjmp(r3_ret_jmp[d], 1);
            return 0;
        case SYS_WRITE:
            console_write((const char *)a1, (size_t)a2);
            return a2;
        case SYS_GETCHAR:
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)console_getchar((int)a1);
        case SYS_CLEAR:
            console_clear();
            return 0;
        case SYS_OPEN: {
            Fat32File *fp = fat32_open((const char *)a1, (const char *)a2);
            if (!fp) return (uint64_t)-1LL;
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
                if (!fd_tab[i]) { fd_tab[i] = fp; return (uint64_t)i; }
            }
            fat32_close(fp);
            return (uint64_t)-1LL;
        }
        case SYS_READ:
            if (a1 >= 32 || !fd_tab[a1]) return 0;
            return (uint64_t)fat32_read((void *)a2, 1, (size_t)a3, fd_tab[a1]);
        case SYS_FWRITE:
            if (a1 >= 32 || !fd_tab[a1]) return 0;
            return (uint64_t)fat32_write((const void *)a2, 1, (size_t)a3, fd_tab[a1]);
        case SYS_SEEK:
            if (a1 >= 32 || !fd_tab[a1]) return (uint64_t)-1LL;
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)fat32_seek(fd_tab[a1], (int64_t)a2, (int)a3);
        case SYS_TELL:
            if (a1 >= 32 || !fd_tab[a1]) return (uint64_t)-1LL;
            return (uint64_t)fat32_tell(fd_tab[a1]);
        case SYS_CLOSE:
            if (a1 < 32 && fd_tab[a1]) { fat32_close(fd_tab[a1]); fd_tab[a1] = 0; }
            return 0;
        case SYS_MKDIR:
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)fat32_mkdir((const char *)a1);
        case SYS_REMOVE:
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)fat32_remove((const char *)a1);
        case SYS_OPENDIR: {
            Fat32Dir *d = fat32_opendir((const char *)a1);
            if (!d) return (uint64_t)-1LL;
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                if (!dir_tab[i]) { dir_tab[i] = d; return (uint64_t)i; }
            }
            fat32_closedir(d);
            return (uint64_t)-1LL;
        }
        case SYS_READDIR:
            if (a1 >= 8 || !dir_tab[a1]) return 0;
            return (uint64_t)fat32_readdir(dir_tab[a1], (Fat32DirEntry *)a2);
        case SYS_CLOSEDIR:
            if (a1 < 8 && dir_tab[a1]) { fat32_closedir(dir_tab[a1]); dir_tab[a1] = 0; }
            return 0;
        case SYS_TIME:
            return (uint64_t)time(0);
        case SYS_CLOCK:
            return (uint64_t)clock();
        case SYS_REBOOT:
            sys_hw_reboot();
            return 0;
        case SYS_POWEROFF:
            if (sc_info && sc_info->shutdown) sc_info->shutdown();
            return 0;
        case SYS_DISK_INFO: {
            uint64_t *out = (uint64_t *)a1;
            if (out) {
                out[0] = block_get_sector_count();
                out[1] = (uint64_t)fat32_is_mounted();
                strcpy((char *)(out + 2), block_get_driver_name());
                strcpy((char *)(out + 4), fat32_get_type_name());
            }
            return 0;
        }
        case SYS_EXEC:
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)ring3_exec_child((const char *)a1);
        case SYS_BATCH: {
            /* io_uring-style batch: a1 = ptr to uint64_t[count][4] {num,a1,a2,a3}, a2 = count */
            uint64_t (*ops)[4] = (uint64_t (*)[4])a1;
            uint64_t cnt = a2, last = 0;
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
                SyscallFrame sub = *f;
                sub.rdi = ops[i][1];
                sub.rsi = ops[i][2];
                sub.rdx = ops[i][3];
                last = syscall_dispatch(&sub, ops[i][0]);
            }
            return last;
        }
        default:
            return (uint64_t)-1LL;
    }
}

__attribute__((naked)) static void syscall_entry(void) {
    __asm__ volatile (
        "movq %%rsp, %0\n\t"
        "movq %1, %%rsp\n\t"
        "pushq %0\n\t"
        "pushq %%rcx\n\t"
        "pushq %%r11\n\t"
        "pushq %%rbx\n\t"
        "pushq %%rbp\n\t"
        "pushq %%rdi\n\t"
        "pushq %%rsi\n\t"
        "pushq %%rdx\n\t"
        "pushq %%r8\n\t"
        "pushq %%r9\n\t"
        "pushq %%r10\n\t"
        "movq %%rsp, %%rcx\n\t"
        "movq %%rax, %%rdx\n\t"
        "movq %%rsp, %%rbx\n\t"
        "andq $-16, %%rsp\n\t"
        "subq $32, %%rsp\n\t"
        "call syscall_dispatch\n\t"
        "movq %%rbx, %%rsp\n\t"
        "popq %%r10\n\t"
        "popq %%r9\n\t"
        "popq %%r8\n\t"
        "popq %%rdx\n\t"
        "popq %%rsi\n\t"
        "popq %%rdi\n\t"
        "popq %%rbp\n\t"
        "popq %%rbx\n\t"
        "popq %%r11\n\t"
        "popq %%rcx\n\t"
        "popq %%rsp\n\t"
        "sysretq\n\t"
        : "+m"(sc_user_rsp) : "m"(sc_kstack_top) : "memory"
    );
}

void syscall_init(BootInfo *info) {
    sc_info = info;
    sc_kstack_top = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(sc_kstack[0] + 16384);
    memset(fd_tab, 0, sizeof(fd_tab));
    memset(dir_tab, 0, sizeof(dir_tab));

    uint32_t tlo, thi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdtsc" : "=a"(tlo), "=d"(thi));
    SonionSysInfo *si = (SonionSysInfo *)(uintptr_t)SYSINFO_PAGE_ADDR;
    si->magic      = SYSINFO_MAGIC;
    si->boot_tsc   = ((uint64_t)thi << 32) | tlo;
    si->tsc_per_ms = 2500000ULL;
    si->unix_base  = (uint64_t)time(0);
    si->screen_w   = info ? info->width : 1280;
    si->screen_h   = info ? info->height : 800;
    uint64_t efer = rdmsr(0xC0000080U);
    wrmsr(0xC0000080U, efer | 1ULL);

    uint64_t star = ((uint64_t)GDT_KERNEL_DATA << 48) | ((uint64_t)GDT_KERNEL_CODE << 32);
    wrmsr(0xC0000081U, star);
    wrmsr(0xC0000082U, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)syscall_entry);
    wrmsr(0xC0000084U, 0x200ULL);
}

static int ring3_launch(const char *path, uint64_t load_addr, uint64_t stack_top, size_t max_bytes) {
    Fat32File *fp = fat32_open(path, "rb");
    if (!fp) return -1;

    uint8_t *dest = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)load_addr;
    memset(dest, 0, max_bytes);
    size_t n = fat32_read(dest, 1, max_bytes, fp);
    fat32_close(fp);
    if (n == 0 || r3_depth >= 2) return -2;

    int slot = r3_depth++;
    sc_kstack_top = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(sc_kstack[slot] + 16384);
    r3_exit_code[slot] = 0;
    if (setjmp(r3_ret_jmp[slot]) == 0) {
        uint64_t u_ss = GDT_USER_DATA | 3;
        uint64_t u_cs = GDT_USER_CODE | 3;
        __asm__ volatile (
            "movw %w0, %%ds\n\t"
            "movw %w0, %%es\n\t"
            "movw %w0, %%fs\n\t"
            "movw %w0, %%gs\n\t"
            "pushq %0\n\t"
            "pushq %1\n\t"
            "pushq $0x002\n\t"
            "pushq %2\n\t"
            "pushq %3\n\t"
            "iretq\n\t"
            : : "r"(u_ss), "r"(stack_top), "r"(u_cs), "r"(load_addr) : "memory"
        );
    }
    r3_depth--;
    sc_kstack_top = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(sc_kstack[r3_depth > 0 ? r3_depth - 1 : 0] + 16384);
    return r3_exit_code[slot];
}

int ring3_exec(const char *path) {
    return ring3_launch(path, USER_BASE_ADDR, USER_STACK_TOP, 2 * 1024 * 1024);
}

int ring3_exec_child(const char *path) {
    return ring3_launch(path, 0x02800000ULL, 0x037FFFF0ULL, 4 * 1024 * 1024);
}



void ring3_fault_recover(uint64_t exc, uint64_t rip, uint64_t cr2) {
    if (r3_depth <= 0) return;
    int d = r3_depth - 1;
    console_set_color(0x00FACC15, 0x00090D16);
    console_puts("\n[KERNEL] Ring 3 Fault Caught (EXC=");
    char hex[20];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        uint8_t nib = (rip >> ((15 - i) * 4)) & 0xF;
        hex[i] = (nib < 10) ? ('0' + nib) : ('A' + nib - 10);
    }
    hex[16] = 0;
    console_puts(exc == 14 ? "14 #PF" : (exc == 13 ? "13 #GP" : "FAULT"));
    console_puts(", RIP=0x");
    console_puts(hex);
    console_puts(") -> Terminating faulty app!\n");
    console_set_color(0x00E2E8F0, 0x00090D16);
    console_flush_now();
    char c2hex[20];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        uint8_t nib = (cr2 >> ((15 - i) * 4)) & 0xF;
        c2hex[i] = (nib < 10) ? ('0' + nib) : ('A' + nib - 10);
    }
    c2hex[16] = 0;
    console_puts(" CR2=0x"); console_puts(c2hex); console_puts("\n"); console_flush_now();
    r3_depth = d;
    sc_kstack_top = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(sc_kstack[d > 0 ? d - 1 : 0] + 16384);
    r3_exit_code[d] = -(int)(128 + exc);
    longjmp(r3_ret_jmp[d], 1);
}

#include "console.h"

#define MAX_ROWS 135
#define MAX_COLS 240

static const uint8_t cfont[95][5] = {

static BootInfo *c_info = 0;
static uint32_t *c_buf  = 0;
static void (*c_flush)(void) = 0;
void console_set_flush(void (*fn)(void)) { c_flush = fn; }
void console_flush_now(void) { console_render(); if (c_flush) c_flush(); }
static int c_scale = 2, c_cols = 80, c_rows = 25;
static int cur_x = 0, cur_y = 0, dirty = 1;
static uint32_t fg_col = 0x00E2E8F0, bg_col = 0x00090D16;

static char     grid_ch[MAX_ROWS][MAX_COLS];
static uint32_t grid_fg[MAX_ROWS][MAX_COLS];

static inline void serial_outb(uint16_t p, uint8_t v) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"(v), "Nd"(p));
}
static inline uint8_t serial_inb(uint16_t p) {
    uint8_t r; __asm__ volatile ("inb %1, %0" : "=a"(r) : "Nd"(p)); return r;
}

static void serial_putc(char c) {
    if (c == '\n') serial_putc('\r');
    for (int t = 0; t < 100000 && !(serial_inb(0x3FD) & 0x20); t++);
    serial_outb(0x3F8, (uint8_t)c);
}

void console_clear(void) {
    for (int r = 0; r < MAX_ROWS; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < MAX_COLS; c++) {
            grid_ch[r][c] = ' ';
            grid_fg[r][c] = fg_col;
        }
    }
    cur_x = 0; cur_y = 0; dirty = 1;
}

void console_init(BootInfo *info, uint32_t *backbuf, int scale) {
    c_info  = info;
    c_buf   = backbuf ? backbuf : info->framebuffer;
    c_scale = (scale > 0) ? scale : 2;
    c_cols  = ((int)info->width - 32) / (6 * c_scale);
    c_rows  = ((int)info->height - 32) / (9 * c_scale);
    if (c_cols > MAX_COLS) c_cols = MAX_COLS;
    if (c_rows > MAX_ROWS) c_rows = MAX_ROWS;
    console_clear();
}

void console_set_color(uint32_t fg, uint32_t bg) {
    fg_col = fg; bg_col = bg; dirty = 1;
}

static void console_scroll(void) {
    for (int r = 1; r < c_rows; r++) {
        memcpy(grid_ch[r - 1], grid_ch[r], (size_t)c_cols);
        memcpy(grid_fg[r - 1], grid_fg[r], (size_t)c_cols * sizeof(uint32_t));
    }
    for (int c = 0; c < c_cols; c++) {
        grid_ch[c_rows - 1][c] = ' ';
        grid_fg[c_rows - 1][c] = fg_col;
    }
    cur_y = c_rows - 1;
}

void console_putchar(char c) {
    serial_putc(c);
    if (c == '\r') { cur_x = 0; dirty = 1; return; }
    if (c == '\n') {
        cur_x = 0;
        if (++cur_y >= c_rows) console_scroll();
        dirty = 1;
        return;
    }
    if (c == '\b') {
        if (cur_x > 0) {
            cur_x--;
            grid_ch[cur_y][cur_x] = ' ';
            dirty = 1;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (c == '\t') {
        int next = (cur_x + 4) & ~3;
        while (cur_x < next && cur_x < c_cols) console_putchar(' ');
        return;
    }
    if ((unsigned char)c < 32 || (unsigned char)c > 126) c = '?';
    grid_ch[cur_y][cur_x] = c;
    grid_fg[cur_y][cur_x] = fg_col;
    if (++cur_x >= c_cols) {
        cur_x = 0;
        if (++cur_y >= c_rows) console_scroll();
    }
    dirty = 1;
}

void console_write(const char *buf, size_t len) {
    if (!buf) return;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) console_putchar(buf[i]);
}

void console_puts(const char *s) {
    if (!s) return;
    while (*s) console_putchar(*s++);
    console_putchar('\n');
}

void console_render(void) {
    if (!c_info || !c_buf || !dirty) return;
    dirty = 0;

    uint64_t bg64 = ((uint64_t)bg_col << 32) | bg_col;
    uint64_t *dst64 = (uint64_t *)c_buf;
    uint32_t qwords = (c_info->height * c_info->pitch) / 2;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < qwords; i++) dst64[i] = bg64;

    int pad_x = 16, pad_y = 16;
    int cw = 6 * c_scale, ch = 9 * c_scale;

    for (int r = 0; r < c_rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < c_cols; c++) {
            char ch_val = grid_ch[r][c];
            if (ch_val <= 32 || ch_val > 126) continue;
            uint32_t col = grid_fg[r][c];
            int gx = pad_x + c * cw;
            int gy = pad_y + r * ch;
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                uint8_t line = cfont[ch_val - 32][i];
                for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                    if (line & (1 << j)) {
                        for (int dy = 0; dy < c_scale; dy++) {
                            int py = gy + j * c_scale + dy;
                            if (py >= (int)c_info->height) continue;
                            for (int dx = 0; dx < c_scale; dx++) {
                                int px = gx + i * c_scale + dx;
                                if (px < (int)c_info->width) c_buf[py * c_info->pitch + px] = col;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Draw underscore cursor at active (cur_x, cur_y)
    int cx = pad_x + cur_x * cw;
    int cy = pad_y + cur_y * ch + 7 * c_scale;
    for (int dy = 0; dy < c_scale; dy++) {
        int py = cy + dy;
        if (py >= (int)c_info->height) break;
        for (int dx = 0; dx < 5 * c_scale; dx++) {
            int px = cx + dx;
            if (px < (int)c_info->width) c_buf[py * c_info->pitch + px] = 0x0038BDF8;
        }
    }
}

int console_getchar(int blocking) {
    if (!c_info || !c_info->poll_input) return -1;
    InputState in;
    do {
        c_info->poll_input(&in);
        if (in.key_char != 0) return (int)(unsigned char)in.key_char;
        if (in.scan_code == 0x17) return 27; // ESC
        console_render(); if (c_flush) c_flush();
        if (blocking && c_info->sleep_ms) c_info->sleep_ms(10);
    } while (blocking);
    return -1;
}
