#include <limits.h>

static struct lconv c_locale = {
    .decimal_point     = ".",
    .thousands_sep     = "",
    .grouping          = "",
    .int_curr_symbol   = "",
    .currency_symbol   = "",
    .mon_decimal_point = "",
    .mon_thousands_sep = "",
    .mon_grouping      = "",
    .positive_sign     = "",
    .negative_sign     = "",
    .int_frac_digits   = CHAR_MAX,
    .frac_digits       = CHAR_MAX,
    .p_cs_precedes     = CHAR_MAX,
    .p_sep_by_space    = CHAR_MAX,
    .n_cs_precedes     = CHAR_MAX,
    .n_sep_by_space    = CHAR_MAX,
    .p_sign_posn       = CHAR_MAX,
    .n_sign_posn       = CHAR_MAX
};

char *setlocale(int category, const char *locale) {
    (void)category;
    if (!locale || locale[0] == 0 || strcmp(locale, "C") == 0 || strcmp(locale, "POSIX") == 0) {
        return "C";
    }
    return 0;
}

struct lconv *localeconv(void) { return &c_locale; }

static __sighandler_t sig_handlers[32];

__sighandler_t signal(int sig, __sighandler_t func) {
    if (sig <= 0 || sig >= 32) return SIG_ERR;
    __sighandler_t prev = sig_handlers[sig];
    sig_handlers[sig] = func;
    return prev;
}

int raise(int sig) {
    if (sig <= 0 || sig >= 32) return -1;
    __sighandler_t h = sig_handlers[sig];
    if (h != SIG_DFL && h != SIG_IGN && h != SIG_ERR) {
        sig_handlers[sig] = SIG_DFL;
        h(sig);
    }
    return 0;
}


========== FILE: ./kernel/libc/math.c ==========

#include "math.h"
#include "errno.h"

typedef union { double d; uint64_t u; } f64_bits;
typedef union { float  f; uint32_t u; } f32_bits;

double fabs(double x) {
    f64_bits b = { x };
    b.u &= 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL;
    return b.d;
}

float fabsf(float x) {
    f32_bits b = { x };
    b.u &= 0x7FFFFFFFU;
    return b.f;
}

double copysign(double x, double y) {
    f64_bits bx = { x }, by = { y };
    bx.u = (bx.u & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL) | (by.u & 0x8000000000000000ULL);
    return bx.d;
}

float copysignf(float x, float y) {
    f32_bits bx = { x }, by = { y };
    bx.u = (bx.u & 0x7FFFFFFFU) | (by.u & 0x80000000U);
    return bx.f;
}

double fmod(double x, double y) {
    if (y == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isnan(y) || isinf(x)) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (isinf(y)) return x;
    return x - trunc(x / y) * y;
}

float fmodf(float x, float y) { return (float)fmod((double)x, (double)y); }

double remainder(double x, double y) {
    if (y == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isnan(y) || isinf(x)) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (isinf(y)) return x;
    return x - round(x / y) * y;
}

float remainderf(float x, float y) { return (float)remainder((double)x, (double)y); }

double fmax(double x, double y) { if (isnan(x)) return y; if (isnan(y)) return x; return x > y ? x : y; }
float  fmaxf(float x, float y)   { if (isnan(x)) return y; if (isnan(y)) return x; return x > y ? x : y; }
double fmin(double x, double y) { if (isnan(x)) return y; if (isnan(y)) return x; return x < y ? x : y; }
float  fminf(float x, float y)   { if (isnan(x)) return y; if (isnan(y)) return x; return x < y ? x : y; }
double fdim(double x, double y) { return (isnan(x) || isnan(y)) ? NAN : (x > y ? x - y : 0.0); }
float  fdimf(float x, float y)   { return (isnan(x) || isnan(y)) ? NAN : (x > y ? x - y : 0.0f); }
double fma(double x, double y, double z) { return x * y + z; }
float  fmaf(float x, float y, float z)   { return x * y + z; }
double trunc(double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x) || fabs(x) >= 4503599627370496.0) return x;
    return (double)(long long)x;
}

float truncf(float x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x) || fabsf(x) >= 8388608.0f) return x;
    return (float)(long long)x;
}

double floor(double x) {
    double t = trunc(x);
    return (x < t) ? (t - 1.0) : t;
}

float floorf(float x) {
    float t = truncf(x);
    return (x < t) ? (t - 1.0f) : t;
}

double ceil(double x) {
    double t = trunc(x);
    return (x > t) ? (t + 1.0) : t;
}

float ceilf(float x) {
    float t = truncf(x);
    return (x > t) ? (t + 1.0f) : t;
}

double round(double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    return (x >= 0.0) ? floor(x + 0.5) : ceil(x - 0.5);
}

float roundf(float x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    return (x >= 0.0f) ? floorf(x + 0.5f) : ceilf(x - 0.5f);
}

long lround(double x) { return (long)round(x); }
long lroundf(float x) { return (long)roundf(x); }
long long llround(double x) { return (long long)round(x); }
long long llroundf(float x) { return (long long)roundf(x); }
double rint(double x) { return round(x); }
float  rintf(float x) { return roundf(x); }
long lrint(double x) { return (long)rint(x); }
long lrintf(float x) { return (long)rintf(x); }
long long llrint(double x) { return (long long)rint(x); }
long long llrintf(float x) { return (long long)rintf(x); }
double nearbyint(double x) { return rint(x); }
float  nearbyintf(float x) { return rintf(x); }

double frexp(double x, int *exp) {
    f64_bits b = { x };
    int e = (int)((b.u >> 52) & 0x7FF);
    if (e == 0) {
        if (x == 0.0) { *exp = 0; return x; }
        double norm = frexp(x * 18014398509481984.0, exp);
        *exp -= 54;
        return norm;
    }
    if (e == 0x7FF) { *exp = 0; return x; }
    *exp = e - 1022;
    b.u = (b.u & 0x800FFFFFFFFFFFFFULL) | 0x3FE0000000000000ULL;
    return b.d;
}

float frexpf(float x, int *exp) { return (float)frexp((double)x, exp); }

double ldexp(double x, int exp) {
    if (x == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isinf(x) || exp == 0) return x;
    while (exp > 1023)  { x *= 8.98846567431158e307; exp -= 1023; }
    while (exp < -1022) { x *= 2.2250738585072014e-308; exp += 1022; }
    f64_bits scale;
    scale.u = (uint64_t)(exp + 1023) << 52;
    return x * scale.d;
}

float ldexpf(float x, int exp) { return (float)ldexp((double)x, exp); }
double scalbn(double x, int n) { return ldexp(x, n); }
float  scalbnf(float x, int n) { return ldexpf(x, n); }

double modf(double x, double *iptr) {
    double i = trunc(x);
    *iptr = i;
    return isinf(x) ? copysign(0.0, x) : (x - i);
}

float modff(float x, float *iptr) {
    double di;
    double rem = modf((double)x, &di);
    *iptr = (float)di;
    return (float)rem;
}

int ilogb(double x) {
    int e;
    if (x == 0.0) return -2147483647 - 1;
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return 2147483647;
    frexp(x, &e);
    return e - 1;
}

int ilogbf(float x) { return ilogb((double)x); }
double logb(double x) { return (x == 0.0) ? -INFINITY : (double)ilogb(x); }
float  logbf(float x) { return (float)logb((double)x); }
double sqrt(double x) {
    if (x < 0.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (x == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    double res;
    __asm__ volatile ("sqrtsd %1, %0" : "=x"(res) : "x"(x));
    return res;
}

float sqrtf(float x) {
    if (x < 0.0f) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (x == 0.0f || isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    float res;
    __asm__ volatile ("sqrtss %1, %0" : "=x"(res) : "x"(x));
    return res;
}

double cbrt(double x) {
    if (x == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    int neg = x < 0.0;
    double ax = fabs(x);
    f64_bits b = { ax };
    b.u = b.u / 3 + 0x2A9F7893E41F8000ULL;
    double y = b.d;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) y = (2.0 * y + ax / (y * y)) / 3.0;
    return neg ? -y : y;
}

float cbrtf(float x) { return (float)cbrt((double)x); }

double hypot(double x, double y) {
    x = fabs(x); y = fabs(y);
    if (isinf(x) || isinf(y)) return INFINITY;
    double mx = fmax(x, y), mn = fmin(x, y);
    if (mx == 0.0) return 0.0;
    double r = mn / mx;
    return mx * sqrt(1.0 + r * r);
}

float hypotf(float x, float y) { return (float)hypot((double)x, (double)y); }

double exp(double x) {
    if (isnan(x)) return x;
    if (x > 709.782712893) { errno = ERANGE; return HUGE_VAL; }
    if (x < -745.133219102) return 0.0;

    int k = (int)round(x * M_LOG2E);
    double r = x - (double)k * M_LN2;

    double term = 1.0, sum = 1.0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 14; i++) {
        term *= r / (double)i;
        sum += term;
    }
    return ldexp(sum, k);
}

float expf(float x) { return (float)exp((double)x); }
double exp2(double x) { return exp(x * M_LN2); }
float  exp2f(float x) { return (float)exp2((double)x); }
double expm1(double x) { return (fabs(x) < 1e-5) ? (x + 0.5 * x * x + (x * x * x) / 6.0) : (exp(x) - 1.0); }
float  expm1f(float x) { return (float)expm1((double)x); }

double log(double x) {
    if (isnan(x)) return x;
    if (x < 0.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (x == 0.0) { errno = ERANGE; return -HUGE_VAL; }
    if (isinf(x)) return INFINITY;

    int e;
    double m = frexp(x, &e);
    if (m < M_SQRT1_2) { m *= 2.0; e--; }

    double u = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0);
    double u2 = u * u;
    double term = u, sum = u;
    for (int k = 3; k <= 21; k += 2) {
        term *= u2;
        sum += term / (double)k;
    }
    return 2.0 * sum + (double)e * M_LN2;
}

float logf(float x) { return (float)log((double)x); }
double log2(double x) { return log(x) * M_LOG2E; }
float  log2f(float x) { return (float)log2((double)x); }
double log10(double x) { return log(x) * M_LOG10E; }
float  log10f(float x) { return (float)log10((double)x); }
double log1p(double x) { return (fabs(x) < 1e-5) ? (x - 0.5 * x * x + (x * x * x) / 3.0) : log(1.0 + x); }
float  log1pf(float x) { return (float)log1p((double)x); }

double pow(double x, double y) {
    if (y == 0.0 || x == 1.0) return 1.0;
    if (isnan(x) || isnan(y)) return NAN;
    if (x == 0.0) {
        if (y < 0.0) { errno = ERANGE; return HUGE_VAL; }
        return 0.0;
    }
    double iy;
    int is_int = (modf(y, &iy) == 0.0);
    if (x < 0.0 && !is_int) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }

    double ax = fabs(x);
    double res = exp(y * log(ax));
    if (x < 0.0 && ((long long)iy & 1LL)) res = -res;
    return res;
}

float powf(float x, float y) { return (float)pow((double)x, (double)y); }
static double reduce_trig(double x, int *quadrant) {
    double k = round(x * M_2_PI);
    *quadrant = ((int)(long long)k) & 3;
    return x - k * M_PI_2;
}

static double sin_kernel(double r) {
    double r2 = r * r;
    return r * (1.0 - r2 / 6.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 20.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 42.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 72.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 110.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 156.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 210.0)))))));
}

static double cos_kernel(double r) {
    double r2 = r * r;
    return 1.0 - r2 / 2.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 12.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 30.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 56.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 90.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 132.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 182.0))))));
}

double sin(double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    int q;
    double r = reduce_trig(x, &q);
    switch (q) {
        case 0: return  sin_kernel(r);
        case 1: return  cos_kernel(r);
        case 2: return -sin_kernel(r);
        default: return -cos_kernel(r);
    }
}

float sinf(float x) { return (float)sin((double)x); }

double cos(double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    int q;
    double r = reduce_trig(x, &q);
    switch (q) {
        case 0: return  cos_kernel(r);
        case 1: return -sin_kernel(r);
        case 2: return -cos_kernel(r);
        default: return  sin_kernel(r);
    }
}

float cosf(float x) { return (float)cos((double)x); }

double tan(double x) {
    double c = cos(x);
    if (c == 0.0) return copysign(HUGE_VAL, sin(x));
    return sin(x) / c;
}

float tanf(float x) { return (float)tan((double)x); }

double atan(double x) {
    if (isnan(x)) return x;
    int neg = x < 0.0;
    double ax = fabs(x);
    int inv = ax > 1.0;
    if (inv) ax = 1.0 / ax;

    int reduced = 0;
    const double TAN_PI_6  = 0.57735026918962576451;
    const double TAN_PI_12 = 0.26794919243112270647;
    if (ax > TAN_PI_12) {
        ax = (ax - TAN_PI_6) / (1.0 + ax * TAN_PI_6);
        reduced = 1;
    }

    double a2 = ax * ax;
    double term = ax, sum = ax;
    for (int k = 3; k <= 19; k += 2) {
        term = -term * a2;
        sum += term / (double)k;
    }

    if (reduced) sum += M_PI / 6.0;
    if (inv) sum = M_PI_2 - sum;
    return neg ? -sum : sum;
}

float atanf(float x) { return (float)atan((double)x); }

double atan2(double y, double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isnan(y)) return NAN;
    if (x > 0.0) return atan(y / x);
    if (x < 0.0 && y >= 0.0) return atan(y / x) + M_PI;
    if (x < 0.0 && y < 0.0)  return atan(y / x) - M_PI;
    if (x == 0.0 && y > 0.0) return  M_PI_2;
    if (x == 0.0 && y < 0.0) return -M_PI_2;
    return 0.0;
}

float atan2f(float y, float x) { return (float)atan2((double)y, (double)x); }

double asin(double x) {
    if (x < -1.0 || x > 1.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (x == 1.0) return M_PI_2;
    if (x == -1.0) return -M_PI_2;
    return atan2(x, sqrt(1.0 - x * x));
}

float asinf(float x) { return (float)asin((double)x); }

double acos(double x) {
    if (x < -1.0 || x > 1.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    return M_PI_2 - asin(x);
}

float acosf(float x) { return (float)acos((double)x); }

double sinh(double x) { return 0.5 * (exp(x) - exp(-x)); }
float  sinhf(float x) { return (float)sinh((double)x); }
double cosh(double x) { return 0.5 * (exp(x) + exp(-x)); }
float  coshf(float x) { return (float)cosh((double)x); }
double tanh(double x) {
    if (x > 20.0) return 1.0;
    if (x < -20.0) return -1.0;
    double e2 = exp(2.0 * x);
    return (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0);
}
float  tanhf(float x) { return (float)tanh((double)x); }
double asinh(double x) { return log(x + sqrt(x * x + 1.0)); }
float  asinhf(float x) { return (float)asinh((double)x); }

}

========== FILE: ./kernel/libc/memory.c ==========

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define HEAP_SIZE (16 * 1024 * 1024)

typedef struct BlockHdr {
    size_t size;
    int    free;
    struct BlockHdr *next;
} BlockHdr;

static uint8_t heap_buf[HEAP_SIZE] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static BlockHdr *heap_head = 0;

static void heap_init_once(void) {
    if (heap_head) return;
    heap_head = (BlockHdr *)heap_buf;
    heap_head->size = HEAP_SIZE - sizeof(BlockHdr);
    heap_head->free = 1;
    heap_head->next = 0;
}

void *malloc(size_t size) {
    if (size == 0) size = 16;
    size = (size + 15ULL) & ~15ULL;
    heap_init_once();

    BlockHdr *cur = heap_head;
    while (cur) {
        if (cur->free && cur->size >= size) {
            if (cur->size >= size + sizeof(BlockHdr) + 32) {
                BlockHdr *split = (BlockHdr *)((uint8_t *)(cur + 1) + size);
                split->size = cur->size - size - sizeof(BlockHdr);
                split->free = 1;
                split->next = cur->next;
                cur->size = size;
                cur->next = split;
            }
            cur->free = 0;
            return (void *)(cur + 1);
        }
        cur = cur->next;
    }
    return 0;
}

void free(void *ptr) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    BlockHdr *hdr = ((BlockHdr *)ptr) - 1;
    hdr->free = 1;

    BlockHdr *cur = heap_head;
    while (cur && cur->next) {
        if (cur->free && cur->next->free) {
            cur->size += sizeof(BlockHdr) + cur->next->size;
            cur->next = cur->next->next;
        } else {
            cur = cur->next;
        }
    }
}

void *calloc(size_t nmemb, size_t size) {
    size_t total = nmemb * size;
    void *p = malloc(total);
    if (p) memset(p, 0, total);
    return p;
}

void *realloc(void *ptr, size_t size) {
    if (!ptr) return malloc(size);
    if (size == 0) { free(ptr); return 0; }

    BlockHdr *hdr = ((BlockHdr *)ptr) - 1;
    if (hdr->size >= size) return ptr;

    void *np = malloc(size);
    if (!np) return 0;
    memcpy(np, ptr, hdr->size);
    free(ptr);
    return np;
}

#include "setjmp.h"

__attribute__((naked)) int setjmp(jmp_buf env) {
    __asm__ volatile (
        "mov %rbx, 0(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %rbp, 8(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %rdi, 16(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %rsi, 24(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %r12, 32(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %r13, 40(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %r14, 48(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %r15, 56(%rcx)\n\t"
        "lea 8(%rsp), %rax\n\t"
        "mov %rax, 64(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov (%rsp), %rax\n\t"
        "mov %rax, 72(%rcx)\n\t"
        "xor %eax, %eax\n\t"
        "ret\n\t"
    );
}

__attribute__((naked)) void longjmp(jmp_buf env, int val) {
    __asm__ volatile (
        "mov %edx, %eax\n\t"
        "test %eax, %eax\n\t"
        "jnz 1f\n\t"
        "inc %eax\n\t"
        "1:\n\t"
        "mov 0(%rcx), %rbx\n\t"
        "mov 8(%rcx), %rbp\n\t"
        "mov 16(%rcx), %rdi\n\t"
        "mov 24(%rcx), %rsi\n\t"
        "mov 32(%rcx), %r12\n\t"
        "mov 40(%rcx), %r13\n\t"
        "mov 48(%rcx), %r14\n\t"
        "mov 56(%rcx), %r15\n\t"
        "mov 64(%rcx), %rsp\n\t"
        "jmp *72(%rcx)\n\t"
    );
}


========== FILE: ./kernel/libc/stdio.c ==========

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <ctype.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include "console.h"
#include "fs/fat32.h"

FILE __sonion_stdin  = { 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 1, 0 };
FILE __sonion_stdout = { 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 1 };
FILE __sonion_stderr = { 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 1 };

static FILE file_table[FOPEN_MAX];

typedef struct {
    char  *buf;
    size_t cap;
    size_t pos;
} FmtOut;

static void fmt_putc(FmtOut *o, char c) {
    if (o->buf && o->pos + 1 < o->cap) {
        o->buf[o->pos] = c;
    }
    o->pos++;
}

static void fmt_pad(FmtOut *o, char ch, int count) {
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) fmt_putc(o, ch);
}

static void fmt_uint(FmtOut *o, uint64_t val, int base, int upper,
                     int width, int prec, int flags, char sign_ch) {
    char tmp[32];
    const char *digits = upper ? "0123456789ABCDEF" : "0123456789abcdef";
    int len = 0;

    if (val == 0 && prec != 0) {
        tmp[len++] = '0';
    } else {
        while (val > 0) {
            tmp[len++] = digits[val % (uint64_t)base];
            val /= (uint64_t)base;
        }
    }

    int zeros = (prec > len) ? (prec - len) : 0;
    int prefix_len = (sign_ch ? 1 : 0);
    if ((flags & 8) && base == 16) prefix_len += 2;
    if ((flags & 8) && base == 8 && zeros == 0 && len > 0) prefix_len += 1;

    int total = prefix_len + zeros + len;
    int pad = (width > total) ? (width - total) : 0;

    if (!(flags & 1) && !(flags & 4)) fmt_pad(o, ' ', pad);
    if (sign_ch) fmt_putc(o, sign_ch);
    if ((flags & 8) && base == 16) {
        fmt_putc(o, '0');
        fmt_putc(o, upper ? 'X' : 'x');
    } else if ((flags & 8) && base == 8 && zeros == 0 && len > 0) {
        fmt_putc(o, '0');
    }
    if (!(flags & 1) && (flags & 4)) fmt_pad(o, '0', pad);
    fmt_pad(o, '0', zeros);
    while (len > 0) fmt_putc(o, tmp[--len]);
    if (flags & 1) fmt_pad(o, ' ', pad);
}

static void fmt_float(FmtOut *o, double val, int width, int prec, int flags, int is_g) {
    if (prec < 0) prec = 6;
    if (is_g && prec == 0) prec = 1;
    if (prec > 9) prec = 9;
    char sign_ch = 0;
    if (val < 0.0) { sign_ch = '-'; val = -val; }
    else if (flags & 2) sign_ch = '+';
    else if (flags & 16) sign_ch = ' ';

    if (isnan(val) || isinf(val)) {
        const char *s = isnan(val) ? "nan" : "inf";
        if (sign_ch) fmt_putc(o, sign_ch);
        while (*s) fmt_putc(o, *s++);
        return;
    }

    double scale = 1.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < prec; i++) scale *= 10.0;
    uint64_t scaled = (uint64_t)(val * scale + 0.5);
    uint64_t iscale = (uint64_t)scale;
    uint64_t ipart  = scaled / iscale;
    uint64_t fpart  = scaled % iscale;

    char ibuf[24];
    int ilen = 0;
    if (ipart == 0) ibuf[ilen++] = '0';
    else while (ipart > 0) { ibuf[ilen++] = (char)('0' + (ipart % 10)); ipart /= 10; }

    int total = (sign_ch ? 1 : 0) + ilen + (prec > 0 ? 1 + prec : 0);
    int pad = (width > total) ? (width - total) : 0;
    if (!(flags & 1) && !(flags & 4)) fmt_pad(o, ' ', pad);
    if (sign_ch) fmt_putc(o, sign_ch);
    if (!(flags & 1) && (flags & 4)) fmt_pad(o, '0', pad);
    while (ilen > 0) fmt_putc(o, ibuf[--ilen]);

    if (prec > 0) {
        char fbuf[16];
        for (int i = prec - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            fbuf[i] = (char)('0' + (fpart % 10));
            fpart /= 10;
        }
        int show = prec;
        if (is_g && !(flags & 8)) {
            while (show > 0 && fbuf[show - 1] == '0') show--;
        }
        if (show > 0) {
            fmt_putc(o, '.');
            for (int i = 0; i < show; i++) fmt_putc(o, fbuf[i]);
        }
    }
    if (flags & 1) fmt_pad(o, ' ', pad);
}

int vsnprintf(char *str, size_t size, const char *fmt, va_list ap) {
    FmtOut o = { str, size, 0 };
    if (!fmt) return 0;

    while (*fmt) {
        if (*fmt != '%') { fmt_putc(&o, *fmt++); continue; }
        fmt++;
        if (*fmt == '%') { fmt_putc(&o, *fmt++); continue; }

        int flags = 0; /* 1:'-', 2:'+', 4:'0', 8:'#', 16:' ' */
        while (*fmt == '-' || *fmt == '+' || *fmt == '0' || *fmt == '#' || *fmt == ' ') {
            if (*fmt == '-') flags |= 1;
            else if (*fmt == '+') flags |= 2;
            else if (*fmt == '0') flags |= 4;
            else if (*fmt == '#') flags |= 8;
            else if (*fmt == ' ') flags |= 16;
            fmt++;
        }

        int width = 0;
        if (*fmt == '*') { width = va_arg(ap, int); fmt++; if (width < 0) { flags |= 1; width = -width; } }
        else while (isdigit((unsigned char)*fmt)) width = width * 10 + (*fmt++ - '0');

        int prec = -1;
        if (*fmt == '.') {
            fmt++; prec = 0;
            if (*fmt == '*') { prec = va_arg(ap, int); fmt++; }
            else while (isdigit((unsigned char)*fmt)) prec = prec * 10 + (*fmt++ - '0');
        }

        int len_mod = 0; /* 1:l, 2:ll, 3:h, 4:hh */
        if (*fmt == 'l') { fmt++; len_mod = 1; if (*fmt == 'l') { fmt++; len_mod = 2; } }
        else if (*fmt == 'h') { fmt++; len_mod = 3; if (*fmt == 'h') { fmt++; len_mod = 4; } }
        else if (*fmt == 'z' || *fmt == 't' || *fmt == 'j') { fmt++; len_mod = 2; }

        char spec = *fmt ? *fmt++ : 0;
        if (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i') {
            int64_t v = (len_mod == 2) ? va_arg(ap, long long) :
                        (len_mod == 1) ? va_arg(ap, long) : va_arg(ap, int);
            char sc = 0; uint64_t uv = (uint64_t)v;
            if (v < 0) { sc = '-'; uv = (uint64_t)(-(v + 1)) + 1ULL; }
            else if (flags & 2) sc = '+';
            else if (flags & 16) sc = ' ';
            fmt_uint(&o, uv, 10, 0, width, prec, flags, sc);
        } else if (spec == 'u' || spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'o') {
            uint64_t uv = (len_mod == 2) ? va_arg(ap, unsigned long long) :
                          (len_mod == 1) ? va_arg(ap, unsigned long) : va_arg(ap, unsigned int);
            int base = (spec == 'o') ? 8 : ((spec == 'u') ? 10 : 16);
            fmt_uint(&o, uv, base, (spec == 'X'), width, prec, flags, 0);
        } else if (spec == 'p') {
            uintptr_t ptr = (uintptr_t)va_arg(ap, void *);
            fmt_uint(&o, (uint64_t)ptr, 16, 0, width, prec, flags | 8, 0);
        } else if (spec == 's') {
            const char *s = va_arg(ap, const char *);
            if (!s) s = "(null)";
            int slen = (int)strlen(s);
            if (prec >= 0 && slen > prec) slen = prec;
            int pad = (width > slen) ? (width - slen) : 0;
            if (!(flags & 1)) fmt_pad(&o, ' ', pad);
            for (int i = 0; i < slen; i++) fmt_putc(&o, s[i]);
            if (flags & 1) fmt_pad(&o, ' ', pad);
        } else if (spec == 'c') {
            char ch = (char)va_arg(ap, int);
            int pad = (width > 1) ? (width - 1) : 0;
            if (!(flags & 1)) fmt_pad(&o, ' ', pad);
            fmt_putc(&o, ch);
            if (flags & 1) fmt_pad(&o, ' ', pad);
        } else if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'F' || spec == 'g' || spec == 'G' || spec == 'e' || spec == 'E') {
            double dv = va_arg(ap, double);
            fmt_float(&o, dv, width, prec, flags, (spec == 'g' || spec == 'G'));
        } else if (spec == 'n') {
            int *np = va_arg(ap, int *);
            if (np) *np = (int)o.pos;
        }
    }

    if (str && size > 0) {
        size_t end = (o.pos < size) ? o.pos : (size - 1);
        str[end] = 0;
    }
    return (int)o.pos;
}

    va_end(ap); return r;
}

int vfprintf(FILE *stream, const char *fmt, va_list ap) {

    if (len <= 0 || !stream) return len;
    size_t out_len = (len < (int)sizeof(tmp)) ? (size_t)len : (sizeof(tmp) - 1);
    fwrite(tmp, 1, out_len, stream);
    return len;
}

int vsscanf(const char *str, const char *fmt, va_list ap) {
    if (!str || !fmt) return EOF;
    const char *s = str;
    int assigned = 0;

    while (*fmt) {
        if (isspace((unsigned char)*fmt)) {
            while (isspace((unsigned char)*fmt)) fmt++;
            while (isspace((unsigned char)*s)) s++;
            continue;
        }
        if (*fmt != '%') {
            if (*s != *fmt) break;
            s++; fmt++; continue;
        }
        fmt++;
        if (*fmt == '%') { if (*s != '%') break; s++; fmt++; continue; }

        int suppress = 0;
        if (*fmt == '*') { suppress = 1; fmt++; }

        int width = 0;
        while (isdigit((unsigned char)*fmt)) width = width * 10 + (*fmt++ - '0');

        int is_long = 0;
        if (*fmt == 'l') { is_long = 1; fmt++; if (*fmt == 'l') { is_long = 2; fmt++; } }
        else if (*fmt == 'h') { fmt++; if (*fmt == 'h') fmt++; }

        char spec = *fmt ? *fmt++ : 0;
        if (spec != 'c' && spec != 'n') {
            while (isspace((unsigned char)*s)) s++;
        }
        if (!*s && spec != 'n') return assigned ? assigned : EOF;

        if (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i' || spec == 'u' ||
            spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'o') {
            char num[64];
            int n = 0, maxw = (width > 0 && width < 63) ? width : 63;
            if ((spec == 'd' || spec == 'i') && (*s == '-' || *s == '+') && n < maxw)
                num[n++] = *s++;
            if (spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'i') {
                if (s[0] == '0' && (s[1] == 'x' || s[1] == 'X') && n + 2 <= maxw) {
                    num[n++] = *s++; num[n++] = *s++;
                }
            }
            while (*s && n < maxw) {
                char c = *s;
                int ok = (spec == 'o') ? (c >= '0' && c <= '7') :
                         (spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'i') ? isxdigit((unsigned char)c) :
                         isdigit((unsigned char)c);
                if (!ok) break;
                num[n++] = *s++;
            }
            num[n] = 0;
            if (n == 0 || (n == 1 && (num[0] == '-' || num[0] == '+'))) break;
            int base = (spec == 'o') ? 8 : ((spec == 'x' || spec == 'X') ? 16 : ((spec == 'i') ? 0 : 10));
            if (!suppress) {
                if (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i') {
                    long long v = strtoll(num, 0, base);
                    if (is_long == 2) *va_arg(ap, long long *) = v;
                    else if (is_long == 1) *va_arg(ap, long *) = (long)v;
                    else *va_arg(ap, int *) = (int)v;
                } else {
                    unsigned long long uv = strtoull(num, 0, base);
                    if (is_long == 2) *va_arg(ap, unsigned long long *) = uv;
                    else if (is_long == 1) *va_arg(ap, unsigned long *) = (unsigned long)uv;
                    else *va_arg(ap, unsigned int *) = (unsigned int)uv;
                }
                assigned++;
            }
        } else if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'F' || spec == 'g' || spec == 'e') {
            char *endp = 0;
            double dv = strtod(s, &endp);
            if (endp == s) break;
            s = endp;
            if (!suppress) {
                if (is_long >= 1) *va_arg(ap, double *) = dv;
                else *va_arg(ap, float *) = (float)dv;
                assigned++;
            }
        } else if (spec == 's') {
            char *dst = suppress ? 0 : va_arg(ap, char *);
            int cnt = 0;
            while (*s && !isspace((unsigned char)*s) && (!width || cnt < width)) {
                if (dst) dst[cnt] = *s;
                s++; cnt++;
            }
            if (cnt == 0) break;
            if (dst) dst[cnt] = 0;
            if (!suppress) assigned++;
        } else if (spec == 'c') {
            char *dst = suppress ? 0 : va_arg(ap, char *);
            int cnt = width ? width : 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
                if (!*s) return assigned ? assigned : EOF;
                if (dst) dst[i] = *s;
                s++;
            }
            if (!suppress) assigned++;
        } else if (spec == '[') {
            int invert = 0;
            if (*fmt == '^') { invert = 1; fmt++; }
            const char *set_start = fmt;
            if (*fmt == ']') fmt++;
            while (*fmt && *fmt != ']') fmt++;
            const char *set_end = fmt;
            if (*fmt == ']') fmt++;
            char *dst = suppress ? 0 : va_arg(ap, char *);
            int cnt = 0;
            while (*s && (!width || cnt < width)) {
                int in_set = 0;
                for (const char *p = set_start; p < set_end; p++) {
                    if (*p == *s) { in_set = 1; break; }
                }
                if (invert ? in_set : !in_set) break;
                if (dst) dst[cnt] = *s;
                s++; cnt++;
            }
            if (cnt == 0) break;
            if (dst) dst[cnt] = 0;
            if (!suppress) assigned++;
        } else if (spec == 'n') {
            if (!suppress) *va_arg(ap, int *) = (int)(s - str);
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    return assigned;
}

FILE *fopen(const char *filename, const char *mode) {
    if (!filename || !mode) { errno = EINVAL; return 0; }
    Fat32File *ff = fat32_open(filename, mode);
    if (!ff) { errno = ENOENT; return 0; }

    for (int i = 0; i < FOPEN_MAX; i++) {
        if (!file_table[i].in_use) {
            FILE *f = &file_table[i];
            memset(f, 0, sizeof(FILE));
            f->in_use   = 1;
            f->kind     = 1;
            f->handle   = ff;
            f->unget_ch = -1;
            f->readable = (strchr(mode, 'r') != 0 || strchr(mode, '+') != 0);
            f->writable = (strchr(mode, 'w') != 0 || strchr(mode, 'a') != 0 ||
                           strchr(mode, '+') != 0);
            return f;
        }
    }
    fat32_close(ff);
    errno = EMFILE;
    return 0;
}

FILE *freopen(const char *filename, const char *mode, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream) return fopen(filename, mode);
    if (stream->kind == 1 && stream->handle) fat32_close((Fat32File *)stream->handle);
    Fat32File *ff = fat32_open(filename, mode);
    if (!ff) { stream->in_use = 0; return 0; }
    stream->in_use = 1; stream->kind = 1; stream->handle = ff;
    stream->eof = 0; stream->err = 0; stream->unget_ch = -1;
    return stream;
}

int fclose(FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use) return EOF;
    if (stream->kind == 1 && stream->handle) {
        fat32_close((Fat32File *)stream->handle);
        stream->handle = 0;
        stream->in_use = 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

size_t fread(void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use || !ptr || !size || !nmemb) return 0;
    if (stream->kind == 0) {
        uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)ptr;
        size_t want = size * nmemb, got = 0;
        while (got < want) {
            int ch = fgetc(stream);
            if (ch == EOF) break;
            dst[got++] = (uint8_t)ch;
        }
        return got / size;
    }
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)ptr;
    size_t want = size * nmemb, extra = 0;
    if (stream->unget_ch >= 0 && want > 0) {
        *dst++ = (uint8_t)stream->unget_ch;
        stream->unget_ch = -1;
        want--; extra = 1;
    }
    size_t r = fat32_read(dst, 1, want, (Fat32File *)stream->handle);
    if (r + extra < size * nmemb) stream->eof = 1;
    return (r + extra) / size;
}

size_t fwrite(const void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use || !ptr || !size || !nmemb) return 0;
    if (stream->kind == 0) {
        console_write((const char *)ptr, size * nmemb);
        return nmemb;
    }
    return fat32_write(ptr, size, nmemb, (Fat32File *)stream->handle);
}

int fgetc(FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use) return EOF;
    if (stream->unget_ch >= 0) {
        int c = stream->unget_ch;
        stream->unget_ch = -1;
        return c;
    }
    if (stream->kind == 0) {
        static char in_buf[512];
        static int in_len = 0, in_pos = 0;
        while (in_pos >= in_len) {
            in_len = 0;
            in_pos = 0;
            while (1) {
                int c = console_getchar(1);
                if (c < 0) {
                    if (in_len == 0) { stream->eof = 1; return EOF; }
                    break;
                }
                if (c == '\r' || c == '\n') {
                    console_putchar('\n');
                    if (in_len < 511) in_buf[in_len++] = '\n';
                    break;
                }
                if (c == '\b' || c == 127) {
                    if (in_len > 0) {
                        in_len--;
                        console_putchar('\b');
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if (c >= 32 && c <= 126 && in_len < 510) {
                    in_buf[in_len++] = (char)c;
                    console_putchar((char)c);
                }
            }
        }
        return (unsigned char)in_buf[in_pos++];
    }
    uint8_t b = 0;
    if (fat32_read(&b, 1, 1, (Fat32File *)stream->handle) != 1) {
        stream->eof = 1;
        return EOF;
    }
    return (int)b;
}

char *fgets(char *s, int n, FILE *stream) {
    if (!s || n <= 0 || !stream) return 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i + 1 < n) {
        int c = fgetc(stream);
        if (c == EOF) break;
        if (c == '\b' && stream->kind == 0) {
            if (i > 0) i--;
            continue;
        }
        s[i++] = (char)c;
        if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') break;
    }
    if (i == 0) return 0;
    s[i] = 0;
    return s;
}

}

static unsigned long long rng_state = 0x5DEECE66DULL;

void srand(unsigned int seed) {
    rng_state = (unsigned long long)seed ^ 0x5DEECE66DULL;
}

int rand(void) {
    rng_state = rng_state * 6364136223846793005ULL + 1442695040888963407ULL;
    return (int)((rng_state >> 33) & RAND_MAX);
}

static int char_to_digit(char c) {
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0';
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') return c - 'a' + 10;
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return c - 'A' + 10;
    return -1;
}

unsigned long long strtoull(const char *nptr, char **endptr, int base) {
    const char *s = nptr;
    while (isspace((uint8_t)*s)) s++;

    int neg = 0;
    if (*s == '-') { neg = 1; s++; }
    else if (*s == '+') { s++; }

    if ((base == 0 || base == 16) && s[0] == '0' && (s[1] == 'x' || s[1] == 'X')) {
        base = 16; s += 2;
    } else if (base == 0) {
        base = (*s == '0') ? 8 : 10;
    }

    unsigned long long acc = 0;
    int any = 0, d;
    while ((d = char_to_digit(*s)) >= 0 && d < base) {
        acc = acc * (unsigned long long)base + (unsigned long long)d;
        any = 1;
        s++;
    }

    if (endptr) *endptr = (char *)(any ? s : nptr);
    return neg ? (unsigned long long)(-(long long)acc) : acc;
}

long long strtoll(const char *nptr, char **endptr, int base) {
    const char *s = nptr;
    while (isspace((uint8_t)*s)) s++;
    int neg = (*s == '-');
    unsigned long long val = strtoull(nptr, endptr, base);
    return neg ? -(long long)val : (long long)val;
}

unsigned long strtoul(const char *nptr, char **endptr, int base) {
    return (unsigned long)strtoull(nptr, endptr, base);
}

long strtol(const char *nptr, char **endptr, int base) {
    return (long)strtoll(nptr, endptr, base);
}

double strtod(const char *nptr, char **endptr) {
    const char *s = nptr;
    while (isspace((uint8_t)*s)) s++;

    double sign = 1.0;
    if (*s == '-') { sign = -1.0; s++; }
    else if (*s == '+') { s++; }

    double val = 0.0;
    int any = 0;
    while (isdigit((uint8_t)*s)) {
        val = val * 10.0 + (*s - '0');
        any = 1;
        s++;
    }

    if (*s == '.') {
        s++;
        double frac = 0.1;
        while (isdigit((uint8_t)*s)) {
            val += (*s - '0') * frac;
            frac *= 0.1;
            any = 1;
            s++;
        }
    }

    if (any && (*s == 'e' || *s == 'E')) {
        s++;
        int exp_sign = 1;
        if (*s == '-') { exp_sign = -1; s++; }
        else if (*s == '+') { s++; }
        int exp = 0;
        while (isdigit((uint8_t)*s)) {
            exp = exp * 10 + (*s - '0');
            s++;
        }
        double p10 = 1.0;
        while (exp--) p10 *= 10.0;
        val = (exp_sign > 0) ? (val * p10) : (val / p10);
    }

    if (endptr) *endptr = (char *)(any ? s : nptr);
    return sign * val;
}

float strtof(const char *nptr, char **endptr) { return (float)strtod(nptr, endptr); }

static void swap_bytes(uint8_t *a, uint8_t *b, size_t size) {
    while (size--) {
        uint8_t tmp = *a;
        *a++ = *b;
        *b++ = tmp;
    }
}

void qsort(void *base, size_t nmemb, size_t size, int (*compar)(const void *, const void *)) {
    if (!base || nmemb < 2 || size == 0) return;
    uint8_t *arr = (uint8_t *)base;

    // Shell/Comb-assisted In-Place Sort (zero recursion stack overflow risk in Ring 0)
    size_t gap = nmemb;
    int swapped = 1;
    while (gap > 1 || swapped) {
        gap = (gap * 10) / 13;
        if (gap < 1) gap = 1;
        swapped = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + gap < nmemb; i++) {
            uint8_t *a = arr + i * size;
            uint8_t *b = arr + (i + gap) * size;
            if (compar(a, b) > 0) {
                swap_bytes(a, b, size);
                swapped = 1;
            }
        }
    }
}

void *bsearch(const void *key, const void *base, size_t nmemb, size_t size, int (*compar)(const void *, const void *)) {
    const uint8_t *arr = (const uint8_t *)base;
    size_t lo = 0, hi = nmemb;
    while (lo < hi) {
        size_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        const void *elem = arr + mid * size;
        int cmp = compar(key, elem);
        if (cmp == 0) return (void *)elem;
        if (cmp < 0) hi = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    return NULL;
}

#define MAX_ATEXIT 32
static void (*atexit_funcs[32])(void);
static int atexit_count = 0;

int atexit(void (*func)(void)) {
    if (atexit_count >= MAX_ATEXIT) return -1;
    atexit_funcs[atexit_count++] = func;
    return 0;
}

void exit(int status) {
    (void)status;
    while (atexit_count > 0) {
        atexit_funcs[--atexit_count]();
    }
    while (1) __asm__ volatile ("hlt");
}

void abort(void) {
    while (1) __asm__ volatile ("hlt");
}

void *memcpy(void *dst, const void *src, size_t n) {
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)src;
    while (n >= 8) {
        *(uint64_t *)d = *(const uint64_t *)s;
        d += 8; s += 8; n -= 8;
    }
    while (n--) *d++ = *s++;
    return dst;
}

void *memmove(void *dst, const void *src, size_t n) {
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)src;
    if (d < s) return memcpy(dst, src, n);
    if (d > s) {
        d += n; s += n;
        while (n--) *--d = *--s;
    }
    return dst;
}

void *memset(void *dst, int val, size_t n) {
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    uint8_t v8 = (uint8_t)val;
    uint64_t v64 = (uint64_t)v8 * 0x0101010101010101ULL;
    while (n >= 8) {
        *(uint64_t *)d = v64;
        d += 8; n -= 8;
    }
    while (n--) *d++ = v8;
    return dst;
}

int memcmp(const void *s1, const void *s2, size_t n) {
    const uint8_t *a = (const uint8_t *)s1;
    const uint8_t *b = (const uint8_t *)s2;
    while (n--) {
        if (*a != *b) return (int)*a - (int)*b;
        a++; b++;
    }
    return 0;
}

void *memchr(const void *s, int c, size_t n) {
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)s;
    while (n--) {
        if (*p == (uint8_t)c) return (void *)p;
        p++;
    }
    return NULL;
}

size_t strlen(const char *s) {
    size_t len = 0;
    while (s[len]) len++;
    return len;
}

size_t strnlen(const char *s, size_t maxlen) {
    size_t len = 0;
    while (len < maxlen && s[len]) len++;
    return len;
}

char *strcpy(char *dst, const char *src) {
    char *ret = dst;
    while ((*dst++ = *src++));
    return ret;
}

char *strncpy(char *dst, const char *src, size_t n) {
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i < n && src[i]; i++) dst[i] = src[i];
    for (; i < n; i++) dst[i] = '\0';
    return dst;
}

char *strcat(char *dst, const char *src) {
    char *ret = dst;
    while (*dst) dst++;
    while ((*dst++ = *src++));
    return ret;
}

char *strncat(char *dst, const char *src, size_t n) {
    char *ret = dst;
    while (*dst) dst++;
    while (n-- && *src) *dst++ = *src++;
    *dst = '\0';
    return ret;
}

int strcmp(const char *s1, const char *s2) {
    while (*s1 && (*s1 == *s2)) { s1++; s2++; }
    return (int)(uint8_t)*s1 - (int)(uint8_t)*s2;
}

int strncmp(const char *s1, const char *s2, size_t n) {
    while (n && *s1 && (*s1 == *s2)) { s1++; s2++; n--; }
    return n == 0 ? 0 : (int)(uint8_t)*s1 - (int)(uint8_t)*s2;
}

int strcasecmp(const char *s1, const char *s2) {
    while (*s1 && (tolower((uint8_t)*s1) == tolower((uint8_t)*s2))) { s1++; s2++; }
    return tolower((uint8_t)*s1) - tolower((uint8_t)*s2);
}

int strncasecmp(const char *s1, const char *s2, size_t n) {
    while (n && *s1 && (tolower((uint8_t)*s1) == tolower((uint8_t)*s2))) { s1++; s2++; n--; }
    return n == 0 ? 0 : tolower((uint8_t)*s1) - tolower((uint8_t)*s2);
}

char *strchr(const char *s, int c) {
    while (*s) {
        if (*s == (char)c) return (char *)s;
        s++;
    }
    return (c == 0) ? (char *)s : NULL;
}

char *strrchr(const char *s, int c) {
    const char *last = NULL;
    do {
        if (*s == (char)c) last = s;
    } while (*s++);
    return (char *)last;
}

char *strstr(const char *haystack, const char *needle) {
    if (!*needle) return (char *)haystack;
    for (; *haystack; haystack++) {
        const char *h = haystack, *n = needle;
        while (*h && *n && (*h == *n)) { h++; n++; }
        if (!*n) return (char *)haystack;
    }
    return NULL;
}

size_t strspn(const char *s, const char *accept) {
    size_t count = 0;
    while (*s && strchr(accept, *s++)) count++;
    return count;
}

size_t strcspn(const char *s, const char *reject) {
    size_t count = 0;
    while (*s && !strchr(reject, *s++)) count++;
    return count;
}

char *strpbrk(const char *s, const char *accept) {
    while (*s) {
        if (strchr(accept, *s)) return (char *)s;
        s++;
    }
    return NULL;
}

char *strtok(char *str, const char *delim) {
    static char *saved = NULL;
    if (str) saved = str;
    if (!saved) return NULL;
    saved += strspn(saved, delim);
    if (!*saved) { saved = NULL; return NULL; }
    char *token = saved;
    saved += strcspn(saved, delim);
    if (*saved) *saved++ = '\0';
    else saved = NULL;
    return token;
}

========== FILE: ./kernel/libc/time.c ==========

#include <time.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static inline void cmos_outb(uint16_t p, uint8_t v) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"(v), "Nd"(p));
}
static inline uint8_t cmos_inb(uint16_t p) {
    uint8_t r; __asm__ volatile ("inb %1, %0" : "=a"(r) : "Nd"(p)); return r;
}

static uint8_t rtc_read(uint8_t reg) {
    cmos_outb(0x70, reg);
    return cmos_inb(0x71);
}

static uint8_t bcd_to_bin(uint8_t b) {
    return (uint8_t)((b & 0x0F) + ((b >> 4) * 10));
}

static int is_leap(int year) {
    return (year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0));
}

static const int mdays[12] = { 31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31 };

clock_t clock(void) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdtsc" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi));
    uint64_t tsc = ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
    return (clock_t)(tsc / 2500000ULL);
}

double difftime(time_t t1, time_t t0) { return (double)(t1 - t0); }

time_t mktime(struct tm *tm) {
    if (!tm) return (time_t)-1;
    int year = tm->tm_year + 1900;
    int mon  = tm->tm_mon;
    while (mon < 0)  { mon += 12; year--; }
    while (mon >= 12){ mon -= 12; year++; }

    int64_t days = 0;
    for (int y = 1970; y < year; y++) days += is_leap(y) ? 366 : 365;
    for (int y = year; y < 1970; y++) days -= is_leap(y) ? 366 : 365;

    int yday = 0;
    for (int m = 0; m < mon; m++) {
        int d = mdays[m] + ((m == 1 && is_leap(year)) ? 1 : 0);
        yday += d;
    }
    yday += (tm->tm_mday - 1);
    days += yday;

    tm->tm_yday = yday;
    int wday = (int)((days + 4) % 7);
    if (wday < 0) wday += 7;
    tm->tm_wday = wday;

    return (time_t)(days * 86400LL + tm->tm_hour * 3600LL + tm->tm_min * 60LL + tm->tm_sec);
}

time_t time(time_t *timer) {
    while (rtc_read(0x0A) & 0x80) __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    uint8_t sec  = rtc_read(0x00);
    uint8_t min  = rtc_read(0x02);
    uint8_t hour = rtc_read(0x04);
    uint8_t day  = rtc_read(0x07);
    uint8_t mon  = rtc_read(0x08);
    uint8_t year = rtc_read(0x09);
    uint8_t regb = rtc_read(0x0B);

    if (!(regb & 0x04)) {
        sec  = bcd_to_bin(sec);
        min  = bcd_to_bin(min);
        hour = bcd_to_bin(hour & 0x7F) | (hour & 0x80);
        day  = bcd_to_bin(day);
        mon  = bcd_to_bin(mon);
        year = bcd_to_bin(year);
    }
    if (!(regb & 0x02) && (hour & 0x80)) {
        hour = (uint8_t)(((hour & 0x7F) + 12) % 24);
    }

    struct tm t;
    memset(&t, 0, sizeof(t));
    t.tm_sec  = sec;
    t.tm_min  = min;
    t.tm_hour = hour;
    t.tm_mday = day ? day : 1;
    t.tm_mon  = mon ? (mon - 1) : 0;
    t.tm_year = 100 + year;

    time_t epoch = mktime(&t);
    if (timer) *timer = epoch;
    return epoch;
}

static struct tm static_tm;

struct tm *gmtime(const time_t *timer) {
    if (!timer) return 0;
    int64_t t = *timer;
    int64_t days = t / 86400LL;
    int64_t rem  = t % 86400LL;
    if (rem < 0) { rem += 86400LL; days--; }

    static_tm.tm_hour = (int)(rem / 3600);
    static_tm.tm_min  = (int)((rem % 3600) / 60);
    static_tm.tm_sec  = (int)(rem % 60);

    int wday = (int)((days + 4) % 7);
    if (wday < 0) wday += 7;
    static_tm.tm_wday = wday;

    int year = 1970;
    while (days >= (is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365)) {
        days -= is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365;
        year++;
    }
    while (days < 0) {
        year--;
        days += is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365;
    }
    static_tm.tm_year = year - 1900;
    static_tm.tm_yday = (int)days;

    int mon = 0;
    while (mon < 11) {
        int d = mdays[mon] + ((mon == 1 && is_leap(year)) ? 1 : 0);
        if (days < d) break;
        days -= d;
        mon++;
    }
    static_tm.tm_mon  = mon;
    static_tm.tm_mday = (int)days + 1;
    static_tm.tm_isdst = 0;
    return &static_tm;
}

struct tm *localtime(const time_t *timer) { return gmtime(timer); }

static void vram_char(char c, int x, int y, uint32_t col, int scale) {
    if (!p_info || c < 32 || c > 126) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        uint8_t line = pfont[c - 32][i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            if (line & (1 << j)) {
                for (int dy = 0; dy < scale; dy++) {
                    int py = y + j * scale + dy;
                    if (py < 0 || py >= (int)p_info->height) continue;
                    for (int dx = 0; dx < scale; dx++) {
                        int px = x + i * scale + dx;
                        if (px >= 0 && px < (int)p_info->width)
                            p_info->framebuffer[py * p_info->pitch + px] = col;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

static void vram_str(const char *s, int x, int y, uint32_t col, int scale) {
    while (*s) { vram_char(*s++, x, y, col, scale); x += 6 * scale; }
}

static void vram_hex(const char *label, uint64_t val, int x, int y) {
    char buf[32];
    int p = 0;
    while (label[p]) { buf[p] = label[p]; p++; }
    buf[p++] = '0';
    buf[p++] = 'x';
    const char *hex = "0123456789ABCDEF";
    for (int s = 60; s >= 0; s -= 4) {
        buf[p++] = hex[(val >> s) & 0xF];
    }
    buf[p] = 0;
    vram_str(buf, x, y, 0x00F8FAFC, 2);
}

static void halt_with_reboot(void) {
    InputState in;
    while (1) {
        if (p_info && p_info->poll_input) {
            p_info->poll_input(&in);
            if (in.scan_code == 0x17 && p_info->reboot) p_info->reboot();
        }
        __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    }
}

static void paint_panic_bg(void) {
    if (!p_info || !p_info->framebuffer) return;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < p_info->height; y++) {
        uint32_t col = (y < 64) ? 0x00991B1B : 0x000F172A;
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < p_info->width; x++) {
            p_info->framebuffer[y * p_info->pitch + x] = col;
        }
    }
    vram_str("SONIONOS KERNEL PANIC - SYSTEM HALTED", 28, 22, 0x00FFFFFF, 2);
    vram_str("Press ESC to reboot machine...", 28, (int)p_info->height - 40, 0x0094A3B8, 2);
}

void kernel_panic(const char *reason, const char *file, int line) {
    __asm__ volatile ("cli");
    paint_panic_bg();
    vram_str("REASON:", 28, 90, 0x00F87171, 2);
    vram_str(reason ? reason : "Unknown Kernel Panic", 125, 90, 0x00FFFFFF, 2);
    vram_str("SOURCE:", 28, 125, 0x00F87171, 2);
    vram_str(file ? file : "unknown", 125, 125, 0x00E2E8F0, 2);
    vram_hex("LINE:   ", (uint64_t)line, 28, 160);
    halt_with_reboot();
}

__attribute__((used)) __attribute__((used)) void panic_exception_handler(ExceptionFrame *f) {
    if ((f->cs & 3) == 3) { uint64_t cr2 = 0; __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr2, %0" : "=r"(cr2)); ring3_fault_recover(f->int_no, f->rip, cr2); }
    __asm__ volatile ("cli");
    uint64_t cr2 = 0;
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr2, %0" : "=r"(cr2));

    paint_panic_bg();
    const char *name = (f->int_no < 32) ? exc_names[f->int_no] : "Hardware Exception";
    vram_str("EXCEPTION:", 28, 85, 0x00F87171, 2);
    vram_str(name, 160, 85, 0x00FFFFFF, 2);

    vram_hex("RIP: ", f->rip,      28, 130);
    vram_hex("ERR: ", f->err_code, 360, 130);
    vram_hex("CR2: ", cr2,         28, 160);
    vram_hex("RSP: ", f->rsp,      360, 160);

    vram_hex("RAX: ", f->rax,      28, 205);
    vram_hex("RBX: ", f->rbx,      360, 205);
    vram_hex("RCX: ", f->rcx,      28, 235);
    vram_hex("RDX: ", f->rdx,      360, 235);
    vram_hex("RSI: ", f->rsi,      28, 265);
    vram_hex("RDI: ", f->rdi,      360, 265);
    vram_hex("RBP: ", f->rbp,      28, 295);
    vram_hex("RFL: ", f->rflags,   360, 295);

    halt_with_reboot();
}

    __asm__ volatile (

        "push %rbx\n\t"
        "push %rcx\n\t"
        "push %rdx\n\t"
        "push %rsi\n\t"
        "push %rdi\n\t"
        "push %rbp\n\t"
        "push %r8\n\t"
        "push %r9\n\t"
        "push %r10\n\t"
        "push %r11\n\t"
        "push %r12\n\t"
        "push %r13\n\t"
        "push %r14\n\t"
        "push %r15\n\t"
        "mov %rsp, %rcx\n\t"
        "sub $32, %rsp\n\t"
        "call panic_exception_handler\n\t"
        "hlt\n\t"
    );
}

ISR_NOERR(28) ISR_ERR(29)   ISR_ERR(30)   ISR_NOERR(31)

static void set_idt_gate(int n, void (*handler)(void), uint16_t cs) {
    uint64_t addr = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)handler;
    idt[n].offset_low  = (uint16_t)(addr & 0xFFFF);
    idt[n].selector    = cs;
    idt[n].ist         = 0;
    idt[n].type_attr   = 0x8E;
    idt[n].offset_mid  = (uint16_t)((addr >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
    idt[n].offset_high = (uint32_t)((addr >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF);
    idt[n].zero        = 0;
}

void panic_init(BootInfo *info) {
    p_info = info;
    uint16_t cs = 0;
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cs, %0" : "=r"(cs));

    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, $0x21" : : "a"((uint8_t)0xFF));
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, $0xA1" : : "a"((uint8_t)0xFF));

    void (*handlers[32])(void) = {
        isr_0, isr_1, isr_2, isr_3, isr_4, isr_5, isr_6, isr_7,
        isr_8, isr_9, isr_10, isr_11, isr_12, isr_13, isr_14, isr_15,
        isr_16, isr_17, isr_18, isr_19, isr_20, isr_21, isr_22, isr_23,
        isr_24, isr_25, isr_26, isr_27, isr_28, isr_29, isr_30, isr_31
    };

        __asm__ volatile ("jmp 1f\n\t isr_ignore:\n\t iretq\n\t 1:\n\t");
    extern void isr_ignore(void);
    for (int i = 32; i < 256; i++) {
        set_idt_gate(i, isr_ignore, cs);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        set_idt_gate(i, handlers[i], cs);
    }

    IdtPtr idtr;
    idtr.limit = sizeof(idt) - 1;
    idtr.base  = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&idt[0];
    __asm__ volatile ("lidt %0" : : "m"(idtr));
}

import struct

data = open('build/bios_kernel.elf', 'rb').read()
(pe_off,) = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, 0x3C)
(num_sec,) = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, pe_off + 6)
(opt_sz,) = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, pe_off + 20)
sec_off = pe_off + 24 + opt_sz

max_end = 0
sections = []
for i in range(num_sec):
    s = sec_off + i * 40
    name = data[s:s+8].rstrip(b'\x00').decode('ascii', errors='ignore')
    vsize, vaddr, raw_sz, raw_ptr = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', data, s + 8)
    if name in ('.text', '.rodata', '.rdata', '.data'):
        sections.append((name, vaddr, raw_sz, raw_ptr))
        if vaddr + raw_sz > max_end:
            max_end = vaddr + raw_sz

base_vaddr = min(vaddr for _, vaddr, _, _ in sections)
flat = bytearray(max_end - base_vaddr)
for name, vaddr, raw_sz, raw_ptr in sections:
    off = vaddr - base_vaddr
    flat[off:off + raw_sz] = data[raw_ptr:raw_ptr + raw_sz]

open('build/bios_kernel.bin', 'wb').write(flat)
print(f"[PACK] Built flat kernel ({len(flat)} bytes)")

import os, struct

chunks = max(1, (ksize + 32767) // 32768)
with open("build/bios_boot.bin", "r+b") as bf:
    bf.seek(2)
    bf.write(struct.pack("<H", chunks))
print(f"[PATCH] Bootloader configured for {chunks} x 32KB chunks ({chunks * 32} KB)")


========== FILE: ./user/bench_r3.c ==========

#include "usyscall.h"

static void print_str(const char *s) {
    size_t n = 0;
    while (s[n]) n++;
    sys_write(s, n);
}

static void print_u64(uint64_t v) {
    char buf[24];
    int i = 0;
    if (v == 0) { buf[i++] = '0'; }
    while (v > 0) { buf[i++] = (char)('0' + (v % 10)); v /= 10; }
    while (i > 0) { char c = buf[--i]; sys_write(&c, 1); }
}

__attribute__((section(".text._start")))
void _start(void) {
    print_str("=== sonionOS 1-Second Max Syscall Throughput (Ring 3, CPL = ");
    print_u64(get_current_cpl());
    print_str(") ===\n\n");

    /* 1. Standard 1-by-1 SYSCALLs in 1 exact RTC second */
    print_str("Aligning to RTC second edge...\n");
    int64_t t0 = syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0);
    while (syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0) == t0) {}

    int64_t t_start = syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0);
    uint64_t c0 = u_rdtsc();
    uint64_t count = 0;

    while (syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0) == t_start) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
            syscall3(SYS_TELL, 0, 0, 0);
        }
        count += 1000;
    }
    uint64_t c1 = u_rdtsc();
    uint64_t total_cycles = c1 - c0;

    print_str("\n[1] Standard 1-by-1 SYSCALLs / sec : ");
    print_u64(count);
    print_str(" syscalls/sec\n");
    print_str("    Avg Cycles per SYSCALL         : ");
    print_u64(count ? (total_cycles / count) : 0);
    print_str(" cycles\n");
    print_str("    Avg Latency per SYSCALL        : ");
    print_u64(count ? (1000000000ULL / count) : 0);
    print_str(" ns\n\n");

    /* 2. Batched SYS_BATCH (io_uring-style, 256 ops/batch) in 1 exact RTC second */
    uint64_t ops[256][4];
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        ops[i][0] = SYS_TELL;
        ops[i][1] = 0;
        ops[i][2] = 0;
        ops[i][3] = 0;
    }

    t0 = syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0);
    while (syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0) == t0) {}

    t_start = syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0);
    uint64_t batch_ops = 0;
    while (syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0) == t_start) {
        sys_batch(ops, 256);
        batch_ops += 256;
    }

    print_str("[2] Batched SYS_BATCH Ops / sec    : ");
    print_u64(batch_ops);
    print_str(" ops/sec\n");
    print_str("    Avg Latency per Batched Op     : ");
    print_u64(batch_ops ? (1000000000ULL / batch_ops) : 0);
    print_str(" ns\n\n");

    sys_exit(0);
}

#include "usyscall.h"

__attribute__((section(".text._start")))
void _start(void) {
    const char msg[] = "[CRASH.BIN] Attempting illegal write to Ring 0 kernel RAM (0x00100000)...\n";
    sys_write(msg, sizeof(msg) - 1);

    /* 0x00100000 is Ring 0 Supervisor-Only in paging.c -> triggers CPU #PF! */
    volatile uint64_t *kernel_mem = (volatile uint64_t *)0x00100000ULL;
    *kernel_mem = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEULL;

    sys_exit(0);
}

========== FILE: ./user/init.c ==========

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <ctype.h>
#include <time.h>
#include "usyscall.h"
#include "lua_runner.h"

static char cwd[256] = "/";

static void resolve_path(const char *in, char *out, size_t out_sz) {
    char tmp[256];
    if (!in || !*in) {
        strncpy(out, cwd, out_sz - 1);
        out[out_sz - 1] = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (in[0] == '/' || in[0] == '\\') strncpy(tmp, in, sizeof(tmp) - 1);
    else if (strcmp(cwd, "/") == 0) snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "/%s", in);
    else snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s/%s", cwd, in);
    tmp[255] = 0;

    char *parts[32];
    int depth = 0;
    char *p = tmp;
    while (*p) {
        while (*p == '/' || *p == '\\') *p++ = 0;
        if (!*p) break;
        char *tok = p;
        while (*p && *p != '/' && *p != '\\') p++;
        if (*p) *p++ = 0;
        if (strcmp(tok, ".") == 0) continue;
        if (strcmp(tok, "..") == 0) { if (depth > 0) depth--; continue; }
        if (depth < 32) parts[depth++] = tok;
    }
    if (depth == 0) { strncpy(out, "/", out_sz); return; }
    out[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
        strncat(out, "/", out_sz - strlen(out) - 1);
        strncat(out, parts[i], out_sz - strlen(out) - 1);
    }
}

static void cmd_ls(const char *arg) {
    char target[256];
    resolve_path(arg, target, sizeof(target));
    int dd = sys_opendir(target);
    if (dd < 0) { printf("ls: cannot access '%s'\n", arg ? arg : cwd); return; }
    UserDirEntry ent;
    while (sys_readdir(dd, &ent)) {
        if (ent.is_dir) printf("drwxr-xr-x  %10s  %s/\n", "-", ent.name);
        else printf("-rw-r--r--  %10u  %s\n", ent.size, ent.name);
    }
    sys_closedir(dd);
}

static void print_tree(const char *path, int depth) {
    int dd = sys_opendir(path);
    if (dd < 0) return;
    UserDirEntry ent;
    while (sys_readdir(dd, &ent)) {
        if (!strcmp(ent.name, ".") || !strcmp(ent.name, "..")) continue;
        for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) printf("  ");
        printf("|-- %s%s\n", ent.name, ent.is_dir ? "/" : "");
        if (ent.is_dir && depth < 6) {
            char sub[256];
            if (!strcmp(path, "/")) snprintf(sub, sizeof(sub), "/%s", ent.name);
            else snprintf(sub, sizeof(sub), "%s/%s", path, ent.name);
            print_tree(sub, depth + 1);
        }
    }
    sys_closedir(dd);
}

static int copy_file(const char *a, const char *b) {
    char src[256], dst[256];
    resolve_path(a, src, sizeof(src));
    resolve_path(b, dst, sizeof(dst));
    FILE *in = fopen(src, "rb");
    if (!in) return -1;
    FILE *out = fopen(dst, "wb");
    if (!out) { fclose(in); return -1; }
    uint8_t buf[512]; size_t n;
    while ((n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), in)) > 0) fwrite(buf, 1, n, out);
    fclose(in); fclose(out);
    return 0;
}
static void shell_exec(char *cmdline) {
    size_t len = strlen(cmdline);
    while (len > 0 && (cmdline[len - 1] == '\n' || cmdline[len - 1] == '\r')) {
        cmdline[--len] = 0;
    }
    while (*cmdline == ' ') cmdline++;
    if (!*cmdline) return;

    char cmd[32]; int i = 0;
    while (cmdline[i] && !isspace((unsigned char)cmdline[i]) && i < 31) {
        cmd[i] = cmdline[i]; i++;
    }
    cmd[i] = 0;
    const char *args = cmdline + i;
    while (*args == ' ') args++;

    if (!strcmp(cmd, "help")) {
        printf("User-Mode (Ring 3) Linux Shell Commands:\n");
        printf("  ls [dir]        cd <dir>        pwd             tree\n");
        printf("  mkdir <dir>     rmdir <dir>     touch <file>    rm <file>\n");
        printf("  cat <file>      cp <src> <dst>  mv <src> <dst>  wc <file>\n");
        printf("  echo <txt> [>|>> file]          clear           uname\n");
        printf("  date            uptime          df              cpl\n");
        printf("  lua <file.lua>  exec <app.bin>  reboot          poweroff\n");
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "cpl")) {
        uint16_t cpl = get_current_cpl();
        printf("Current CPU Privilege Level: Ring %u (CPL = %u)\n", cpl, cpl);
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "pwd")) {
        printf("%s\n", cwd);
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "cd")) {
        char target[256];
        resolve_path(*args ? args : "/", target, sizeof(target));
        if (!strcmp(target, "/")) { strcpy(cwd, "/"); return; }
        int dd = sys_opendir(target);
        if (dd < 0) { printf("cd: %s: No such directory\n", args); return; }
        sys_closedir(dd);
        strcpy(cwd, target);
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "ls")) {
        cmd_ls(args);
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "tree")) {
        char target[256]; resolve_path(args, target, sizeof(target));
        printf("%s\n", target); print_tree(target, 0);
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "mkdir")) {
        if (!*args) printf("mkdir: missing operand\n");
        else {
            char t[256]; resolve_path(args, t, sizeof(t));
            if (sys_mkdir(t) != 0) printf("mkdir: failed\n");
        }
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "rmdir") || !strcmp(cmd, "rm")) {
        if (!*args) printf("%s: missing operand\n", cmd);
        else {
            char t[256]; resolve_path(args, t, sizeof(t));
            if (remove(t) != 0) printf("%s: failed\n", cmd);
        }
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "touch")) {
        if (!*args) printf("touch: missing operand\n");
        else {
            char t[256]; resolve_path(args, t, sizeof(t));
            FILE *f = fopen(t, "a");
            if (f) fclose(f); else perror("touch");
        }
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "cat")) {
        if (!*args) printf("cat: missing operand\n");
        else {
            char t[256]; resolve_path(args, t, sizeof(t));
            FILE *f = fopen(t, "r");
            if (!f) { printf("cat: %s: No such file\n", args); return; }
            char b[256]; while (fgets(b, sizeof(b), f)) printf("%s", b);
            fclose(f);
        }
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "cp")) {
        char a[128], b[128];
        if (sscanf(args, "%127s %127s", a, b) == 2) {
            if (copy_file(a, b) != 0) printf("cp: failed\n");
        } else printf("Usage: cp <src> <dst>\n");
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "mv")) {
        char a[128], b[128];
        if (sscanf(args, "%127s %127s", a, b) == 2) {
            char s[256]; resolve_path(a, s, sizeof(s));
            if (copy_file(a, b) == 0) remove(s); else printf("mv: failed\n");
        } else printf("Usage: mv <src> <dst>\n");
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "wc")) {
        char t[256]; resolve_path(args, t, sizeof(t));
        FILE *f = fopen(t, "rb");
        if (!f) { printf("wc: cannot open '%s'\n", args); return; }
        int c, l = 0, w = 0, by = 0, iw = 0;
        while ((c = fgetc(f)) != EOF) {
            by++; if (c == '\n') l++;
            if (isspace(c)) iw = 0; else if (!iw) { iw = 1; w++; }
        }
        fclose(f); printf(" %d %d %d %s\n", l, w, by, args);
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "echo")) {
        const char *r = strstr(args, ">>"); int app = 1;
        if (!r) { r = strchr(args, '>'); app = 0; }
        if (!r) { printf("%s\n", args); return; }
        char txt[256]; size_t tl = (size_t)(r - args);
        while (tl > 0 && args[tl - 1] == ' ') tl--;
        if (tl >= sizeof(txt)) tl = sizeof(txt) - 1;
        memcpy(txt, args, tl); txt[tl] = 0;
        const char *fn = r + (app ? 2 : 1); while (*fn == ' ') fn++;
        char t[256]; resolve_path(fn, t, sizeof(t));
        FILE *f = fopen(t, app ? "a" : "w");
        if (f) { fprintf(f, "%s\n", txt); fclose(f); } else perror("echo");
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "clear")) {
        sys_clear();
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "uname")) {
        printf(!strcmp(args, "-a") ? "sonionOS 0.1.0-x86_64 UserMode\n"
                                   : "sonionOS\n");
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "date")) {
        time_t now = time(0); printf("%s", ctime(&now));
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "uptime")) {
        long long s = (long long)clock() / 1000;
        printf("up %lld min, %lld sec\n", s / 60, s % 60);
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "df")) {
        uint64_t di[8]; sys_disk_info(di);
        uint64_t mb = (di[0] * 512ULL) / (1024ULL * 1024ULL);
        printf("Driver: %s | FS: %s (%s) | Size: %llu MB\n",
               (char *)(di + 2), di[1] ? "MOUNTED" : "NONE",
               (char *)(di + 4), (unsigned long long)mb);
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "lua")) {
        if (!*args) printf("Usage: lua <script.lua>\n");
        else {
            char t[256]; resolve_path(args, t, sizeof(t));
            lua_run_file(t);
        }
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "exec")) {
        if (!*args) printf("Usage: exec <program.bin>\n");
        else {
            char t[256]; resolve_path(args, t, sizeof(t));
            int rc = sys_exec(t);
            printf("[Child Ring 3 exited: %d]\n", rc);
        }
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "reboot")) {
        printf("Rebooting...\n"); sys_reboot();
    } else if (!strcmp(cmd, "poweroff") || !strcmp(cmd, "shutdown")) {
        sys_poweroff();
    } else {
        printf("%s: command not found\n", cmd);
    }
}

__attribute__((section(".text._start")))
void _start(void) {
    uint64_t di[8];
    sys_disk_info(di);
    printf("[USER] Ring 3 Shell + Lua 5.5.1 Active (CPL = %u)\n",
           get_current_cpl());
    printf("[DISK] %s | [FS] %s (%s)\n", (char *)(di + 2),
           di[1] ? "MOUNTED" : "NONE", (char *)(di + 4));
    printf("Type 'help' for commands ('cpl', 'lua hello.lua').\n\n");

    char line[256];
    while (1) {
        printf("root@sonionOS:%s# ", cwd);
        if (!fgets(line, sizeof(line), stdin)) break;
        shell_exec(line);
    }
    sys_exit(0);
}
