static void u_putc_con(char c) { sys_write(&c, 1); }

FILE *fopen(const char *filename, const char *mode) {
    if (!filename || !mode) { errno = EINVAL; return 0; }
    int fd = sys_open(filename, mode);
    if (fd < 0) { errno = ENOENT; return 0; }
    for (int i = 0; i < FOPEN_MAX; i++) {
        if (!file_table[i].in_use) {
            FILE *f = &file_table[i];
            memset(f, 0, sizeof(FILE));
            f->in_use   = 1;
            f->kind     = 1;
            f->handle   = (void *)(intptr_t)(fd + 1);
            f->unget_ch = -1;
            f->readable = (strchr(mode, 'r') != 0 || strchr(mode, '+') != 0);
            f->writable = (strchr(mode, 'w') != 0 || strchr(mode, 'a') != 0 || strchr(mode, '+') != 0);
            return f;
        }
    }
    sys_close(fd);
    errno = EMFILE;
    return 0;
}

FILE *freopen(const char *filename, const char *mode, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream) return fopen(filename, mode);
    if (stream->kind == 1 && stream->handle) sys_close((int)(intptr_t)stream->handle - 1);
    int fd = sys_open(filename, mode);
    if (fd < 0) { stream->in_use = 0; return 0; }
    stream->in_use = 1; stream->kind = 1; stream->handle = (void *)(intptr_t)(fd + 1);
    stream->eof = 0; stream->err = 0; stream->unget_ch = -1;
    return stream;
}

int fclose(FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use) return EOF;
    if (stream->kind == 1 && stream->handle) {
        sys_close((int)(intptr_t)stream->handle - 1);
        stream->handle = 0;
        stream->in_use = 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

size_t fread(void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use || !ptr || !size || !nmemb) return 0;
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)ptr;
    size_t want = size * nmemb, extra = 0;
    if (stream->kind == 0) {
        while (extra < want) {
            int ch = fgetc(stream);
            if (ch == EOF) break;
            dst[extra++] = (uint8_t)ch;
        }
        return extra / size;
    }
    if (stream->unget_ch >= 0 && want > 0) {
        *dst++ = (uint8_t)stream->unget_ch;
        stream->unget_ch = -1;
        want--; extra = 1;
    }
    int fd = (int)(intptr_t)stream->handle - 1;
    int64_t r = sys_read(fd, dst, want);
    if (r < 0) r = 0;
    if ((size_t)r + extra < size * nmemb) stream->eof = 1;
    return ((size_t)r + extra) / size;
}

size_t fwrite(const void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use || !ptr || !size || !nmemb) return 0;
    if (stream->kind == 0) { sys_write((const char *)ptr, size * nmemb); return nmemb; }
    int fd = (int)(intptr_t)stream->handle - 1;
    int64_t w = sys_fwrite(fd, ptr, size * nmemb);
    return (w > 0) ? ((size_t)w / size) : 0;
}

int fgetc(FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use) return EOF;
    if (stream->unget_ch >= 0) { int c = stream->unget_ch; stream->unget_ch = -1; return c; }
    if (stream->kind == 0) {
        static char in_buf[512];
        static int in_len = 0, in_pos = 0;
        while (in_pos >= in_len) {
            in_len = 0; in_pos = 0;
            while (1) {
                int c = sys_getchar(1);
                if (c < 0) { if (in_len == 0) { stream->eof = 1; return EOF; } break; }
                if (c == '\r' || c == '\n') { u_putc_con('\n'); if (in_len < 511) in_buf[in_len++] = '\n'; break; }
                if (c == '\b' || c == 127) { if (in_len > 0) { in_len--; u_putc_con('\b'); } continue; }
                if (c >= 32 && c <= 126 && in_len < 510) { in_buf[in_len++] = (char)c; u_putc_con((char)c); }
            }
        }
        return (unsigned char)in_buf[in_pos++];
    }
    uint8_t b = 0;
    int fd = (int)(intptr_t)stream->handle - 1;
    if (sys_read(fd, &b, 1) != 1) { stream->eof = 1; return EOF; }
    return (int)b;
}

time_t mktime(struct tm *tm) {
    if (!tm) return (time_t)-1;
    int year = tm->tm_year + 1900, mon = tm->tm_mon;
    while (mon < 0) { mon += 12; year--; }
    while (mon >= 12) { mon -= 12; year++; }
    int64_t days = 0;
    for (int y = 1970; y < year; y++) days += is_leap(y) ? 366 : 365;
    for (int y = year; y < 1970; y++) days -= is_leap(y) ? 366 : 365;
    int yday = 0;
    for (int m = 0; m < mon; m++) yday += mdays[m] + ((m == 1 && is_leap(year)) ? 1 : 0);
    yday += (tm->tm_mday - 1);
    days += yday;
    tm->tm_yday = yday;
    int wday = (int)((days + 4) % 7);
    tm->tm_wday = (wday < 0) ? (wday + 7) : wday;
    return (time_t)(days * 86400LL + tm->tm_hour * 3600LL + tm->tm_min * 60LL + tm->tm_sec);
}

time_t time(time_t *timer) {
    time_t ep = (time_t)sys_time();
    if (timer) *timer = ep;
    return ep;
}
static struct tm static_tm;

struct tm *gmtime(const time_t *timer) {
    if (!timer) return 0;
    int64_t t = *timer;
    int64_t days = t / 86400LL;
    int64_t rem  = t % 86400LL;
    if (rem < 0) { rem += 86400LL; days--; }

    static_tm.tm_hour = (int)(rem / 3600);
    static_tm.tm_min  = (int)((rem % 3600) / 60);
    static_tm.tm_sec  = (int)(rem % 60);

    int wday = (int)((days + 4) % 7);
    if (wday < 0) wday += 7;
    static_tm.tm_wday = wday;

    int year = 1970;
    while (days >= (is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365)) {
        days -= is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365;
        year++;
    }
    while (days < 0) {
        year--;
        days += is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365;
    }
    static_tm.tm_year = year - 1900;
    static_tm.tm_yday = (int)days;

    int mon = 0;
    while (mon < 11) {
        int d = mdays[mon] + ((mon == 1 && is_leap(year)) ? 1 : 0);
        if (days < d) break;
        days -= d;
        mon++;
    }
    static_tm.tm_mon  = mon;
    static_tm.tm_mday = (int)days + 1;
    static_tm.tm_isdst = 0;
    return &static_tm;
}

struct tm *localtime(const time_t *timer) { return gmtime(timer); }

char *asctime(const struct tm *tm) {
    static const char *wname[7]  = { "Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat" };
    static const char *mname[12] = { "Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
                                       "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec" };
    static char buf[32];
    if (!tm) return 0;
    int w = (tm->tm_wday >= 0 && tm->tm_wday < 7) ? tm->tm_wday : 0;
    int m = (tm->tm_mon >= 0 && tm->tm_mon < 12) ? tm->tm_mon : 0;
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s %s %2d %02d:%02d:%02d %d\n",
             wname[w], mname[m], tm->tm_mday,
             tm->tm_hour, tm->tm_min, tm->tm_sec, tm->tm_year + 1900);
    return buf;
}

char *ctime(const time_t *timer) { return asctime(localtime(timer)); }

size_t strftime(char *s, size_t maxsize, const char *fmt, const struct tm *tm) {
    if (!s || maxsize == 0 || !fmt || !tm) return 0;
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (*fmt && pos + 1 < maxsize) {
        if (*fmt != '%') { s[pos++] = *fmt++; continue; }
        fmt++;
        char tmp[32]; tmp[0] = 0;
        if (*fmt == 'Y') snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%04d", tm->tm_year + 1900);
        else if (*fmt == 'm') snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%02d", tm->tm_mon + 1);
        else if (*fmt == 'd') snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%02d", tm->tm_mday);
        else if (*fmt == 'H') snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%02d", tm->tm_hour);
        else if (*fmt == 'M') snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%02d", tm->tm_min);
        else if (*fmt == 'S') snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%02d", tm->tm_sec);
        else if (*fmt == '%') { tmp[0] = '%'; tmp[1] = 0; }
        if (*fmt) fmt++;
        for (int i = 0; tmp[i] && pos + 1 < maxsize; i++) s[pos++] = tmp[i];
    }
    s[pos] = 0;
    return pos;
}

static inline int64_t syscall3(uint64_t n, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2, uint64_t a3) {
    int64_t ret;
    __asm__ volatile (
        "syscall"
        : "=a"(ret)
        : "a"(n), "D"(a1), "S"(a2), "d"(a3)
        : "rcx", "r11", "memory"
    );
    return ret;
}

static inline uint64_t u_rdtsc(void) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdtsc" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi));
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static inline int64_t sys_clock(void) {
    const volatile SonionSysInfo *si = (const volatile SonionSysInfo *)(uintptr_t)SYSINFO_PAGE_ADDR;
    if (si->magic == SYSINFO_MAGIC && si->tsc_per_ms > 0) {
        return (int64_t)((u_rdtsc() - si->boot_tsc) / si->tsc_per_ms);
    }
    return syscall3(SYS_CLOCK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static inline int64_t sys_time(void) {
    const volatile SonionSysInfo *si = (const volatile SonionSysInfo *)(uintptr_t)SYSINFO_PAGE_ADDR;
    if (si->magic == SYSINFO_MAGIC && si->tsc_per_ms > 0) {
        uint64_t ms = (u_rdtsc() - si->boot_tsc) / si->tsc_per_ms;
        return (int64_t)(si->unix_base + (ms / 1000ULL));
    }
    return syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0);
}
static inline void sys_reboot(void) { syscall3(SYS_REBOOT, 0, 0, 0); }
static inline void sys_poweroff(void) { syscall3(SYS_POWEROFF, 0, 0, 0); }
static inline void sys_disk_info(uint64_t *buf) { syscall3(SYS_DISK_INFO, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)buf, 0, 0); }
static inline int64_t sys_batch(void *ops, uint64_t count) { return syscall3(SYS_BATCH, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ops, count, 0); }
static inline int  sys_exec(const char *p) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_EXEC, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p, 0, 0); }

static inline uint16_t get_current_cpl(void) {
    uint16_t cs;
    __asm__ volatile ("movw %%cs, %0" : "=r"(cs));
    return cs & 3;
}

#include <stdint.h>
#include "bootinfo.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t attributes;
    uint8_t  window_a, window_b;
    uint16_t granularity, window_size, segment_a, segment_b;
    uint32_t win_func_ptr;
    uint16_t pitch;
    uint16_t width;
    uint16_t height;
    uint8_t  w_char, y_char, planes, bpp, banks, memory_model, bank_size, image_pages, reserved0;
    uint8_t  red_mask, red_pos, green_mask, green_pos, blue_mask, blue_pos, rsvd_mask, rsvd_pos, direct_color;
    uint32_t framebuffer;
} VesaModeInfo;

static inline uint8_t inb(uint16_t port) {
    uint8_t ret;
    __asm__ volatile ("inb %1, %0" : "=a"(ret) : "Nd"(port));
    return ret;
}

static inline void outb(uint16_t port, uint8_t val) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"(val), "Nd"(port));
}

static inline uint64_t rdtsc(void) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdtsc" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi));
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static const char scancode_ascii[128] = {
    0,  27, '1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9','0','-','=','\b',
    '\t','q','w','e','r','t','y','u','i','o','p',0x5B,0x5D,'\r',
    0,  'a','s','d','f','g','h','j','k','l',';','\'',0x60, 0,
    '\\','z','x','c','v','b','n','m',',','.','/', 0, '*', 0, ' '
};

static uint64_t tsc_ticks_per_ms = 2000000;

static void calibrate_tsc(void) {
    uint8_t gate = inb(0x61) & 0xFC;
    outb(0x61, gate);
    outb(0x43, 0xB0);
    outb(0x42, 0x9C);
    outb(0x42, 0x2E);
    outb(0x61, gate | 1);

    uint64_t t0 = rdtsc();
    uint32_t guard = 0;
    while (!(inb(0x61) & 0x20) && ++guard < 10000000);
    uint64_t t1 = rdtsc();

    if (guard < 10000000 && t1 > t0) tsc_ticks_per_ms = (t1 - t0) / 10;
}

static int32_t ps2_mx = 400, ps2_my = 300;
static uint8_t ps2_mbtn = 0, ps2_mcycle = 0;
static uint8_t ps2_mpkt[3];

static void ps2_wait_write(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 100000; i++) if (!(inb(0x64) & 2)) return;
}
static void ps2_wait_read(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 100000; i++) if (inb(0x64) & 1) return;
}
static void ps2_mouse_init(void) {
    ps2_wait_write(); outb(0x64, 0xA8);
    ps2_wait_write(); outb(0x64, 0x20);
    ps2_wait_read();  uint8_t st = (inb(0x60) | 2) & ~0x20;
    ps2_wait_write(); outb(0x64, 0x60);
    ps2_wait_write(); outb(0x60, st);
    ps2_wait_write(); outb(0x64, 0xD4);
    ps2_wait_write(); outb(0x60, 0xF6);
    ps2_wait_read();  (void)inb(0x60);
    ps2_wait_write(); outb(0x64, 0xD4);
    ps2_wait_write(); outb(0x60, 0xF4);
    ps2_wait_read();  (void)inb(0x60);
}
void bios_poll_input(InputState *state) {
    state->key_char = 0;
    state->scan_code = 0;
    while (inb(0x64) & 1) {
        uint8_t status = inb(0x64);
        uint8_t data   = inb(0x60);
        if (status & 0x20) {
            if (ps2_mcycle == 0 && !(data & 0x08)) continue;
            ps2_mpkt[ps2_mcycle++] = data;
            if (ps2_mcycle == 3) {
                ps2_mcycle = 0;
                ps2_mbtn = ps2_mpkt[0] & 0x07;
                int32_t dx = (int32_t)ps2_mpkt[1] - ((ps2_mpkt[0] & 0x10) ? 256 : 0);
                int32_t dy = (int32_t)ps2_mpkt[2] - ((ps2_mpkt[0] & 0x20) ? 256 : 0);
                ps2_mx += dx; ps2_my -= dy;
                if (ps2_mx < 0) ps2_mx = 0; if (ps2_mx > 799) ps2_mx = 799;
                if (ps2_my < 0) ps2_my = 0; if (ps2_my > 599) ps2_my = 599;
            }
        } else if (!(data & 0x80)) {
            if (data == 0x01) state->scan_code = 0x17;
            else if (data < 128) state->key_char = scancode_ascii[data];
        }
    }
    state->mouse_x = ps2_mx;
    state->mouse_y = ps2_my;
    state->left_click = (ps2_mbtn & 1) ? 1 : 0;
}

void bios_sleep_ms(uint32_t ms) {
    uint64_t target = rdtsc() + (uint64_t)ms * tsc_ticks_per_ms;
    while (rdtsc() < target) {
        __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    }
}

void bios_reboot(void) {
    while (inb(0x64) & 0x02);
    outb(0x64, 0xFE);
    while (1) __asm__("hlt");
}

void bios_shutdown(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outw %0, %1" : : "a"((uint16_t)0x2000), "Nd"((uint16_t)0x604));
    while (1) __asm__("hlt");
}

__attribute__((section(".text.entry")))
void bios_entry(VesaModeInfo *vesa) {
    calibrate_tsc();
    ps2_mouse_init();

    BootInfo info;
    info.framebuffer = (uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)vesa->framebuffer;
    info.width       = vesa->width  ? vesa->width  : 800;
    info.height      = vesa->height ? vesa->height : 600;
    info.pitch       = vesa->pitch  ? (vesa->pitch / 4) : info.width;
    info.poll_input  = bios_poll_input;
    info.sleep_ms    = bios_sleep_ms;
    info.reboot      = bios_reboot;
    info.shutdown    = bios_shutdown;

    kernel_main(&info);
    while (1) __asm__("hlt");
}



uint32_t g_mouse_dbg = 0;

FILE: ./boot/bios/boot.asm

[bits 16]
[org 0x7C00]

jmp short start
kernel_chunks: dw 8

start:
    cli
    xor ax, ax
    mov ds, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov ss, ax
    mov sp, 0x7C00
    mov [boot_drive], dl

    mov cx, [kernel_chunks]
.read_loop:
    push cx
    mov si, dap
    mov ah, 0x42
    mov dl, [boot_drive]
    int 0x13
    jc disk_err
    add word [dap + 6], 0x0800
    add dword [dap + 8], 64
    pop cx
    loop .read_loop

    xor ax, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov di, 0x9000
    mov ax, 0x4F01
    mov cx, 0x4143
    int 0x10

    mov ax, 0x4F02
    mov bx, 0x4143
    int 0x10

    in al, 0x92
    or al, 2
    out 0x92, al

    lgdt [gdt32_desc]
    mov eax, cr0
    or eax, 1
    mov cr0, eax
    jmp dword 0x08:pm32_entry

disk_err:
    mov ax, 0x0E45
    int 0x10
    cli
    hlt

[bits 32]
pm32_entry:
    mov ax, 0x10
    mov ds, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov fs, ax
    mov gs, ax
    mov ss, ax
    mov esp, 0x90000
    jmp 0x10000

boot_drive: db 0
dap:
    db 0x10, 0
    dw 64, 0x0000, 0x1000
    dq 1

gdt32:
    dq 0
    dq 0x00CF9A000000FFFF
    dq 0x00CF92000000FFFF
gdt32_desc:
    dw gdt32_desc - gdt32 - 1
    dd gdt32

times 510 - ($ - $$) db 0
dw 0xAA55


================================================================================
FILE: ./boot/bios/entry64.asm
================================================================================

[bits 32]
section .text.trampoline
global _start32
extern bios_entry

_start32:
    ; Zero out 16 MB of .bss RAM (0x200000 -> 0x1200000) so backbuf & globals are 100% clean
    mov edi, 0x200000
    xor eax, eax
    mov ecx, 2162688
    rep stosd

    ; Build 64-Bit Identity Page Tables at 0x1000 (maps first 4 GB)
    mov edi, 0x1000
    xor eax, eax
    mov ecx, 8192
    rep stosd

    mov dword [0x1000], 0x2003
    mov dword [0x2000], 0x3003
    mov dword [0x2008], 0x4003
    mov dword [0x2010], 0x5003
    mov dword [0x2018], 0x6003

    mov edi, 0x3000
    mov eax, 0x00000083
    mov ecx, 2048
.map_loop:
    mov [edi], eax
    add eax, 0x200000
    add edi, 8
    loop .map_loop

    ; Enable FPU & SSE
    mov eax, cr0
    and ax, 0xFFFB
    or ax, 0x2
    mov cr0, eax

    mov eax, cr4
    or eax, (1 << 5) | (1 << 9) | (1 << 10)
    mov cr4, eax

    ; Enable Long Mode (EFER.LME) & Paging
    mov eax, 0x1000
    mov cr3, eax

    mov ecx, 0xC0000080
    rdmsr
    or eax, 1 << 8
    wrmsr

    mov eax, cr0
    or eax, 1 << 31
    mov cr0, eax

    lgdt [gdt64_desc]
    jmp dword 0x08:lm64_ready

[bits 64]
lm64_ready:
    mov ax, 0x10
    mov ss, ax
    mov ds, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov fs, ax
    mov gs, ax

    ; Place 16-byte aligned stack safely at 0x1800000 (24 MB, well above .bss!)
    mov rsp, 0x007F8000
    mov rcx, 0x9000
    mov rdi, 0x9000
    mov rax, bios_entry
    call rax

.halt:
    hlt
    jmp .halt

align 8
gdt64:
    dq 0
    dq 0x00209A0000000000
    dq 0x0000920000000000
gdt64_desc:
    dw gdt64_desc - gdt64 - 1
    dd gdt64

typedef struct { uint32_t MaxMode, Mode; EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_MODE_INFORMATION *Info; UINTN SizeOfInfo; uint64_t FrameBufferBase; UINTN FrameBufferSize; } EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL_MODE;
typedef struct _EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL { void* QueryMode; void* SetMode; void* Blt; EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL_MODE *Mode; } EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL;
typedef struct { EFI_TABLE_HEADER Hdr; void *f1,*f2,*f3,*f4,*f5,*f6,*f7,*f8,*f9,*f10,*f11,*f12,*f13,*f14,*f15,*f16,*f17; EFI_STATUS (*HandleProtocol)(EFI_HANDLE H, EFI_GUID *P, void **I); void *f19,*f20,*f21,*f22,*f23,*f24,*f25,*f26,*f27,*f28; EFI_STATUS (__attribute__((ms_abi)) *Stall)(UINTN Microseconds); void *f30; EFI_STATUS (*ConnectController)(EFI_HANDLE C, EFI_HANDLE *D, void *R, uint8_t Rec); void *f32,*f33,*f34,*f35; EFI_STATUS (*LocateHandleBuffer)(UINTN T, EFI_GUID *P, void *K, UINTN *N, EFI_HANDLE **B); void *f37; EFI_STATUS (__attribute__((ms_abi)) *LocateProtocol)(EFI_GUID *Protocol, void *Registration, void **Interface); } EFI_BOOT_SERVICES;
typedef struct { EFI_TABLE_HEADER Hdr; void *f1,*f2,*f3,*f4,*f5,*f6,*f7,*f8,*f9,*f10; void (__attribute__((ms_abi)) *ResetSystem)(int ResetType, EFI_STATUS ResetStatus, UINTN DataSize, void *ResetData); } EFI_RUNTIME_SERVICES;
typedef struct { EFI_TABLE_HEADER Hdr; CHAR16 *FirmwareVendor; uint32_t FirmwareRevision; EFI_HANDLE ConsoleInHandle; EFI_SIMPLE_TEXT_INPUT_PROTOCOL *ConIn; EFI_HANDLE ConsoleOutHandle; void* ConOut; EFI_HANDLE StandardErrorHandle; void* StdErr; EFI_RUNTIME_SERVICES *RuntimeServices; EFI_BOOT_SERVICES *BootServices; } EFI_SYSTEM_TABLE;

static EFI_SYSTEM_TABLE *g_st = 0;
static EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *g_mice[8];
static int g_num_mice = 0;

typedef struct { uint64_t CurrentX, CurrentY, CurrentZ; uint32_t ActiveButtons; } EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_STATE;
typedef struct { uint64_t AbsoluteMinX, AbsoluteMinY, AbsoluteMinZ, AbsoluteMaxX, AbsoluteMaxY, AbsoluteMaxZ, Attributes; } EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_MODE;
typedef struct _EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_PROTOCOL { EFI_STATUS (*Reset)(struct _EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *This, uint8_t Ext); EFI_STATUS (*GetState)(struct _EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *This, EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_STATE *State); void* WaitForInput; EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_MODE *Mode; } EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_PROTOCOL;
static EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *g_abs_mice[8];
static int g_num_abs = 0;
uint32_t g_mouse_dbg = 0;
static int cur_mx = 400, cur_my = 300, max_w = 800, max_h = 600;

static uint8_t uefi_mbtn = 0, uefi_mcycle = 0;
static uint8_t uefi_mpkt[3];

static inline uint8_t u_inb(uint16_t p) {
    uint8_t r; __asm__ volatile ("inb %1, %0" : "=a"(r) : "Nd"(p)); return r;
}
static inline void u_outb(uint16_t p, uint8_t v) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"(v), "Nd"(p));
}
static void u_ps2_wait_w(void) { for (int i = 0; i < 100000; i++) if (!(u_inb(0x64) & 2)) return; }
static void u_ps2_wait_r(void) { for (int i = 0; i < 100000; i++) if (u_inb(0x64) & 1) return; }
static void u_ps2_mouse_init(void) {
    u_ps2_wait_w(); u_outb(0x64, 0xA8);
    u_ps2_wait_w(); u_outb(0x64, 0x20);
    u_ps2_wait_r(); uint8_t st = (u_inb(0x60) | 2) & ~0x20;
    u_ps2_wait_w(); u_outb(0x64, 0x60);
    u_ps2_wait_w(); u_outb(0x60, st);
    u_ps2_wait_w(); u_outb(0x64, 0xD4);
    u_ps2_wait_w(); u_outb(0x60, 0xF6);
    u_ps2_wait_r(); (void)u_inb(0x60);
    u_ps2_wait_w(); u_outb(0x64, 0xD4);
    u_ps2_wait_w(); u_outb(0x60, 0xF4);
    u_ps2_wait_r(); (void)u_inb(0x60);
}
void uefi_poll_input(InputState *state) {
    state->key_char = 0;
    state->scan_code = 0;
    state->left_click = 0;

    while (u_inb(0x64) & 1) {
        uint8_t status = u_inb(0x64);
        if (!(status & 0x20)) break; /* leave keyboard byte for UEFI ConIn! */
        uint8_t data = u_inb(0x60);
        if (uefi_mcycle == 0 && !(data & 0x08)) continue;
        uefi_mpkt[uefi_mcycle++] = data;
        if (uefi_mcycle == 3) {
            uefi_mcycle = 0;
            uefi_mbtn = uefi_mpkt[0] & 0x07;
            int32_t dx = (int32_t)uefi_mpkt[1] - ((uefi_mpkt[0] & 0x10) ? 256 : 0);
            int32_t dy = (int32_t)uefi_mpkt[2] - ((uefi_mpkt[0] & 0x20) ? 256 : 0);
            cur_mx += dx; cur_my -= dy;
            if (cur_mx < 0) cur_mx = 0; if (cur_mx >= max_w) cur_mx = max_w - 1;
            if (cur_my < 0) cur_my = 0; if (cur_my >= max_h) cur_my = max_h - 1;
        }
    }
    if (uefi_mbtn & 1) state->left_click = 1;
    EFI_INPUT_KEY key;
    if (g_st->ConIn->ReadKeyStroke(g_st->ConIn, &key) == 0) {
        state->key_char = (char)key.UnicodeChar;
        state->scan_code = key.ScanCode;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < g_num_abs; i++) {
        EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *ap = g_abs_mice[i];
        EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_STATE as;
        EFI_STATUS st_a = (ap && ap->Mode) ? ap->GetState(ap, &as) : 99; g_mouse_dbg = ((uint32_t)g_num_abs << 24) | ((uint32_t)g_num_mice << 16) | ((uint32_t)st_a & 0xFFFFU); if (st_a == 0) {
            uint64_t rx = ap->Mode->AbsoluteMaxX - ap->Mode->AbsoluteMinX;
            uint64_t ry = ap->Mode->AbsoluteMaxY - ap->Mode->AbsoluteMinY;
            if (rx > 0) cur_mx = (int)(((as.CurrentX - ap->Mode->AbsoluteMinX) * (uint64_t)max_w) / rx);
            if (ry > 0) cur_my = (int)(((as.CurrentY - ap->Mode->AbsoluteMinY) * (uint64_t)max_h) / ry);
            if (cur_mx < 0) cur_mx = 0; if (cur_mx >= max_w) cur_mx = max_w - 1;
            if (cur_my < 0) cur_my = 0; if (cur_my >= max_h) cur_my = max_h - 1;
            if (as.ActiveButtons & 1) state->left_click = 1;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_num_mice; i++) {
        EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *mp = g_mice[i];
        EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_STATE ms;
        EFI_STATUS st_m = mp ? mp->GetState(mp, &ms) : 99; if (g_num_abs == 0) g_mouse_dbg = ((uint32_t)g_num_mice << 16) | ((uint32_t)st_m & 0xFFFFU); if (st_m == 0) {
            int rx = (mp->Mode && mp->Mode->ResolutionX > 0) ? (int)mp->Mode->ResolutionX : 1;
            int ry = (mp->Mode && mp->Mode->ResolutionY > 0) ? (int)mp->Mode->ResolutionY : 1;
            int dx = (rx > 100) ? (ms.RelativeMovementX / (rx / 16 + 1)) : (ms.RelativeMovementX * 8);
            int dy = (ry > 100) ? (ms.RelativeMovementY / (ry / 16 + 1)) : (ms.RelativeMovementY * 8);
            if (dx == 0 && ms.RelativeMovementX != 0) dx = (ms.RelativeMovementX > 0) ? 2 : -2;
            if (dy == 0 && ms.RelativeMovementY != 0) dy = (ms.RelativeMovementY > 0) ? 2 : -2;
            cur_mx += dx; cur_my += dy;
            if (cur_mx < 0) cur_mx = 0; if (cur_mx >= max_w) cur_mx = max_w - 1;
            if (cur_my < 0) cur_my = 0; if (cur_my >= max_h) cur_my = max_h - 1;
            if (ms.LeftButton) state->left_click = 1;
        }
    }
    while (u_inb(0x64) & 1) {
        uint8_t status = u_inb(0x64);
        if (!(status & 0x20)) break; /* leave keyboard byte for UEFI ConIn! */
        uint8_t data = u_inb(0x60);
        if (uefi_mcycle == 0 && !(data & 0x08)) continue;
        uefi_mpkt[uefi_mcycle++] = data;
        if (uefi_mcycle == 3) {
            uefi_mcycle = 0;
            uefi_mbtn = uefi_mpkt[0] & 0x07;
            int32_t dx = (int32_t)uefi_mpkt[1] - ((uefi_mpkt[0] & 0x10) ? 256 : 0);
            int32_t dy = (int32_t)uefi_mpkt[2] - ((uefi_mpkt[0] & 0x20) ? 256 : 0);
            cur_mx += dx; cur_my -= dy;
            if (cur_mx < 0) cur_mx = 0; if (cur_mx >= max_w) cur_mx = max_w - 1;
            if (cur_my < 0) cur_my = 0; if (cur_my >= max_h) cur_my = max_h - 1;
        }
    }
    if (uefi_mbtn & 1) state->left_click = 1;
    state->mouse_x = cur_mx;
    state->mouse_y = cur_my;
}

void uefi_sleep_ms(uint32_t ms) { g_st->BootServices->Stall((UINTN)ms * 1000); }
void uefi_reboot(void) { g_st->RuntimeServices->ResetSystem(0, 0, 0, 0); }
void uefi_shutdown(void) { g_st->RuntimeServices->ResetSystem(2, 0, 0, 0); }

EFI_STATUS __attribute__((ms_abi)) efi_main(EFI_HANDLE img, EFI_SYSTEM_TABLE *st) {
    g_st = st;
    EFI_GUID gop_guid = {0x9042a9de, 0x23dc, 0x4a38, {0x96,0xfb,0x7a,0xde,0xd0,0x80,0x51,0x6a}};
    EFI_GUID ptr_guid = {0x31878c87, 0x0b75, 0x11d5, {0x9a,0x4f,0x00,0x90,0x27,0x3f,0xc1,0x4d}};
    EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL *gop = 0;

    st->BootServices->LocateProtocol(&gop_guid, 0, (void**)&gop);
    UINTN nh = 0; EFI_HANDLE *hb = 0;
    if (st->BootServices->LocateHandleBuffer(0, 0, 0, &nh, &hb) == 0 && hb) {
        for (UINTN i = 0; i < nh; i++) st->BootServices->ConnectController(hb[i], 0, 0, 1);
    }
    nh = 0; hb = 0;
    EFI_GUID abs_guid = {0x8D59D32B, 0xC655, 0x4AE9, {0x9B,0x15,0xF2,0x59,0x04,0x99,0x2A,0x43}};
    if (st->BootServices->LocateHandleBuffer(2, &abs_guid, 0, &nh, &hb) == 0 && hb) {
        for (UINTN i = 0; i < nh && g_num_abs < 8; i++) {
            EFI_ABSOLUTE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *ap = 0;
            if (st->BootServices->HandleProtocol(hb[i], &abs_guid, (void**)&ap) == 0 && ap) {
                ap->Reset(ap, 0); g_abs_mice[g_num_abs++] = ap;
            }
        }
    }
    nh = 0; hb = 0;
    if (st->BootServices->LocateHandleBuffer(2, &ptr_guid, 0, &nh, &hb) == 0 && hb) {
        for (UINTN i = 0; i < nh && g_num_mice < 8; i++) {
            EFI_SIMPLE_POINTER_PROTOCOL *mp = 0;
            if (st->BootServices->HandleProtocol(hb[i], &ptr_guid, (void**)&mp) == 0 && mp) {
                mp->Reset(mp, 0); g_mice[g_num_mice++] = mp;
            }
        }
    }

    u_ps2_mouse_init();
    max_w = gop->Mode->Info->HorizontalResolution;
    max_h = gop->Mode->Info->VerticalResolution;
    cur_mx = max_w / 2; cur_my = max_h / 2;

    BootInfo info;
    info.framebuffer = (uint32_t*)gop->Mode->FrameBufferBase;
    info.width       = max_w;
    info.height      = max_h;
    info.pitch       = gop->Mode->Info->PixelsPerScanLine;
    info.poll_input  = uefi_poll_input;
    info.sleep_ms    = uefi_sleep_ms;
    info.reboot      = uefi_reboot;
    info.shutdown    = uefi_shutdown;

    // Hand over control to the shared sonionOS kernel!
    kernel_main(&info);
    return 0;
}

#include "console.h"
#include "desktop.h"
#include "string.h"

#define MAX_ROWS 135
#define MAX_COLS 240

static const uint8_t cfont[95][5] = {
    {0,0,0,0,0},{0,0,95,0,0},{0,7,0,7,0},{20,127,20,127,20},{36,42,127,42,18},
    {35,19,8,100,98},{54,73,85,34,80},{0,5,3,0,0},{0,28,34,65,0},{0,65,34,28,0},

    {2,4,8,16,32},{0,65,65,127,0},{4,2,1,2,4},{64,64,64,64,64},{0,1,2,4,0},

    {127,16,40,68,0},{0,65,127,64,0},{124,4,24,4,120},{124,8,4,4,120},{56,68,68,68,56},
    {124,20,20,20,8},{8,20,20,24,124},{124,8,4,4,8},{72,84,84,84,32},{4,63,68,64,32},
    {60,64,64,32,124},{28,32,64,32,28},{60,64,48,64,60},{68,40,16,40,68},{12,80,80,80,60},
    {68,100,84,76,68},{0,8,54,65,0},{0,0,127,0,0},{0,65,54,8,0},{16,8,8,16,8}

static BootInfo *c_info = 0;
static uint32_t *c_buf  = 0;
static void (*c_flush)(void) = 0;
void console_set_flush(void (*fn)(void)) { c_flush = fn; }
void console_flush_now(void) { console_render(); if (c_flush) c_flush(); }
static int c_scale = 2, c_cols = 80, c_rows = 25;
static int cur_x = 0, cur_y = 0, dirty = 1;
static uint32_t fg_col = 0x00E2E8F0, bg_col = 0x00090D16;

static int c_area_x = 16, c_area_y = 16;
static int c_area_w = 0, c_area_h = 0;

static char     grid_ch[MAX_ROWS][MAX_COLS];
static uint32_t grid_fg[MAX_ROWS][MAX_COLS];

static inline void serial_outb(uint16_t p, uint8_t v) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"(v), "Nd"(p));
}
static inline uint8_t serial_inb(uint16_t p) {
    uint8_t r; __asm__ volatile ("inb %1, %0" : "=a"(r) : "Nd"(p)); return r;
}

static void serial_putc(char c) {
    if (c == '\n') serial_putc('\r');
    for (int t = 0; t < 100000 && !(serial_inb(0x3FD) & 0x20); t++);
    serial_outb(0x3F8, (uint8_t)c);
}

void console_clear(void) {
    for (int r = 0; r < MAX_ROWS; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < MAX_COLS; c++) {
            grid_ch[r][c] = ' ';
            grid_fg[r][c] = fg_col;
        }
    }
    cur_x = 0; cur_y = 0; dirty = 1;
}

void console_init(BootInfo *info, uint32_t *backbuf, int scale) {
    c_info  = info;
    c_buf   = backbuf ? backbuf : info->framebuffer;
    c_scale = (scale > 0) ? scale : 2;

    desktop_console_bounds(&c_area_x, &c_area_y,
                           &c_area_w, &c_area_h);

    c_cols = c_area_w / (6 * c_scale);
    c_rows = c_area_h / (9 * c_scale);

    if (c_cols < 1) c_cols = 1;
    if (c_rows < 1) c_rows = 1;
    if (c_cols > MAX_COLS) c_cols = MAX_COLS;
    if (c_rows > MAX_ROWS) c_rows = MAX_ROWS;
    console_clear();
}

void console_set_color(uint32_t fg, uint32_t bg) {
    fg_col = fg; bg_col = bg; dirty = 1;
}

static void console_scroll(void) {
    for (int r = 1; r < c_rows; r++) {
        memcpy(grid_ch[r - 1], grid_ch[r], (size_t)c_cols);
        memcpy(grid_fg[r - 1], grid_fg[r], (size_t)c_cols * sizeof(uint32_t));
    }
    for (int c = 0; c < c_cols; c++) {
        grid_ch[c_rows - 1][c] = ' ';
        grid_fg[c_rows - 1][c] = fg_col;
    }
    cur_y = c_rows - 1;
}

void console_putchar(char c) {
    serial_putc(c);
    if (c == '\r') { cur_x = 0; dirty = 1; return; }
    if (c == '\n') {
        cur_x = 0;
        if (++cur_y >= c_rows) console_scroll();
        dirty = 1;
        return;
    }
    if (c == '\b') {
        if (cur_x > 0) {
            cur_x--;
            grid_ch[cur_y][cur_x] = ' ';
            dirty = 1;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (c == '\t') {
        int next = (cur_x + 4) & ~3;
        while (cur_x < next && cur_x < c_cols) console_putchar(' ');
        return;
    }
    if ((unsigned char)c < 32 || (unsigned char)c > 126) c = '?';
    grid_ch[cur_y][cur_x] = c;
    grid_fg[cur_y][cur_x] = fg_col;
    if (++cur_x >= c_cols) {
        cur_x = 0;
        if (++cur_y >= c_rows) console_scroll();
    }
    dirty = 1;
}

void console_write(const char *buf, size_t len) {
    if (!buf) return;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) console_putchar(buf[i]);
}

void console_puts(const char *s) {
    if (!s) return;
    while (*s) console_putchar(*s++);
    console_putchar('\n');
}

void console_render(void) {
    if (!c_info || !c_buf) return;

    if (!desktop_console_visible()) return;

    /* Follow the window when it moves. */
    desktop_console_bounds(&c_area_x, &c_area_y,
                           &c_area_w, &c_area_h);

    if (!dirty) return;
    dirty = 0;

    /* Console is rendered inside the desktop window. */
    int pad_x = c_area_x;
    int pad_y = c_area_y;
    int cw = 6 * c_scale;
    int ch = 9 * c_scale;

    /* Clear only the console content area. */
    for (int y = 0; y < c_area_h; y++) {
        int py = c_area_y + y;
        if (py < 0 || py >= (int)c_info->height) continue;

        for (int x = 0; x < c_area_w; x++) {
            int px = c_area_x + x;
            if (px < 0 || px >= (int)c_info->width) continue;

            c_buf[py * c_info->pitch + px] = bg_col;
        }
    }

    for (int r = 0; r < c_rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < c_cols; c++) {
            char ch_val = grid_ch[r][c];
            if (ch_val <= 32 || ch_val > 126) continue;
            uint32_t col = grid_fg[r][c];
            int gx = pad_x + c * cw;
            int gy = pad_y + r * ch;
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                uint8_t line = cfont[ch_val - 32][i];
                for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                    if (line & (1 << j)) {
                        for (int dy = 0; dy < c_scale; dy++) {
                            int py = gy + j * c_scale + dy;
                            if (py >= (int)c_info->height) continue;
                            for (int dx = 0; dx < c_scale; dx++) {
                                int px = gx + i * c_scale + dx;
                                if (px < (int)c_info->width) c_buf[py * c_info->pitch + px] = col;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Draw underscore cursor at active (cur_x, cur_y)
    int cx = pad_x + cur_x * cw;
    int cy = pad_y + cur_y * ch + 7 * c_scale;
    for (int dy = 0; dy < c_scale; dy++) {
        int py = cy + dy;
        if (py >= (int)c_info->height) break;
        for (int dx = 0; dx < 5 * c_scale; dx++) {
            int px = cx + dx;
            if (px < (int)c_info->width) c_buf[py * c_info->pitch + px] = 0x0038BDF8;
        }
    }
}

int console_getchar(int blocking) {
    if (!c_info || !c_info->poll_input) return -1;
    InputState in;
    do {
        c_info->poll_input(&in);

        desktop_update(&in);

        /* Desktop was redrawn, so redraw the complete text grid. */
        dirty = 1;
        console_render();

        desktop_draw_cursor();

        if (c_flush) c_flush();

        if (in.key_char != 0)
            return (int)(unsigned char)in.key_char;

        if (in.scan_code == 0x17) return 27; // ESC
        if (blocking && c_info->sleep_ms) c_info->sleep_ms(10);
    } while (blocking);
    return -1;
}

#include "desktop.h"
#include "gfx.h"

static BootInfo *d_info;

static int mouse_x, mouse_y;
static int old_mouse_x, old_mouse_y;
static int previous_click;
static int dragging;

static int selected_icon = -1;

static int win_x, win_y, win_w, win_h;
static int saved_x, saved_y, saved_w, saved_h;

static int win_open = 1;
static int win_minimized = 0;
static int win_maximized = 0;
static int win_focused = 1;

static const uint32_t icon_colors[3] = {
    0x0038BDF8, 0x0022C55E, 0x00A78BFA
};

static int inside(int x, int y, int rx, int ry, int rw, int rh) {
    return x >= rx && y >= ry &&
           x < rx + rw && y < ry + rh;
}

static int dock_y(void) {
    return (d_info->height > 100)
        ? (int)d_info->height - 76 : 0;
}

static void clamp_window(void) {
    int max_x = (int)d_info->width - win_w;
    int max_y = (int)d_info->height - win_h;

    if (win_x < 0) win_x = 0;
    if (win_y < 34) win_y = 34;
    if (win_x > max_x) win_x = max_x;
    if (win_y > max_y) win_y = max_y;
}

static void draw_window(void) {
    if (!win_open || win_minimized) return;

    gfx_fill_rect(win_x + 5, win_y + 5,
                  win_w, win_h, 0x00000000);

    gfx_fill_rect(win_x, win_y, win_w, win_h,
                  0x002B3D55);

    gfx_rect(win_x, win_y, win_w, win_h,
             win_focused ? 0x0038BDF8 : 0x00475B78);

    /* Title bar */
    gfx_fill_rect(win_x + 1, win_y + 1,
                  win_w - 2, 29,
                  win_focused ? 0x0018273D : 0x00101829);

    gfx_fill_rect(win_x + 1, win_y + 29,
                  win_w - 2, 1, 0x0038BDF8);

    /* Minimize */
    gfx_fill_rect(win_x + win_w - 62, win_y + 10,
                  9, 9, 0x00F59E0B);

    /* Maximize / restore */
    gfx_fill_rect(win_x + win_w - 44, win_y + 10,
                  9, 9, 0x0022C55E);

    /* Close */
    gfx_fill_rect(win_x + win_w - 26, win_y + 10,
                  9, 9, 0x00EF4444);

    /* Console content */
    gfx_fill_rect(win_x + 10, win_y + 38,
                  win_w - 20, win_h - 48,
                  0x00090D16);
}

static void draw_scene(void) {
    uint32_t w = d_info->width;
    uint32_t h = d_info->height;

    gfx_fill(0x000B1220);

    gfx_fill_rect(w * 3 / 5, 60, w / 3, h / 3,
                  0x0015223A);

    gfx_fill_rect(w * 2 / 3, 90, w / 4, h / 4,
                  0x001B2C48);

    /* Top panel */
    gfx_fill_rect(0, 0, w, 34, 0x00101829);
    gfx_fill_rect(0, 33, w, 1, 0x0038BDF8);

    /* Desktop icons */
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        int x = 28;
        int y = 64 + i * 100;

        if (selected_icon == i) {
            gfx_fill_rect(x - 6, y - 6, 60, 60,
                          0x00304765);
            gfx_rect(x - 6, y - 6, 60, 60,
                     0x0038BDF8);
        }

        gfx_fill_rect(x, y, 48, 48, icon_colors[i]);
        gfx_rect(x, y, 48, 48, 0x00E2E8F0);
        gfx_fill_rect(x + 12, y + 12, 24, 24,
                      0x00E2E8F0);
    }

    /* Dock */
    int dw = (w > 440) ? 400 : (int)w - 32;
    if (dw < 0) dw = 0;

    int dx = ((int)w - dw) / 2;
    int dy = dock_y();

    gfx_fill_rect(dx, dy, dw, 56, 0x00182235);
    gfx_rect(dx, dy, dw, 56, 0x00475B78);

    const uint32_t colors[5] = {
        0x0038BDF8, 0x0022C55E, 0x00F59E0B,
        0x00A78BFA, 0x00EF4444
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        int x = dx + 14 + i * 72;
        if (x + 40 >= dx + dw) break;

        gfx_fill_rect(x, dy + 8, 40, 40, colors[i]);
        gfx_rect(x, dy + 8, 40, 40, 0x00E2E8F0);
    }

    /* Console dock indicator */
    if (win_open && win_minimized) {
        gfx_fill_rect(dx + 14, dy + 51, 40, 3,
                      0x0038BDF8);
    }

    draw_window();
}

void desktop_console_bounds(int *x, int *y, int *w, int *h) {
    if (!d_info) return;

    if (x) *x = win_x + 18;
    if (y) *y = win_y + 44;
    if (w) *w = win_w - 36;
    if (h) *h = win_h - 56;
}

int desktop_console_visible(void) {
    return win_open && !win_minimized;
}

void desktop_init(BootInfo *info, uint32_t *backbuf) {
    if (!info || !backbuf || !info->width || !info->height)
        return;

    d_info = info;
    gfx_init(info, backbuf);

    win_w = (int)info->width - 120;
    win_h = (int)info->height - 150;

    if (win_w > 680) win_w = 680;
    if (win_h > 460) win_h = 460;

    if (win_w > (int)info->width - 16)
        win_w = (int)info->width - 16;

    if (win_h > (int)info->height - 100)
        win_h = (int)info->height - 100;

    if (win_w < 180) win_w = 180;
    if (win_h < 120) win_h = 120;

    win_x = ((int)info->width - win_w) / 2;
    win_y = 48;

    saved_x = win_x;
    saved_y = win_y;
    saved_w = win_w;
    saved_h = win_h;

    mouse_x = (int)info->width / 2;
    mouse_y = (int)info->height / 2;

    old_mouse_x = mouse_x;
    old_mouse_y = mouse_y;

    draw_scene();
}

static void maximize_window(void) {
    if (!win_maximized) {
        saved_x = win_x;
        saved_y = win_y;
        saved_w = win_w;
        saved_h = win_h;

        win_x = 8;
        win_y = 40;
        win_w = (int)d_info->width - 16;
        win_h = (int)d_info->height - 124;

        win_maximized = 1;
    } else {
        win_x = saved_x;
        win_y = saved_y;
        win_w = saved_w;
        win_h = saved_h;

        win_maximized = 0;
    }
}

void desktop_update(const InputState *input) {
    if (!d_info || !input) return;

    mouse_x = input->mouse_x;
    mouse_y = input->mouse_y;

    if (mouse_x < 0) mouse_x = 0;
    if (mouse_y < 0) mouse_y = 0;

    if (mouse_x >= (int)d_info->width)
        mouse_x = (int)d_info->width - 1;

    if (mouse_y >= (int)d_info->height)
        mouse_y = (int)d_info->height - 1;

    int pressed = input->left_click != 0;

    if (pressed && !previous_click) {
        int dock_x = ((int)d_info->width -
                     ((d_info->width > 440) ? 400 :
                      (int)d_info->width - 32)) / 2;

        /* Restore console from its dock icon */
        if (inside(mouse_x, mouse_y,
                   dock_x + 14, dock_y() + 8, 40, 40)) {
            win_open = 1;
            win_minimized = 0;
            win_focused = 1;
        }

        else if (desktop_console_visible() &&
                 inside(mouse_x, mouse_y,
                        win_x, win_y, win_w, 30)) {

            win_focused = 1;

            if (inside(mouse_x, mouse_y,
                       win_x + win_w - 62, win_y + 7, 15, 15)) {
                win_minimized = 1;
                dragging = 0;
            }

            else if (inside(mouse_x, mouse_y,
                            win_x + win_w - 44, win_y + 7, 15, 15)) {
                maximize_window();
                dragging = 0;
            }

            else if (inside(mouse_x, mouse_y,
                            win_x + win_w - 26, win_y + 7, 15, 15)) {
                win_open = 0;
                win_minimized = 0;
                dragging = 0;
            }

            else if (!win_maximized) {
                dragging = 1;
            }
        }

        else if (desktop_console_visible() &&
                 inside(mouse_x, mouse_y,
                        win_x, win_y, win_w, win_h)) {
            win_focused = 1;
            dragging = 0;
        }

        else {
            dragging = 0;
            win_focused = 0;
            selected_icon = -1;

            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                int iy = 64 + i * 100;

                if (inside(mouse_x, mouse_y,
                           22, iy - 6, 60, 60)) {
                    selected_icon = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (pressed && dragging && desktop_console_visible()) {
        win_x += mouse_x - old_mouse_x;
        win_y += mouse_y - old_mouse_y;
        clamp_window();
    }

    if (!pressed)
        dragging = 0;

    previous_click = pressed;
    old_mouse_x = mouse_x;
    old_mouse_y = mouse_y;

    draw_scene();
}

void desktop_draw_cursor(void) {
    if (!d_info) return;

    for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) {
        int width = y / 2 + 1;
        gfx_fill_rect(mouse_x - 1, mouse_y + y,
                      width + 2, 1, 0x00000000);
    }

    for (int y = 0; y < 14; y++) {
        int width = y / 2 + 1;
        gfx_fill_rect(mouse_x, mouse_y + y,
                      width, 1, 0x00FFFFFF);
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/gfx.c
================================================================================

#include "gfx.h"

static BootInfo *g_info;
static uint32_t *g_buf;

void gfx_init(BootInfo *info, uint32_t *backbuf) {
    g_info = info;
    g_buf = backbuf;
}

void gfx_pixel(int x, int y, uint32_t color) {
    if (!g_info || !g_buf) return;
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= (int)g_info->width ||
        y >= (int)g_info->height) return;

    g_buf[(uint32_t)y * g_info->pitch + (uint32_t)x] = color;
}

void gfx_fill(uint32_t color) {
    if (!g_info || !g_buf) return;

    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < g_info->height; y++) {
        uint32_t *row = &g_buf[y * g_info->pitch];
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < g_info->width; x++)
            row[x] = color;
    }
}

void gfx_fill_rect(int x, int y, int w, int h, uint32_t color) {
    if (!g_info || !g_buf || w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

    int x2 = x + w;
    int y2 = y + h;

    if (x < 0) x = 0;
    if (y < 0) y = 0;
    if (x2 > (int)g_info->width) x2 = (int)g_info->width;
    if (y2 > (int)g_info->height) y2 = (int)g_info->height;

    for (int py = y; py < y2; py++) {
        for (int px = x; px < x2; px++)
            g_buf[(uint32_t)py * g_info->pitch + (uint32_t)px] = color;
    }
}

void gfx_rect(int x, int y, int w, int h, uint32_t color) {
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

    gfx_fill_rect(x, y, w, 1, color);
    gfx_fill_rect(x, y + h - 1, w, 1, color);
    gfx_fill_rect(x, y, 1, h, color);
    gfx_fill_rect(x + w - 1, y, 1, h, color);
}


================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/kernel.c
================================================================================

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "bootinfo.h"
#include "pat.h"
#include "arch/gdt.h"
#include "arch/paging.h"
#include "arch/syscall.h"
#include "panic.h"
#include "console.h"
#include "desktop.h"
#include "sched.h"
#include "blockdev.h"
#include "fs/fat32.h"

static BootInfo *g_info = 0;
static uint32_t * const backbuf = (uint32_t *)0x00400000ULL;

static void swap_buffers(void) {
    if (!g_info || !g_info->framebuffer) return;
    uint32_t h = g_info->height, w = g_info->width, pitch = g_info->pitch;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        memcpy(&g_info->framebuffer[y * pitch], &backbuf[y * pitch], w * sizeof(uint32_t));
    }
}

uint64_t kernel_dev_fb_write(uint64_t offset, const void *buf, uint64_t len) {
    if (!g_info || !buf || len == 0) return 0;
    uint64_t max_bytes = (uint64_t)g_info->width * g_info->height * 4ULL;
    if (offset >= max_bytes) return 0;
    if (offset + len > max_bytes) len = max_bytes - offset;
    memcpy(((uint8_t *)backbuf) + offset, buf, (size_t)len);
    swap_buffers();
    return len;
}
void kernel_main(BootInfo *info) {
    g_info = info;
    gdt_init();
    paging_init(info);
    syscall_init(info);
    panic_init(info);
    enable_write_combining((uintptr_t)info->framebuffer, (uint64_t)info->pitch * info->height * 4);

    desktop_init(info, backbuf);
    sched_init();
    console_init(info, backbuf, 2);
    console_set_flush(swap_buffers);
    block_init(info);
    fat32_init();

    console_set_color(0x0038BDF8, 0x00090D16);
    console_puts("[KERNEL] Ring 0 Ready -> Launching /USER/INIT.BIN in Ring 3...");
    console_flush_now();

    int rc = ring3_exec("/USER/INIT.BIN");
    console_set_color(0x00EF4444, 0x00090D16);
    console_puts("[KERNEL] INIT.BIN exited or missing! Halting.");
    console_flush_now();
    (void)rc;
    while (1) info->sleep_ms(100);
}

#include "panic.h"
#include "arch/syscall.h"
#include "arch/syscall.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t offset_low;
    uint16_t selector;
    uint8_t  ist;
    uint8_t  type_attr;
    uint16_t offset_mid;
    uint32_t offset_high;
    uint32_t zero;
} IdtEntry;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t limit;
    uint64_t base;
} IdtPtr;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint64_t r15, r14, r13, r12, r11, r10, r9, r8;
    uint64_t rbp, rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx, rbx, rax;
    uint64_t int_no, err_code;
    uint64_t rip, cs, rflags, rsp, ss;
} ExceptionFrame;

static IdtEntry idt[256];
static BootInfo *p_info = 0;

static const char *exc_names[32] = {
    "Divide By Zero (#DE)", "Debug (#DB)", "Non-Maskable Interrupt (NMI)", "Breakpoint (#BP)",
    "Overflow (#OF)", "Bound Range Exceeded (#BR)", "Invalid Opcode (#UD)", "Device Not Available (#NM)",
    "Double Fault (#DF)", "Coprocessor Segment Overrun", "Invalid TSS (#TS)", "Segment Not Present (#NP)",
    "Stack-Segment Fault (#SS)", "General Protection Fault (#GP)", "Page Fault (#PF)", "Reserved (15)",
    "x87 Floating-Point (#MF)", "Alignment Check (#AC)", "Machine Check (#MC)", "SIMD Floating-Point (#XM)",
    "Virtualization (#VE)", "Control Protection (#CP)", "Reserved (22)", "Reserved (23)",
    "Reserved (24)", "Reserved (25)", "Reserved (26)", "Reserved (27)",
    "Hypervisor Injection (#HV)", "VMM Communication (#VC)", "Security Exception (#SX)", "Reserved (31)"
};

static void vram_char(char c, int x, int y, uint32_t col, int scale) {
    if (!p_info || c < 32 || c > 126) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        uint8_t line = pfont[c - 32][i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            if (line & (1 << j)) {
                for (int dy = 0; dy < scale; dy++) {
                    int py = y + j * scale + dy;
                    if (py < 0 || py >= (int)p_info->height) continue;
                    for (int dx = 0; dx < scale; dx++) {
                        int px = x + i * scale + dx;
                        if (px >= 0 && px < (int)p_info->width)
                            p_info->framebuffer[py * p_info->pitch + px] = col;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

static void vram_str(const char *s, int x, int y, uint32_t col, int scale) {
    while (*s) { vram_char(*s++, x, y, col, scale); x += 6 * scale; }
}

static void vram_hex(const char *label, uint64_t val, int x, int y) {
    char buf[32];
    int p = 0;
    while (label[p]) { buf[p] = label[p]; p++; }
    buf[p++] = '0';
    buf[p++] = 'x';
    const char *hex = "0123456789ABCDEF";
    for (int s = 60; s >= 0; s -= 4) {
        buf[p++] = hex[(val >> s) & 0xF];
    }
    buf[p] = 0;
    vram_str(buf, x, y, 0x00F8FAFC, 2);
}

static void halt_with_reboot(void) {
    InputState in;
    while (1) {
        if (p_info && p_info->poll_input) {
            p_info->poll_input(&in);
            if (in.scan_code == 0x17 && p_info->reboot) p_info->reboot();
        }
        __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    }
}

static void paint_panic_bg(void) {
    if (!p_info || !p_info->framebuffer) return;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < p_info->height; y++) {
        uint32_t col = (y < 64) ? 0x00991B1B : 0x000F172A;
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < p_info->width; x++) {
            p_info->framebuffer[y * p_info->pitch + x] = col;
        }
    }
    vram_str("SONIONOS KERNEL PANIC - SYSTEM HALTED", 28, 22, 0x00FFFFFF, 2);
    vram_str("Press ESC to reboot machine...", 28, (int)p_info->height - 40, 0x0094A3B8, 2);
}

void kernel_panic(const char *reason, const char *file, int line) {
    __asm__ volatile ("cli");
    paint_panic_bg();
    vram_str("REASON:", 28, 90, 0x00F87171, 2);
    vram_str(reason ? reason : "Unknown Kernel Panic", 125, 90, 0x00FFFFFF, 2);
    vram_str("SOURCE:", 28, 125, 0x00F87171, 2);
    vram_str(file ? file : "unknown", 125, 125, 0x00E2E8F0, 2);
    vram_hex("LINE:   ", (uint64_t)line, 28, 160);
    halt_with_reboot();
}

__attribute__((used)) __attribute__((used)) void panic_exception_handler(ExceptionFrame *f) {
    if ((f->cs & 3) == 3) { uint64_t cr2 = 0; __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr2, %0" : "=r"(cr2)); ring3_fault_recover(f->int_no, f->rip, cr2); }
    __asm__ volatile ("cli");
    uint64_t cr2 = 0;
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr2, %0" : "=r"(cr2));

    paint_panic_bg();
    const char *name = (f->int_no < 32) ? exc_names[f->int_no] : "Hardware Exception";
    vram_str("EXCEPTION:", 28, 85, 0x00F87171, 2);
    vram_str(name, 160, 85, 0x00FFFFFF, 2);

    vram_hex("RIP: ", f->rip,      28, 130);
    vram_hex("ERR: ", f->err_code, 360, 130);
    vram_hex("CR2: ", cr2,         28, 160);
    vram_hex("RSP: ", f->rsp,      360, 160);

    vram_hex("RAX: ", f->rax,      28, 205);
    vram_hex("RBX: ", f->rbx,      360, 205);
    vram_hex("RCX: ", f->rcx,      28, 235);
    vram_hex("RDX: ", f->rdx,      360, 235);
    vram_hex("RSI: ", f->rsi,      28, 265);
    vram_hex("RDI: ", f->rdi,      360, 265);
    vram_hex("RBP: ", f->rbp,      28, 295);
    vram_hex("RFL: ", f->rflags,   360, 295);

    halt_with_reboot();
}

__attribute__((naked, used)) void exc_common_stub(void) {
    __asm__ volatile (
        "push %rax\n\t"
        "push %rbx\n\t"
        "push %rcx\n\t"
        "push %rdx\n\t"
        "push %rsi\n\t"
        "push %rdi\n\t"
        "push %rbp\n\t"
        "push %r8\n\t"
        "push %r9\n\t"
        "push %r10\n\t"
        "push %r11\n\t"
        "push %r12\n\t"
        "push %r13\n\t"
        "push %r14\n\t"
        "push %r15\n\t"
        "mov %rsp, %rcx\n\t"
        "sub $32, %rsp\n\t"
        "call panic_exception_handler\n\t"
        "hlt\n\t"
    );
}

#define ISR_NOERR(n) \
    __attribute__((naked)) static void isr_##n(void) { \
        __asm__ volatile ("push $0\n\t push $" #n "\n\t jmp exc_common_stub\n\t"); \
    }

#define ISR_ERR(n) \
    __attribute__((naked)) static void isr_##n(void) { \
        __asm__ volatile ("push $" #n "\n\t jmp exc_common_stub\n\t"); \
    }

ISR_NOERR(0)  ISR_NOERR(1)  ISR_NOERR(2)  ISR_NOERR(3)
ISR_NOERR(4)  ISR_NOERR(5)  ISR_NOERR(6)  ISR_NOERR(7)
ISR_ERR(8)    ISR_NOERR(9)  ISR_ERR(10)   ISR_ERR(11)
ISR_ERR(12)   ISR_ERR(13)   ISR_ERR(14)   ISR_NOERR(15)
ISR_NOERR(16) ISR_ERR(17)   ISR_NOERR(18) ISR_NOERR(19)
ISR_NOERR(20) ISR_ERR(21)   ISR_NOERR(22) ISR_NOERR(23)
ISR_NOERR(24) ISR_NOERR(25) ISR_NOERR(26) ISR_NOERR(27)
ISR_NOERR(28) ISR_ERR(29)   ISR_ERR(30)   ISR_NOERR(31)

static void set_idt_gate(int n, void (*handler)(void), uint16_t cs) {
    uint64_t addr = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)handler;
    idt[n].offset_low  = (uint16_t)(addr & 0xFFFF);
    idt[n].selector    = cs;
    idt[n].ist         = (n == 2 || n == 8 || n == 12 || n == 13 || n == 14 || n == 18) ? 1 : 0;
    idt[n].type_attr   = 0x8E;
    idt[n].offset_mid  = (uint16_t)((addr >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
    idt[n].offset_high = (uint32_t)((addr >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF);
    idt[n].zero        = 0;
}

void panic_init(BootInfo *info) {
    p_info = info;
    uint16_t cs = 0;
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cs, %0" : "=r"(cs));

    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, $0x21" : : "a"((uint8_t)0xFF));
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, $0xA1" : : "a"((uint8_t)0xFF));

    void (*handlers[32])(void) = {
        isr_0, isr_1, isr_2, isr_3, isr_4, isr_5, isr_6, isr_7,
        isr_8, isr_9, isr_10, isr_11, isr_12, isr_13, isr_14, isr_15,
        isr_16, isr_17, isr_18, isr_19, isr_20, isr_21, isr_22, isr_23,
        isr_24, isr_25, isr_26, isr_27, isr_28, isr_29, isr_30, isr_31
    };

        __asm__ volatile ("jmp 1f\n\t isr_ignore:\n\t iretq\n\t 1:\n\t");
    extern void isr_ignore(void);
    for (int i = 32; i < 256; i++) {
        set_idt_gate(i, isr_ignore, cs);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        set_idt_gate(i, handlers[i], cs);
    }

    uint64_t cr4; __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr4, %0" : "=r"(cr4)); cr4 |= (1ULL << 6) | (1ULL << 10); __asm__ volatile ("mov %0, %%cr4" : : "r"(cr4));
    IdtPtr idtr;
    idtr.limit = sizeof(idt) - 1;
    idtr.base  = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&idt[0];
    __asm__ volatile ("lidt %0" : : "m"(idtr));
}








================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/sched.c
================================================================================

#include "sched.h"
#include <stddef.h>

static TaskInfo tasks[MAX_TASKS];
static int current_idx = 0;
static int next_pid = 1;

static void scpy(char *d, const char *s, size_t m) {
    size_t i = 0;
    if (!s) s = "task";
    while (s[i] && i + 1 < m) { d[i] = s[i]; i++; }
    d[i] = 0;
}

void sched_init(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TASKS; i++) {
        tasks[i].pid = 0;
        tasks[i].state = TASK_UNUSED;
        tasks[i].ticks = 0;
    }
    tasks[0].pid = next_pid++;
    scpy(tasks[0].name, "INIT.BIN (Shell)", 24);
    tasks[0].state = TASK_RUNNING;
    tasks[0].cpl = 3;
    tasks[0].mem_kb = 16384;
    tasks[0].ticks = 1;
    current_idx = 0;
}

void sched_yield(void) { sched_tick(); }

int sched_register_task(const char *name, int cpl, uint32_t mem_kb) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TASKS; i++) {
        if (tasks[i].state == TASK_UNUSED || tasks[i].state == TASK_ZOMBIE) {
            tasks[i].pid = next_pid++;
            scpy(tasks[i].name, name, 24);
            tasks[i].state = TASK_RUNNING;
            tasks[i].cpl = cpl;
            tasks[i].mem_kb = mem_kb;
            tasks[i].ticks = 1;
            return tasks[i].pid;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

void sched_set_state(int pid, int state) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TASKS; i++) {
        if (tasks[i].pid == pid) { tasks[i].state = state; return; }
    }
}

void sched_tick(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TASKS; i++) {
        if (tasks[i].state == TASK_RUNNING || tasks[i].state == TASK_READY) {
            tasks[i].ticks++;
        }
    }
}

int sched_kill(int pid) {
    if (pid <= 1) return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TASKS; i++) {
        if (tasks[i].pid == pid && tasks[i].state != TASK_UNUSED) {
            tasks[i].state = TASK_UNUSED;
            tasks[i].pid = 0;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return -2;
}

int sched_count(void) {
    int c = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TASKS; i++) if (tasks[i].state != TASK_UNUSED) c++;
    return c;
}

TaskInfo *sched_get(int idx) {
    return (idx < 0 || idx >= MAX_TASKS) ? 0 : &tasks[idx];
}

int sched_current_pid(void) { return tasks[current_idx].pid; }

#include "arch/gdt.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint32_t rsv0;
    uint64_t rsp0, rsp1, rsp2, rsv1;
    uint64_t ist[7];
    uint64_t rsv2;
    uint16_t rsv3, iomap_base;
} Tss64;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t limit;
    uint64_t base;
} Gdtr64;

static uint64_t gdt[7] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static Tss64    tss      __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static uint8_t  ist1_stack[8192] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static uint8_t  kstack[16384] __attribute__((aligned(16)));

void tss_set_rsp0(uint64_t rsp0) { tss.rsp0 = rsp0; }

void gdt_init(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) gdt[i] = 0;
    uint8_t *tp = (uint8_t *)&tss;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(tss); i++) tp[i] = 0;

    tss.rsp0       = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(kstack + sizeof(kstack));
    tss.ist[0]     = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(ist1_stack + sizeof(ist1_stack));
    tss.iomap_base = sizeof(Tss64);

    gdt[1] = 0x00AF9A000000FFFFULL;
    gdt[2] = 0x00CF92000000FFFFULL;
    gdt[3] = 0x00CFF2000000FFFFULL;
    gdt[4] = 0x00AFFA000000FFFFULL;

    uint64_t base  = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&tss;
    uint64_t limit = sizeof(Tss64) - 1;
    gdt[5] = (limit & 0xFFFFULL) | ((base & 0xFFFFFFULL) << 16) |
               (0x89ULL << 40) | (((limit >> 16) & 0xFULL) << 48) | (((base >> 24) & 0xFFULL) << 56);
    gdt[6] = (base >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFFULL;

    Gdtr64 gdtr = { sizeof(gdt) - 1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)gdt };
    __asm__ volatile (
        "lgdt %0\n\t"
        "pushq $0x08\n\t"
        "leaq 1f(%%rip), %%rax\n\t"
        "pushq %%rax\n\t"
        "lretq\n\t"
        "1:\n\t"
        "movw $0x10, %%ax\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%ds\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%es\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%fs\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%gs\n\t"
        "movw %%ax, %%ss\n\t"
        : : "m"(gdtr) : "rax", "memory"
    );
    uint16_t tss_sel = GDT_TSS_SEL;
    __asm__ volatile ("ltr %0" : : "r"(tss_sel));
}



================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/arch/paging.c
================================================================================

#include "arch/paging.h"

#define PTE_PRESENT  (1ULL << 0)
#define PTE_WRITABLE (1ULL << 1)
#define PTE_USER     (1ULL << 2)
#define PTE_PS_2MB   (1ULL << 7)

static uint64_t pdpt_fb[512] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t pd_fb[512]   __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t pml4[512]       __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t pdpt[512]       __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t pd_low[4][512] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t pd_hi[512]      __attribute__((aligned(4096)));

void paging_init(BootInfo *info) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) { pml4[i] = 0; pdpt[i] = 0; pd_hi[i] = 0; }
    uint64_t pdpt_flags = PTE_PRESENT | PTE_WRITABLE | PTE_USER;
    pml4[0] = ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pdpt) | pdpt_flags;

    for (uint64_t g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
        pdpt[g] = ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pd_low[g]) | pdpt_flags;
        for (uint64_t m = 0; m < 512; m++) {
            uint64_t addr = (g << 30) | (m << 21);
            uint64_t flags = PTE_PRESENT | PTE_WRITABLE | PTE_PS_2MB;
            if (addr >= USER_BASE_ADDR && addr < USER_LIMIT_ADDR) flags |= PTE_USER;
            pd_low[g][m] = addr | flags;
        }
    }
    if (info && info->framebuffer) {
        uint64_t fb = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)info->framebuffer;
        uint64_t gb = fb >> 30;
        if (gb >= 4 && gb < 512) {
            pdpt[gb] = ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pd_hi) | (PTE_PRESENT | PTE_WRITABLE);
            uint64_t base_gb = gb << 30;
            for (uint64_t m = 0; m < 512; m++) {
                pd_hi[m] = (base_gb | (m << 21)) | (PTE_PRESENT | PTE_WRITABLE | PTE_PS_2MB);
            }
        }
    }

    uint64_t cr3 = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)pml4;
    uint64_t cr0;
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %%cr0, %0" : "=r"(cr0));
    cr0 = (cr0 & ~((1ULL << 2) | (1ULL << 3))) | (1ULL << 1);
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %0, %%cr0" : : "r"(cr0));
    uint64_t cr4;
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %%cr4, %0" : "=r"(cr4));
    cr4 |= (1ULL << 7) | (1ULL << 9) | (1ULL << 10);
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %0, %%cr4" : : "r"(cr4));
    __asm__ volatile ("movq %0, %%cr3" : : "r"(cr3) : "memory");
}









================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/arch/syscall.c

#include "sched.h"
#include "arch/syscall.h"
#include "arch/gdt.h"
#include "arch/paging.h"
#include "sysinfo_page.h"
#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <setjmp.h>
#include <time.h>
#include "console.h"
#include "blockdev.h"
#include "fs/fat32.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint64_t r10, r9, r8, rdx, rsi, rdi, rbp, rbx;
    uint64_t r11, rcx, user_rsp;
} SyscallFrame;

static BootInfo  *sc_info = 0;
static Fat32File *fd_tab[32];
static Fat32Dir  *dir_tab[8];
static jmp_buf    r3_ret_jmp[2];
static int        r3_exit_code[2];
static int        r3_depth = 0;

static uint8_t  sc_kstack[2][16384] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static uint64_t sc_kstack_top = 0;
static uint64_t sc_user_rsp   = 0;

static inline uint64_t rdmsr(uint32_t msr) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdmsr" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi) : "c"(msr));
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static inline void wrmsr(uint32_t msr, uint64_t val) {
    __asm__ volatile ("wrmsr" : : "c"(msr), "a"((uint32_t)val), "d"((uint32_t)(val >> 32)));
}

static void sys_hw_reboot(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("cli");
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"((uint8_t)0x06), "Nd"((uint16_t)0xCF9));
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"((uint8_t)0xFE), "Nd"((uint16_t)0x64));
    while (1) __asm__ volatile ("hlt");
}

static char sc_tolower(char c) {
    return (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') ? (char)(c + 32) : c;
}

static int sc_starts_with_nocase(const char *s, const char *prefix) {
    while (*prefix) {
        if (sc_tolower(*s) != sc_tolower(*prefix)) return 0;
        s++; prefix++;
    }
    return (*s == 0 || *s == '/' || *s == '\\');
}

static int is_protected_syspath(const char *path) {
    if (!path) return 0;
    while (*path == '/' || *path == '\\') path++;
    if (sc_starts_with_nocase(path, "efi"))  return 1;
    if (sc_starts_with_nocase(path, "boot")) return 1;
    if (sc_starts_with_nocase(path, "user")) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static void deny_syspath_write(const char *path) {
    console_set_color(0x00FACC15, 0x00090D16);
    console_puts("\n[KERNEL] Access Denied (EACCES): Protected system path -> ");
    console_puts(path ? path : "(null)");
    console_puts("\n");
    console_set_color(0x00E2E8F0, 0x00090D16);
    console_flush_now();
}
extern uint32_t __attribute__((weak)) g_mouse_dbg;
extern uint64_t kernel_dev_fb_write(uint64_t offset, const void *buf, uint64_t len);
static uint64_t dev_fb_pos = 0;

static int dev_open_path(const char *p) {
    if (!p) return -1;
    while (*p == '/' || *p == '\\') p++;
    if (p[0]=='d' && p[1]=='e' && p[2]=='v' && (p[3]=='/' || p[3]=='\\')) {
        const char *n = p + 4;
        if (strcmp(n, "null") == 0)  return 100;
        if (strcmp(n, "zero") == 0)  return 101;
        if (strcmp(n, "kbd") == 0)   return 102;
        if (strcmp(n, "mouse") == 0) return 103;
        if (strcmp(n, "fb0") == 0)   { dev_fb_pos = 0; return 104; }
    }
    return -1;
}
uint64_t syscall_dispatch(SyscallFrame *f, uint64_t num) {
    uint64_t a1 = f->rdi, a2 = f->rsi, a3 = f->rdx;
    sched_tick();
    switch (num) {
        case SYS_EXIT:
            int d = (r3_depth > 0) ? (r3_depth - 1) : 0; r3_exit_code[d] = (int)a1;
            longjmp(r3_ret_jmp[d], 1);
            return 0;
        case SYS_WRITE:
            console_write((const char *)a1, (size_t)a2);
            return a2;
        case SYS_GETCHAR:
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)console_getchar((int)a1);
        case SYS_CLEAR:
            console_clear();
            return 0;
        case SYS_OPEN: { int dfd = dev_open_path((const char *)a1); if (dfd >= 100) return (uint64_t)dfd;
            int wr = 0; if ((const char *)a2) { for (const char *m = (const char *)a2; *m; m++) if (*m=='w'||*m=='a'||*m=='+') wr=1; } if (wr && is_protected_syspath((const char *)a1)) { deny_syspath_write((const char *)a1); return (uint64_t)-13; }
            Fat32File *fp = fat32_open((const char *)a1, (const char *)a2);
            if (!fp) return (uint64_t)-1LL;
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
                if (!fd_tab[i]) { fd_tab[i] = fp; return (uint64_t)i; }
            }
            fat32_close(fp);
            return (uint64_t)-1LL;
        }
        case SYS_READ: {
            if ((int)a1 == 100) return 0;
            if ((int)a1 == 101) { if (a2 && a3) memset((void *)a2, 0, (size_t)a3); return a3; }
            if ((int)a1 == 102 || (int)a1 == 103) {
                InputState st; memset(&st, 0, sizeof(st));
                if (sc_info && sc_info->poll_input) sc_info->poll_input(&st);
                SonionSysInfo *si = (SonionSysInfo *)(uintptr_t)SYSINFO_PAGE_ADDR;
                si->mouse_x = st.mouse_x; si->mouse_y = st.mouse_y;
                si->mouse_btns = st.left_click ? 1 : 0;
                if (st.key_char) si->last_key = (uint8_t)st.key_char;
                if ((int)a1 == 102 && a2 && a3 >= 1) {
                    ((char *)a2)[0] = st.key_char;
                    if (a3 >= 2) ((char *)a2)[1] = (char)st.scan_code;
                    return (a3 >= 2) ? 2 : 1;
                }
                if ((int)a1 == 103 && a2 && a3 >= 12) {
                    int32_t *m = (int32_t *)a2;
                    m[0] = st.mouse_x; m[1] = st.mouse_y; m[2] = st.left_click ? 1 : 0;
                    if (a3 >= 16) { m[3] = (int32_t)g_mouse_dbg; return 16; }
                    return 12;
                }
                return 0;
            }
            if (a1 >= 32 || !fd_tab[a1]) return 0;
            return (uint64_t)fat32_read((void *)a2, 1, (size_t)a3, fd_tab[a1]);
        }
        case SYS_FWRITE:
            if ((int)a1 == 100) return a3;
            if ((int)a1 == 104) { uint64_t w = kernel_dev_fb_write(dev_fb_pos, (const void *)a2, a3); dev_fb_pos += w; return w; }
            if (a1 >= 32 || !fd_tab[a1]) return 0;
            return (uint64_t)fat32_write((const void *)a2, 1, (size_t)a3, fd_tab[a1]);
        case SYS_SEEK:
            if ((int)a1 == 104) { dev_fb_pos = (uint64_t)a2; return 0; }
            if ((int)a1 >= 100) return 0;
            if (a1 >= 32 || !fd_tab[a1]) return (uint64_t)-1LL;
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)fat32_seek(fd_tab[a1], (int64_t)a2, (int)a3);
        case SYS_TELL:
            if ((int)a1 == 104) return dev_fb_pos;
            if ((int)a1 >= 100) return 0;
            if (a1 >= 32 || !fd_tab[a1]) return (uint64_t)-1LL;
            return (uint64_t)fat32_tell(fd_tab[a1]);
        case SYS_CLOSE:
            if (a1 < 32 && fd_tab[a1]) { fat32_close(fd_tab[a1]); fd_tab[a1] = 0; }
            return 0;
        case SYS_MKDIR:
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)fat32_mkdir((const char *)a1);
        case SYS_REMOVE: if (is_protected_syspath((const char *)a1)) { deny_syspath_write((const char *)a1); return (uint64_t)-13; }
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)fat32_remove((const char *)a1);
        case SYS_OPENDIR: {
            Fat32Dir *d = fat32_opendir((const char *)a1);
            if (!d) return (uint64_t)-1LL;
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                if (!dir_tab[i]) { dir_tab[i] = d; return (uint64_t)i; }
            }
            fat32_closedir(d);
            return (uint64_t)-1LL;
        }
        case SYS_READDIR:
            if (a1 >= 8 || !dir_tab[a1]) return 0;
            return (uint64_t)fat32_readdir(dir_tab[a1], (Fat32DirEntry *)a2);
        case SYS_CLOSEDIR:
            if (a1 < 8 && dir_tab[a1]) { fat32_closedir(dir_tab[a1]); dir_tab[a1] = 0; }
            return 0;
        case SYS_TIME:
            return (uint64_t)time(0);
        case SYS_CLOCK:
            return (uint64_t)clock();
        case SYS_REBOOT:
            sys_hw_reboot();
            return 0;
        case SYS_POWEROFF:
            if (sc_info && sc_info->shutdown) sc_info->shutdown();
            return 0;
        case SYS_DISK_INFO: {
            uint64_t *out = (uint64_t *)a1;
            if (out) {
                out[0] = block_get_sector_count();
                out[1] = (uint64_t)fat32_is_mounted();
                strcpy((char *)(out + 2), block_get_driver_name());
                strcpy((char *)(out + 4), fat32_get_type_name());
            }
            return 0;
        }
        case SYS_EXEC:
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)ring3_exec_child((const char *)a1);
        case SYS_BATCH: {
            /* io_uring-style batch: a1 = ptr to uint64_t[count][4] {num,a1,a2,a3}, a2 = count */
            uint64_t (*ops)[4] = (uint64_t (*)[4])a1;
            uint64_t cnt = a2, last = 0;
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
                SyscallFrame sub = *f;
                sub.rdi = ops[i][1];
                sub.rsi = ops[i][2];
                sub.rdx = ops[i][3];
                last = syscall_dispatch(&sub, ops[i][0]);
            }
            return last;
        }
        case 30: { /* SYS_PS: copy compact task list to user buffer */
            typedef struct { int pid, state, cpl; uint32_t mem_kb; uint64_t ticks; char name[24]; } UserTask;
            UserTask *out = (UserTask *)a1;
            int max = (int)a2, n = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TASKS && n < max; i++) {
                TaskInfo *t = sched_get(i);
                if (t && t->state != TASK_UNUSED) {
                    out[n].pid = t->pid; out[n].state = t->state;
                    out[n].cpl = t->cpl; out[n].mem_kb = t->mem_kb;
                    out[n].ticks = t->ticks;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 24; k++) out[n].name[k] = t->name[k];
                    n++;
                }
            }
            return (uint64_t)n;
        }
        case 31: /* SYS_KILL */
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)sched_kill((int)a1);
        case 32: /* SYS_SPAWN_BG */
            return (uint64_t)(int64_t)sched_register_task((const char *)a1, 3, 256);
        default:
            return (uint64_t)-1LL;
    }
}

__attribute__((naked)) static void syscall_entry(void) {
    __asm__ volatile (
        "movq %%rsp, %0\n\t"
        "movq %1, %%rsp\n\t"
        "pushq %0\n\t"
        "pushq %%rcx\n\t"
        "pushq %%r11\n\t"
        "pushq %%rbx\n\t"
        "pushq %%rbp\n\t"
        "pushq %%rdi\n\t"
        "pushq %%rsi\n\t"
        "pushq %%rdx\n\t"
        "pushq %%r8\n\t"
        "pushq %%r9\n\t"
        "pushq %%r10\n\t"
        "movq %%rsp, %%rcx\n\t"
        "movq %%rax, %%rdx\n\t"
        "movq %%rsp, %%rbx\n\t"
        "andq $-16, %%rsp\n\t"
        "subq $32, %%rsp\n\t"
        "call syscall_dispatch\n\t"
        "movq %%rbx, %%rsp\n\t"
        "popq %%r10\n\t"
        "popq %%r9\n\t"
        "popq %%r8\n\t"
        "popq %%rdx\n\t"
        "popq %%rsi\n\t"
        "popq %%rdi\n\t"
        "popq %%rbp\n\t"
        "popq %%rbx\n\t"
        "popq %%r11\n\t"
        "popq %%rcx\n\t"
        "popq %%rsp\n\t"
        "sysretq\n\t"
        : "+m"(sc_user_rsp) : "m"(sc_kstack_top) : "memory"
    );
}

void syscall_init(BootInfo *info) {
    sc_info = info;
    sc_kstack_top = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(sc_kstack[0] + 16384);
    memset(fd_tab, 0, sizeof(fd_tab));
    memset(dir_tab, 0, sizeof(dir_tab));

    uint32_t tlo, thi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdtsc" : "=a"(tlo), "=d"(thi));
    SonionSysInfo *si = (SonionSysInfo *)(uintptr_t)SYSINFO_PAGE_ADDR;
    si->magic      = SYSINFO_MAGIC;
    si->boot_tsc   = ((uint64_t)thi << 32) | tlo;
    si->tsc_per_ms = 2500000ULL;
    si->unix_base  = (uint64_t)time(0);
    si->screen_w   = info ? info->width : 1280;
    si->screen_h   = info ? info->height : 800;
    uint64_t efer = rdmsr(0xC0000080U);
    wrmsr(0xC0000080U, efer | 1ULL);

    uint64_t star = ((uint64_t)GDT_KERNEL_DATA << 48) | ((uint64_t)GDT_KERNEL_CODE << 32);
    wrmsr(0xC0000081U, star);
    wrmsr(0xC0000082U, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)syscall_entry);
    wrmsr(0xC0000084U, 0x200ULL);
}

static int ring3_launch(const char *path, uint64_t load_addr, uint64_t stack_top, size_t max_bytes) {
    Fat32File *fp = fat32_open(path, "rb");
    if (!fp) return -1;

    uint8_t *dest = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)load_addr;
    memset(dest, 0, max_bytes);
    size_t n = fat32_read(dest, 1, max_bytes, fp);
    fat32_close(fp);
    if (n == 0 || r3_depth >= 2) return -2;

    int slot = r3_depth++;
    sc_kstack_top = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(sc_kstack[slot] + 16384);
    r3_exit_code[slot] = 0;
    if (setjmp(r3_ret_jmp[slot]) == 0) {
        uint64_t u_ss = GDT_USER_DATA | 3;
        uint64_t u_cs = GDT_USER_CODE | 3;
        __asm__ volatile (
            "movw %w0, %%ds\n\t"
            "movw %w0, %%es\n\t"
            "movw %w0, %%fs\n\t"
            "movw %w0, %%gs\n\t"
            "pushq %0\n\t"
            "pushq %1\n\t"
            "pushq $0x002\n\t"
            "pushq %2\n\t"
            "pushq %3\n\t"
            "iretq\n\t"
            : : "r"(u_ss), "r"(stack_top), "r"(u_cs), "r"(load_addr) : "memory"
        );
    }
    r3_depth--;
    sc_kstack_top = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(sc_kstack[r3_depth > 0 ? r3_depth - 1 : 0] + 16384);
    return r3_exit_code[slot];
}

int ring3_exec(const char *path) {
    return ring3_launch(path, USER_BASE_ADDR, USER_STACK_TOP, 2 * 1024 * 1024);
}

int ring3_exec_child(const char *path) {
    return ring3_launch(path, 0x02800000ULL, 0x037FFFF0ULL, 4 * 1024 * 1024);
}



void ring3_fault_recover(uint64_t exc, uint64_t rip, uint64_t cr2) {
    if (r3_depth <= 0) return;
    int d = r3_depth - 1;
    console_set_color(0x00FACC15, 0x00090D16);
    console_puts("\n[KERNEL] Ring 3 Fault Caught (EXC=");
    char hex[20];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        uint8_t nib = (rip >> ((15 - i) * 4)) & 0xF;
        hex[i] = (nib < 10) ? ('0' + nib) : ('A' + nib - 10);
    }
    hex[16] = 0;
    console_puts(exc == 14 ? "14 #PF" : (exc == 13 ? "13 #GP" : "FAULT"));
    console_puts(", RIP=0x");
    console_puts(hex);
    console_puts(") -> Terminating faulty app!\n");
    console_set_color(0x00E2E8F0, 0x00090D16);
    console_flush_now();
    char c2hex[20];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        uint8_t nib = (cr2 >> ((15 - i) * 4)) & 0xF;
        c2hex[i] = (nib < 10) ? ('0' + nib) : ('A' + nib - 10);
    }
    c2hex[16] = 0;
    console_puts(" CR2=0x"); console_puts(c2hex); console_puts("\n"); console_flush_now();
    r3_depth = d;
    sc_kstack_top = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(sc_kstack[d > 0 ? d - 1 : 0] + 16384);
    r3_exit_code[d] = -(int)(128 + exc);
    longjmp(r3_ret_jmp[d], 1);
}

FILE: ./kernel/drivers/ahci.c
