#include "drivers/ahci.h"
#include "drivers/pci.h"
#include "blockdev.h"
#include "string.h"

typedef volatile struct {
    uint32_t clb;
    uint32_t clbu;
    uint32_t fb;
    uint32_t fbu;
    uint32_t is;
    uint32_t ie;
    uint32_t cmd;
    uint32_t rsv0;
    uint32_t tfd;
    uint32_t sig;
    uint32_t ssts;
    uint32_t sctl;
    uint32_t serr;
    uint32_t sact;
    uint32_t ci;
    uint32_t sntf;
    uint32_t fbs;
    uint32_t rsv1[11];
    uint32_t vendor[4];
} HbaPort;

typedef volatile struct {
    uint32_t cap;
    uint32_t ghc;
    uint32_t is;
    uint32_t pi;
    uint32_t vs;
    uint32_t ccc_ctl;
    uint32_t ccc_pts;
    uint32_t em_loc;
    uint32_t em_ctl;
    uint32_t cap2;
    uint32_t bohc;
    uint8_t  rsv[116];
    uint8_t  vendor[96];
    HbaPort  ports[32];
} HbaMem;

typedef struct {
    uint16_t flags;
    uint16_t prdtl;
    volatile uint32_t prdbc;
    uint32_t ctba;
    uint32_t ctbau;
    uint32_t rsv1[4];
} HbaCmdHeader;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t dba;
    uint32_t dbau;
    uint32_t rsv0;
    uint32_t dbc;
} HbaPrdtEntry;

typedef struct {
    uint8_t      cfis[64];
    uint8_t      acmd[16];
    uint8_t      rsv[48];
    HbaPrdtEntry prdt[1];
} HbaCmdTbl;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint8_t  fis_type;
    uint8_t  pmport_c;
    uint8_t  command;
    uint8_t  featurel;
    uint8_t  lba0;
    uint8_t  lba1;
    uint8_t  lba2;
    uint8_t  device;
    uint8_t  lba3;
    uint8_t  lba4;
    uint8_t  lba5;
    uint8_t  featureh;
    uint8_t  countl;
    uint8_t  counth;
    uint8_t  icc;
    uint8_t  control;
    uint8_t  rsv1[4];
} FisRegH2D;

static uint8_t ahci_cmd_list[1024]   __attribute__((aligned(1024)));
static uint8_t ahci_fis_buf[256]     __attribute__((aligned(256)));
static uint8_t ahci_cmd_tbl[256]     __attribute__((aligned(128)));
static uint8_t ahci_dma_bounce[65536] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));

static HbaPort *active_port = 0;

static void ahci_stop_cmd(HbaPort *port) {
    port->cmd &= ~(1U << 0);
    port->cmd &= ~(1U << 4);
    while ((port->cmd & (1U << 15)) || (port->cmd & (1U << 14))) {
        __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    }
}

static void ahci_start_cmd(HbaPort *port) {
    while (port->cmd & (1U << 15)) __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    port->cmd |= (1U << 4);
    port->cmd |= (1U << 0);
}

static int ahci_rw_chunk(uint64_t lba, uint16_t count, void *dma_buf, int write) {
    if (!active_port) return -1;
    active_port->is = (uint32_t)-1;

    HbaCmdHeader *hdr = (HbaCmdHeader *)ahci_cmd_list;
    memset((void *)hdr, 0, sizeof(HbaCmdHeader));
    hdr->flags = (sizeof(FisRegH2D) / sizeof(uint32_t)) | (write ? (1 << 6) : 0);
    hdr->prdtl = 1;
    hdr->ctba  = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)ahci_cmd_tbl;
    hdr->ctbau = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)ahci_cmd_tbl >> 32);

    HbaCmdTbl *tbl = (HbaCmdTbl *)ahci_cmd_tbl;
    memset(tbl, 0, sizeof(HbaCmdTbl));
    tbl->prdt[0].dba  = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)dma_buf;
    tbl->prdt[0].dbau = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)dma_buf >> 32);
    tbl->prdt[0].dbc  = (count * 512) - 1;

    FisRegH2D *fis = (FisRegH2D *)tbl->cfis;
    fis->fis_type = 0x27;
    fis->pmport_c = 0x80;
    fis->command  = write ? 0x35 : 0x25; // WRITE DMA EXT / READ DMA EXT
    fis->lba0     = (uint8_t)lba;
    fis->lba1     = (uint8_t)(lba >> 8);
    fis->lba2     = (uint8_t)(lba >> 16);
    fis->device   = 1 << 6;
    fis->lba3     = (uint8_t)(lba >> 24);
    fis->lba4     = (uint8_t)(lba >> 32);
    fis->lba5     = (uint8_t)(lba >> 40);
    fis->countl   = (uint8_t)count;
    fis->counth   = (uint8_t)(count >> 8);

    for (int t = 0; t < 1000000; t++) {
        if (!(active_port->tfd & (0x80 | 0x08))) break;
    }

    active_port->ci = 1;
    while (1) {
        if (!(active_port->ci & 1)) break;
        if (active_port->is & (1U << 30)) return -1;
    }
    return (active_port->is & (1U << 30)) ? -1 : 0;
}

static int ahci_read_sectors(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, void *buf) {
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)buf;
    while (count > 0) {
        uint16_t chunk = (count > 128) ? 128 : (uint16_t)count;
        if (ahci_rw_chunk(lba, chunk, ahci_dma_bounce, 0) != 0) return -1;
        memcpy(dst, ahci_dma_bounce, chunk * 512);
        dst += chunk * 512;
        lba += chunk;
        count -= chunk;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int ahci_write_sectors(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, const void *buf) {
    const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)buf;
    while (count > 0) {
        uint16_t chunk = (count > 128) ? 128 : (uint16_t)count;
        memcpy(ahci_dma_bounce, src, chunk * 512);
        if (ahci_rw_chunk(lba, chunk, ahci_dma_bounce, 1) != 0) return -1;
        src += chunk * 512;
        lba += chunk;
        count -= chunk;
    }
    return 0;
}

int ahci_init(void) {
    PciDevice dev;
    if (!pci_find_class(0x01, 0x06, 0x01, &dev)) return 0;

    pci_enable_bus_master_mmio(&dev);
    uint64_t abar = pci_read32(dev.bus, dev.slot, dev.func, 0x24) & ~0x1FFFULL;
    if (!abar) return 0;

    HbaMem *hba = (HbaMem *)(uintptr_t)abar;
    hba->ghc |= (1U << 31); // Enable AHCI Mode

    uint32_t pi = hba->pi;
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        if (!(pi & (1U << i))) continue;
        HbaPort *port = &hba->ports[i];
        uint32_t ssts = port->ssts;
        uint8_t det = ssts & 0x0F;
        uint8_t ipm = (ssts >> 8) & 0x0F;
        if (det == 3 && ipm == 1 && port->sig == 0x00000101) {
            ahci_stop_cmd(port);
            memset(ahci_cmd_list, 0, sizeof(ahci_cmd_list));
            memset(ahci_fis_buf, 0, sizeof(ahci_fis_buf));
            port->clb  = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)ahci_cmd_list;
            port->clbu = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)ahci_cmd_list >> 32);
            port->fb   = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)ahci_fis_buf;
            port->fbu  = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)ahci_fis_buf >> 32);
            port->serr = (uint32_t)-1;
            port->is   = (uint32_t)-1;
            ahci_start_cmd(port);

            active_port = port;
            BlockDriver drv = {
                .name          = "SATA-AHCI",
                .sector_count  = 0xFFFFFFFFULL,
                .sector_size   = 512,
                .read_sectors  = ahci_read_sectors,
                .write_sectors = ahci_write_sectors
            };
            block_register(&drv);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

FILE: ./kernel/drivers/ata.c
================================================================================

#include "drivers/ata.h"
#include "blockdev.h"

#define ATA_PRIMARY_IO      0x1F0
#define ATA_PRIMARY_CTRL    0x3F6
#define ATA_SECONDARY_IO    0x170
#define ATA_SECONDARY_CTRL  0x376

#define ATA_REG_DATA        0x00
#define ATA_REG_SECCOUNT0   0x02
#define ATA_REG_LBA0        0x03
#define ATA_REG_LBA1        0x04
#define ATA_REG_LBA2        0x05
#define ATA_REG_HDDEVSEL    0x06
#define ATA_REG_COMMAND     0x07
#define ATA_REG_STATUS      0x07

#define ATA_CMD_READ_PIO_EXT   0x24
#define ATA_CMD_WRITE_PIO_EXT  0x34
#define ATA_CMD_CACHE_FLUSH    0xE7
#define ATA_CMD_IDENTIFY       0xEC

#define ATA_SR_BSY  0x80
#define ATA_SR_DRDY 0x40
#define ATA_SR_DRQ  0x08
#define ATA_SR_ERR  0x01

static uint16_t active_io    = 0;
static uint16_t active_ctrl  = 0;
static uint8_t  active_slave = 0;
static uint64_t ata_sectors  = 0;

static inline void outb(uint16_t port, uint8_t val) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"(val), "Nd"(port));
}

static inline uint8_t inb(uint16_t port) {
    uint8_t ret;
    __asm__ volatile ("inb %1, %0" : "=a"(ret) : "Nd"(port));
    return ret;
}

static inline uint16_t inw(uint16_t port) {
    uint16_t ret;
    __asm__ volatile ("inw %1, %0" : "=a"(ret) : "Nd"(port));
    return ret;
}

static inline void outw(uint16_t port, uint16_t val) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outw %0, %1" : : "a"(val), "Nd"(port));
}

static void ata_400ns_delay(uint16_t ctrl) {
    inb(ctrl); inb(ctrl); inb(ctrl); inb(ctrl);
}

static int ata_poll(uint16_t io, int check_drq) {
    for (int timeout = 0; timeout < 1000000; timeout++) {
        uint8_t st = inb(io + ATA_REG_STATUS);
        if (st & ATA_SR_ERR) return -1;
        if (!(st & ATA_SR_BSY)) {
            if (!check_drq || (st & ATA_SR_DRQ)) return 0;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

static int ata_probe_drive(uint16_t io, uint16_t ctrl, uint8_t slave) {
    outb(ctrl, 0x02);
    outb(io + ATA_REG_HDDEVSEL, (uint8_t)(0xA0 | (slave << 4)));
    ata_400ns_delay(ctrl);
    outb(io + ATA_REG_SECCOUNT0, 0);
    outb(io + ATA_REG_LBA0, 0);
    outb(io + ATA_REG_LBA1, 0);
    outb(io + ATA_REG_LBA2, 0);
    outb(io + ATA_REG_COMMAND, ATA_CMD_IDENTIFY);
    ata_400ns_delay(ctrl);
    uint8_t st = inb(io + ATA_REG_STATUS);
    if (st == 0 || st == 0xFF) return 0;
    if (ata_poll(io, 1) != 0) return 0;
    uint16_t id[256];
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) id[i] = inw(io + ATA_REG_DATA);
    uint64_t secs = ((uint64_t)id[103] << 48) | ((uint64_t)id[102] << 32) |
                    ((uint64_t)id[101] << 16) | (uint64_t)id[100];
    if (secs == 0) secs = ((uint64_t)id[61] << 16) | (uint64_t)id[60];
    if (secs == 0) return 0;
    active_io = io; active_ctrl = ctrl; active_slave = slave; ata_sectors = secs;
    return 1;
}

static int ata_read_sectors(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, void *buf) {
    if (!active_io || !buf || count == 0) return -1;
    uint32_t *dst = (uint32_t *)buf;
    while (count > 0) {
        if (ata_poll(active_io, 0) != 0) return -1;
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_HDDEVSEL, (uint8_t)(0xE0 | (active_slave << 4) | ((lba >> 24) & 0x0F)));
        ata_400ns_delay(active_ctrl);
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_SECCOUNT0, 1);
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_LBA0, (uint8_t)(lba & 0xFF));
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_LBA1, (uint8_t)((lba >> 8) & 0xFF));
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_LBA2, (uint8_t)((lba >> 16) & 0xFF));
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_COMMAND, 0x20);
        ata_400ns_delay(active_ctrl);
        if (ata_poll(active_io, 1) != 0) return -1;
        __asm__ volatile ("cld; rep insl" : "+D"(dst) : "c"(128), "d"(active_io + ATA_REG_DATA) : "memory");
        ata_400ns_delay(active_ctrl);
        lba++;
        count--;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int ata_write_sectors(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, const void *buf) {
    if (!active_io || !buf || count == 0) return -1;
    const uint32_t *src = (const uint32_t *)buf;
    while (count > 0) {
        if (ata_poll(active_io, 0) != 0) return -1;
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_HDDEVSEL, (uint8_t)(0xE0 | (active_slave << 4) | ((lba >> 24) & 0x0F)));
        ata_400ns_delay(active_ctrl);
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_SECCOUNT0, 1);
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_LBA0, (uint8_t)(lba & 0xFF));
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_LBA1, (uint8_t)((lba >> 8) & 0xFF));
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_LBA2, (uint8_t)((lba >> 16) & 0xFF));
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_COMMAND, 0x30);
        ata_400ns_delay(active_ctrl);
        if (ata_poll(active_io, 1) != 0) return -1;
        __asm__ volatile ("cld; rep outsl" : "+S"(src) : "c"(128), "d"(active_io + ATA_REG_DATA) : "memory");
        ata_400ns_delay(active_ctrl);
        outb(active_io + ATA_REG_COMMAND, ATA_CMD_CACHE_FLUSH);
        ata_poll(active_io, 0);
        lba++;
        count--;
    }
    return 0;
}
static int drive_has_fs(void) {
    uint8_t sec[512];
    if (ata_read_sectors(0, 1, sec) != 0) return 0;
    if (sec[510] != 0x55 || sec[511] != 0xAA) return 0;
    if (sec[450] != 0 || sec[466] != 0 || sec[482] != 0 || sec[498] != 0) return 1;
    return (sec[11] == 0 && sec[12] == 2 && sec[13] > 0);
}

int ata_init(void) {
    uint16_t ios[4]   = { ATA_PRIMARY_IO, ATA_PRIMARY_IO, ATA_SECONDARY_IO, ATA_SECONDARY_IO };
    uint16_t ctrls[4] = { ATA_PRIMARY_CTRL, ATA_PRIMARY_CTRL, ATA_SECONDARY_CTRL, ATA_SECONDARY_CTRL };
    uint8_t  slvs[4]  = { 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    uint16_t best_io = 0, best_ctrl = 0; uint8_t best_slv = 0; uint64_t best_sec = 0;

    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
        if (ata_probe_drive(ios[d], ctrls[d], slvs[d])) {
            if (!best_io) { best_io = active_io; best_ctrl = active_ctrl; best_slv = active_slave; best_sec = ata_sectors; }
            if (drive_has_fs()) {
                BlockDriver drv = { "ATA-PIO", ata_sectors, 512, ata_read_sectors, ata_write_sectors };
                block_register(&drv); return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if (best_io) {
        active_io = best_io; active_ctrl = best_ctrl; active_slave = best_slv; ata_sectors = best_sec;
        BlockDriver drv = { "ATA-PIO", ata_sectors, 512, ata_read_sectors, ata_write_sectors };
        block_register(&drv); return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}







================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/drivers/blockdev.c
================================================================================

#include "blockdev.h"
#include "drivers/nvme.h"
#include "drivers/ahci.h"
#include "drivers/ata.h"
#include "drivers/usb_msc.h"

static BlockDriver active_driver = { "NONE", 0, 512, 0, 0 };

void block_register(const BlockDriver *drv) {
    if (drv && drv->read_sectors) active_driver = *drv;
}

void block_init(BootInfo *info) {
    (void)info;
    if (nvme_init())    return;
    if (ahci_init())    return;
    if (ata_init())     return;
    if (usb_msc_init()) return;
}

int block_read(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, void *buf) {
    if (!active_driver.read_sectors || count == 0) return -1;
    return active_driver.read_sectors(lba, count, buf);
}

int block_write(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, const void *buf) {
    if (!active_driver.write_sectors || count == 0) return -1;
    return active_driver.write_sectors(lba, count, buf);
}

const char *block_get_driver_name(void) { return active_driver.name; }
uint64_t block_get_sector_count(void)   { return active_driver.sector_count; }


================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/drivers/nvme.c
================================================================================

#include "drivers/nvme.h"
#include "drivers/pci.h"
#include "blockdev.h"
#include "string.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint8_t  opc;
    uint8_t  flags;
    uint16_t cid;
    uint32_t nsid;
    uint64_t rsv0;
    uint64_t mptr;
    uint64_t prp1;
    uint64_t prp2;
    uint32_t cdw10;
    uint32_t cdw11;
    uint32_t cdw12;
    uint32_t cdw13;
    uint32_t cdw14;
    uint32_t cdw15;
} NvmeCmd;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint32_t dw0;
    uint32_t dw1;
    uint16_t sq_head;
    uint16_t sq_id;
    uint16_t cid;
    uint16_t status;
} NvmeCqe;

#define NVME_Q_DEPTH 16

static NvmeCmd admin_sq[NVME_Q_DEPTH] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static NvmeCqe admin_cq[NVME_Q_DEPTH] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static NvmeCmd io_sq[NVME_Q_DEPTH]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static NvmeCqe io_cq[NVME_Q_DEPTH]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint8_t nvme_dma_page[4096]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));

static volatile uint8_t *nvme_mmio = 0;
static uint32_t db_stride = 4;

static uint16_t asq_tail = 0, acq_head = 0, acq_phase = 1;
static uint16_t isq_tail = 0, icq_head = 0, icq_phase = 1;
static uint16_t next_cid = 1;

static uint32_t native_block_size = 512;
static uint64_t total_512_sectors = 0;

static inline uint32_t nvme_read32(uint32_t off) {
    return *(volatile uint32_t *)(nvme_mmio + off);
}

static inline void nvme_write32(uint32_t off, uint32_t val) {
    *(volatile uint32_t *)(nvme_mmio + off) = val;
}

static inline uint64_t nvme_read64(uint32_t off) {
    uint32_t lo = nvme_read32(off);
    uint32_t hi = nvme_read32(off + 4);
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static inline void nvme_write64(uint32_t off, uint64_t val) {
    nvme_write32(off, (uint32_t)(val & 0xFFFFFFFFULL));
    nvme_write32(off + 4, (uint32_t)(val >> 32));
}

static inline void nvme_ring_sq_db(uint16_t qid, uint16_t tail) {
    nvme_write32(0x1000 + (2 * qid) * db_stride, tail);
}

static inline void nvme_ring_cq_db(uint16_t qid, uint16_t head) {
    nvme_write32(0x1000 + (2 * qid + 1) * db_stride, head);
}

static int nvme_submit_sync(uint16_t qid, NvmeCmd *sq, NvmeCqe *cq,
                            uint16_t *sq_tail, uint16_t *cq_head, uint16_t *cq_phase,
                            const NvmeCmd *cmd) {
    uint16_t tail = *sq_tail;
    sq[tail] = *cmd;
    sq[tail].cid = next_cid++;

    tail = (tail + 1) % NVME_Q_DEPTH;
    *sq_tail = tail;
    nvme_ring_sq_db(qid, tail);

    uint16_t head = *cq_head;
    uint16_t phase = *cq_phase;

    for (uint32_t timeout = 0; timeout < 50000000U; timeout++) {
        volatile NvmeCqe *entry = &cq[head];
        uint16_t st = entry->status;
        if ((st & 1) == phase) {
            uint16_t err = (st >> 1) & 0x7FFF;
            head++;
            if (head >= NVME_Q_DEPTH) {
                head = 0;
                phase ^= 1;
            }
            *cq_head = head;
            *cq_phase = phase;
            nvme_ring_cq_db(qid, head);
            return (err == 0) ? 0 : -1;
        }
        __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    }
    return -1;
}

static int nvme_admin_cmd(const NvmeCmd *cmd) {
    return nvme_submit_sync(0, admin_sq, admin_cq, &asq_tail, &acq_head, &acq_phase, cmd);
}

static int nvme_io_cmd(const NvmeCmd *cmd) {
    return nvme_submit_sync(1, io_sq, io_cq, &isq_tail, &icq_head, &icq_phase, cmd);
}

static int nvme_rw_native_blocks(uint64_t dev_lba, uint16_t nblocks, int write) {
    NvmeCmd cmd;
    memset(&cmd, 0, sizeof(cmd));
    cmd.opc   = write ? 0x01 : 0x02; // NVM Write (0x01) / NVM Read (0x02)
    cmd.nsid  = 1;
    cmd.prp1  = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)nvme_dma_page;
    cmd.cdw10 = (uint32_t)(dev_lba & 0xFFFFFFFFULL);
    cmd.cdw11 = (uint32_t)(dev_lba >> 32);
    cmd.cdw12 = (uint32_t)(nblocks - 1);
    return nvme_io_cmd(&cmd);
}

static int nvme_read_sectors(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, void *buf) {
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)buf;
    if (native_block_size == 512) {
        while (count > 0) {
            uint16_t chunk = (count > 8) ? 8 : (uint16_t)count;
            if (nvme_rw_native_blocks(lba, chunk, 0) != 0) return -1;
            memcpy(dst, nvme_dma_page, chunk * 512);
            dst += chunk * 512;
            lba += chunk;
            count -= chunk;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // 4K (4096-byte) Native NVMe Translation
    while (count > 0) {
        uint64_t dev_lba = lba / 8;
        uint32_t sub_off = (uint32_t)(lba % 8);
        uint32_t avail   = 8 - sub_off;
        uint32_t take    = (count < avail) ? count : avail;

        if (nvme_rw_native_blocks(dev_lba, 1, 0) != 0) return -1;
        memcpy(dst, nvme_dma_page + sub_off * 512, take * 512);
        dst += take * 512;
        lba += take;
        count -= take;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int nvme_write_sectors(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, const void *buf) {
    const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)buf;
    if (native_block_size == 512) {
        while (count > 0) {
            uint16_t chunk = (count > 8) ? 8 : (uint16_t)count;
            memcpy(nvme_dma_page, src, chunk * 512);
            if (nvme_rw_native_blocks(lba, chunk, 1) != 0) return -1;
            src += chunk * 512;
            lba += chunk;
            count -= chunk;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // 4K (4096-byte) Native NVMe Read-Modify-Write
    while (count > 0) {
        uint64_t dev_lba = lba / 8;
        uint32_t sub_off = (uint32_t)(lba % 8);
        uint32_t avail   = 8 - sub_off;
        uint32_t take    = (count < avail) ? count : avail;

        if (take < 8) {
            if (nvme_rw_native_blocks(dev_lba, 1, 0) != 0) return -1;
        }
        memcpy(nvme_dma_page + sub_off * 512, src, take * 512);
        if (nvme_rw_native_blocks(dev_lba, 1, 1) != 0) return -1;

        src += take * 512;
        lba += take;
        count -= take;
    }
    return 0;
}

int nvme_init(void) {
    PciDevice dev;
    // PCI Class 0x01 (Mass Storage), Subclass 0x08 (NVM), ProgIF 0x02 (NVMe)
    if (!pci_find_class(0x01, 0x08, 0x02, &dev)) return 0;

    pci_enable_bus_master_mmio(&dev);
    if (!dev.bar0) return 0;

    nvme_mmio = (volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)dev.bar0;
    uint64_t cap = nvme_read64(0x00);
    uint32_t dstrd = (uint32_t)((cap >> 32) & 0xF);
    db_stride = 4U << dstrd;

    // 1. Reset Controller (CC.EN = 0) and wait for CSTS.RDY == 0
    uint32_t cc = nvme_read32(0x14);
    if (cc & 1) {
        nvme_write32(0x14, cc & ~1U);
        for (uint32_t t = 0; t < 50000000U; t++) {
            if (!(nvme_read32(0x1C) & 1)) break;
            __asm__ volatile ("pause");
        }
    }

    memset(admin_sq, 0, sizeof(admin_sq));
    memset(admin_cq, 0, sizeof(admin_cq));
    memset(io_sq,    0, sizeof(io_sq));
    memset(io_cq,    0, sizeof(io_cq));
    asq_tail = acq_head = 0; acq_phase = 1;
    isq_tail = icq_head = 0; icq_phase = 1;

    // 2. Configure Admin Queue Attributes & Base Addresses
    nvme_write32(0x24, ((NVME_Q_DEPTH - 1) << 16) | (NVME_Q_DEPTH - 1));
    nvme_write64(0x28, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)admin_sq);
    nvme_write64(0x30, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)admin_cq);

    // 3. Enable Controller (IOSQES=6 [64B], IOCQES=4 [16B], MPS=0 [4KB], CSS=0, EN=1)
    cc = (4U << 20) | (6U << 16) | 1U;
    nvme_write32(0x14, cc);

    int ready = 0;
    for (uint32_t t = 0; t < 50000000U; t++) {
        uint32_t csts = nvme_read32(0x1C);
        if (csts & 2) return 0; // CFS: Controller Fatal Status
        if (csts & 1) { ready = 1; break; }
        __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    }
    if (!ready) return 0;

    // 4. Identify Namespace 1 (CNS = 0) to detect 512B vs 4096B LBA size & total capacity
    memset(nvme_dma_page, 0, sizeof(nvme_dma_page));
    NvmeCmd id_cmd;
    memset(&id_cmd, 0, sizeof(id_cmd));
    id_cmd.opc   = 0x06;
    id_cmd.nsid  = 1;
    id_cmd.prp1  = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)nvme_dma_page;
    id_cmd.cdw10 = 0;
    if (nvme_admin_cmd(&id_cmd) != 0) return 0;

    uint64_t nsze = *(uint64_t *)(nvme_dma_page + 0);
    uint8_t flbas = nvme_dma_page[26] & 0x0F;
    uint32_t lbaf = *(uint32_t *)(nvme_dma_page + 128 + flbas * 4);
    uint8_t lbads = (uint8_t)((lbaf >> 16) & 0xFF);
    native_block_size = (lbads >= 9) ? (1U << lbads) : 512U;
    total_512_sectors = nsze * (native_block_size / 512U);

    // 5. Create I/O Completion Queue (QID = 1)
    NvmeCmd cq_cmd;
    memset(&cq_cmd, 0, sizeof(cq_cmd));
    cq_cmd.opc   = 0x05;
    cq_cmd.prp1  = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)io_cq;
    cq_cmd.cdw10 = ((NVME_Q_DEPTH - 1) << 16) | 1U;
    cq_cmd.cdw11 = 1U; // Physically Contiguous
    if (nvme_admin_cmd(&cq_cmd) != 0) return 0;

    // 6. Create I/O Submission Queue (QID = 1 -> CQID = 1)
    NvmeCmd sq_cmd;
    memset(&sq_cmd, 0, sizeof(sq_cmd));
    sq_cmd.opc   = 0x01;
    sq_cmd.prp1  = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)io_sq;
    sq_cmd.cdw10 = ((NVME_Q_DEPTH - 1) << 16) | 1U;
    sq_cmd.cdw11 = (1U << 16) | 1U; // CQID = 1, Physically Contiguous
    if (nvme_admin_cmd(&sq_cmd) != 0) return 0;

    BlockDriver drv = {
        .name          = "PCIe-NVMe",
        .sector_count  = total_512_sectors,
        .sector_size   = 512,
        .read_sectors  = nvme_read_sectors,
        .write_sectors = nvme_write_sectors
    };
    block_register(&drv);
    return 1;
}


================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/drivers/pci.c

#include "drivers/pci.h"

#define PCI_CONFIG_ADDR 0xCF8
#define PCI_CONFIG_DATA 0xCFC

static inline void outl(uint16_t port, uint32_t val) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outl %0, %1" : : "a"(val), "Nd"(port));
}

static inline uint32_t inl(uint16_t port) {
    uint32_t ret;
    __asm__ volatile ("inl %1, %0" : "=a"(ret) : "Nd"(port));
    return ret;
}

uint32_t pci_read32(uint8_t bus, uint8_t slot, uint8_t func, uint8_t offset) {
    uint32_t addr = (1U << 31)
                  | ((uint32_t)bus  << 16)
                  | ((uint32_t)slot << 11)
                  | ((uint32_t)func << 8)
                  | (offset & 0xFC);
    outl(PCI_CONFIG_ADDR, addr);
    return inl(PCI_CONFIG_DATA);
}

void pci_write32(uint8_t bus, uint8_t slot, uint8_t func, uint8_t offset, uint32_t val) {
    uint32_t addr = (1U << 31)
                  | ((uint32_t)bus  << 16)
                  | ((uint32_t)slot << 11)
                  | ((uint32_t)func << 8)
                  | (offset & 0xFC);
    outl(PCI_CONFIG_ADDR, addr);
    outl(PCI_CONFIG_DATA, val);
}

uint16_t pci_read16(uint8_t bus, uint8_t slot, uint8_t func, uint8_t offset) {
    uint32_t val = pci_read32(bus, slot, func, offset & 0xFC);
    return (uint16_t)((val >> ((offset & 2) * 8)) & 0xFFFF);
}

void pci_write16(uint8_t bus, uint8_t slot, uint8_t func, uint8_t offset, uint16_t val) {
    uint32_t aligned = offset & 0xFC;
    uint32_t shift = (offset & 2) * 8;
    uint32_t cur = pci_read32(bus, slot, func, aligned);
    cur = (cur & ~(0xFFFFU << shift)) | ((uint32_t)val << shift);
    pci_write32(bus, slot, func, aligned, cur);
}

uint8_t pci_read8(uint8_t bus, uint8_t slot, uint8_t func, uint8_t offset) {
    uint32_t val = pci_read32(bus, slot, func, offset & 0xFC);
    return (uint8_t)((val >> ((offset & 3) * 8)) & 0xFF);
}

static uint64_t read_bar_addr(uint8_t bus, uint8_t slot, uint8_t func, uint8_t bar_offset) {
    uint32_t lo = pci_read32(bus, slot, func, bar_offset);
    if (lo & 1) {
        return (uint64_t)(lo & ~0x3U);
    }
    uint8_t type = (lo >> 1) & 0x3;
    uint64_t addr = (uint64_t)(lo & ~0xFU);
    if (type == 0x2) {
        uint64_t hi = pci_read32(bus, slot, func, bar_offset + 4);
        addr |= (hi << 32);
    }
    return addr;
}

int pci_find_class(uint8_t class_code, uint8_t subclass, int prog_if_filter, PciDevice *out_dev) {
    for (uint16_t bus = 0; bus < 256; bus++) {
        for (uint8_t slot = 0; slot < 32; slot++) {
            uint16_t vendor = pci_read16((uint8_t)bus, slot, 0, 0x00);
            if (vendor == 0xFFFF) continue;

            uint8_t header = pci_read8((uint8_t)bus, slot, 0, 0x0E);
            uint8_t max_func = (header & 0x80) ? 8 : 1;

            for (uint8_t func = 0; func < max_func; func++) {
                uint16_t v = pci_read16((uint8_t)bus, slot, func, 0x00);
                if (v == 0xFFFF) continue;

                uint8_t cc  = pci_read8((uint8_t)bus, slot, func, 0x0B);
                uint8_t sub = pci_read8((uint8_t)bus, slot, func, 0x0A);
                uint8_t pif = pci_read8((uint8_t)bus, slot, func, 0x09);

                if (cc == class_code && sub == subclass) {
                    if (prog_if_filter >= 0 && pif != (uint8_t)prog_if_filter) continue;
                    if (out_dev) {
                        out_dev->bus        = (uint8_t)bus;
                        out_dev->slot       = slot;
                        out_dev->func       = func;
                        out_dev->vendor_id  = v;
                        out_dev->device_id  = pci_read16((uint8_t)bus, slot, func, 0x02);
                        out_dev->class_code = cc;
                        out_dev->subclass   = sub;
                        out_dev->prog_if    = pif;
                        out_dev->bar0       = read_bar_addr((uint8_t)bus, slot, func, 0x10);
                        out_dev->bar4       = read_bar_addr((uint8_t)bus, slot, func, 0x20);
                    }
                    return 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void pci_enable_bus_master_mmio(const PciDevice *dev) {
    uint16_t cmd = pci_read16(dev->bus, dev->slot, dev->func, 0x04);
    cmd |= (1 << 1) | (1 << 2); // Memory Space Enable + Bus Master DMA Enable
    cmd &= ~(uint16_t)(1 << 10); // Clear Interrupt Disable if needed
    pci_write16(dev->bus, dev->slot, dev->func, 0x04, cmd);
}


================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/drivers/usb_msc.c
================================================================================

#include "drivers/usb_msc.h"
#include "drivers/pci.h"
#include "blockdev.h"
#include "string.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint64_t param;
    uint32_t status, control;
} XhciTrb;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint64_t base;
    uint32_t size, rsv;
} XhciErstEntry;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint32_t sig, tag, data_len;
    uint8_t  flags, lun, cb_len, cb[16];
} UsbMscCbw;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint32_t sig, tag, residue;
    uint8_t  status;
} UsbMscCsw;

static uint64_t      dcbaa[256]      __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static XhciTrb       cmd_ring[64]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static XhciTrb       evt_ring[64]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static XhciErstEntry erst[1]         __attribute__((aligned(64)));
static uint32_t      dev_ctx[1024]   __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint32_t      in_ctx[1056]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static XhciTrb       ep0_ring[64]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static XhciTrb       bulk_in_ring[64]  __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static XhciTrb       bulk_out_ring[64] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint8_t       usb_dma_buf[4096] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));

static volatile uint8_t *xhci_cap = 0, *xhci_op = 0, *xhci_rt = 0;
static volatile uint32_t *xhci_db = 0;

static uint32_t cmd_idx = 0, cmd_pcs = 1, evt_idx = 0, evt_ccs = 1;
static uint32_t ep0_idx = 0, ep0_pcs = 1, bin_idx = 0, bin_pcs = 1, bout_idx = 0, bout_pcs = 1;
static uint8_t  active_slot = 0, bulk_in_dci = 0, bulk_out_dci = 0;
static uint32_t csw_tag = 1;
static uint64_t usb_sectors = 0;

static inline uint32_t mmio_r32(volatile uint8_t *b, uint32_t o) { return *(volatile uint32_t *)(b + o); }
static inline void mmio_w32(volatile uint8_t *b, uint32_t o, uint32_t v) { *(volatile uint32_t *)(b + o) = v; }
static inline void mmio_w64(volatile uint8_t *b, uint32_t o, uint64_t v) {
    mmio_w32(b, o, (uint32_t)v); mmio_w32(b, o + 4, (uint32_t)(v >> 32));
}

static int xhci_wait_event(uint8_t expected_type, XhciTrb *out_evt) {
    for (uint32_t t = 0; t < 50000000U; t++) {
        volatile XhciTrb *e = &evt_ring[evt_idx];
        uint32_t ctrl = e->control;
        if ((ctrl & 1U) == evt_ccs) {
            if (out_evt) *out_evt = *e;
            evt_idx++;
            if (evt_idx >= 63) { evt_idx = 0; evt_ccs ^= 1; }
            uint64_t erdp = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&evt_ring[evt_idx];
            mmio_w64(xhci_rt, 0x38, erdp | (1ULL << 3));
            uint8_t type = (uint8_t)((ctrl >> 10) & 0x3F);
            if (expected_type == 0 || type == expected_type) return 0;
        }
        __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    }
    return -1;
}

static int xhci_send_cmd(uint64_t param, uint32_t status, uint32_t ctrl, XhciTrb *out_evt) {
    cmd_ring[cmd_idx].param   = param;
    cmd_ring[cmd_idx].status  = status;
    cmd_ring[cmd_idx].control = (ctrl & ~1U) | cmd_pcs;
    cmd_idx++;
    if (cmd_idx >= 63) {
        cmd_ring[63].param   = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cmd_ring;
        cmd_ring[63].status  = 0;
        cmd_ring[63].control = (6U << 10) | 2U | cmd_pcs;
        cmd_idx = 0; cmd_pcs ^= 1;
    }
    xhci_db[0] = 0;
    return xhci_wait_event(33, out_evt);
}

static int xhci_ctrl_xfer(uint8_t rt, uint8_t rq, uint16_t val, uint16_t idx, void *data, uint16_t len) {
    uint64_t setup = (uint64_t)rt | ((uint64_t)rq << 8) | ((uint64_t)val << 16) |
                     ((uint64_t)idx << 32) | ((uint64_t)len << 48);
    uint32_t trt = (len == 0) ? 0 : ((rt & 0x80) ? 3 : 2);
    ep0_ring[ep0_idx].param = setup; ep0_ring[ep0_idx].status = 8;
    ep0_ring[ep0_idx].control = (2U << 10) | (1U << 6) | (trt << 16) | ep0_pcs; ep0_idx++;
    if (len > 0) {
        ep0_ring[ep0_idx].param = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)data; ep0_ring[ep0_idx].status = len;
        ep0_ring[ep0_idx].control = (3U << 10) | ((rt & 0x80) ? (1U << 16) : 0) | ep0_pcs; ep0_idx++;
    }
    ep0_ring[ep0_idx].param = 0; ep0_ring[ep0_idx].status = 0;
    ep0_ring[ep0_idx].control = (4U << 10) | (1U << 5) | ((len > 0 && (rt & 0x80)) ? 0 : (1U << 16)) | ep0_pcs; ep0_idx++;
    if (ep0_idx >= 60) {
        ep0_ring[ep0_idx].param = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ep0_ring; ep0_ring[ep0_idx].status = 0;
        ep0_ring[ep0_idx].control = (6U << 10) | 2U | ep0_pcs; ep0_idx = 0; ep0_pcs ^= 1;
    }
    xhci_db[active_slot] = 1;
    XhciTrb evt;
    return (xhci_wait_event(32, &evt) == 0 && ((evt.status >> 24) & 0xFF) == 1) ? 0 : -1;
}
static int xhci_bulk_xfer(int is_in, void *buf, uint32_t len) {
    XhciTrb *ring = is_in ? bulk_in_ring : bulk_out_ring;
    uint32_t *idx = is_in ? &bin_idx : &bout_idx;
    uint32_t *pcs = is_in ? &bin_pcs : &bout_pcs;
    uint8_t dci   = is_in ? bulk_in_dci : bulk_out_dci;

    ring[*idx].param   = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)buf;
    ring[*idx].status  = len;
    ring[*idx].control = (1U << 10) | (1U << 5) | (*pcs);
    (*idx)++;
    if (*idx >= 63) {
        ring[63].param   = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ring;
        ring[63].status  = 0;
        ring[63].control = (6U << 10) | 2U | (*pcs);
        *idx = 0; (*pcs) ^= 1;
    }
    xhci_db[active_slot] = dci;
    XhciTrb evt;
    if (xhci_wait_event(32, &evt) != 0) return -1;
    uint8_t cc = (uint8_t)((evt.status >> 24) & 0xFF);
    return (cc == 1 || cc == 13) ? 0 : -1;
}

static int usb_msc_scsi_cmd(const uint8_t *cdb, uint8_t cdb_len, int is_in, void *data, uint32_t data_len) {
    UsbMscCbw *cbw = (UsbMscCbw *)usb_dma_buf;
    memset(cbw, 0, sizeof(UsbMscCbw));
    cbw->sig = 0x43425355U; cbw->tag = csw_tag++; cbw->data_len = data_len;
    cbw->flags = is_in ? 0x80 : 0x00; cbw->cb_len = cdb_len;
    memcpy(cbw->cb, cdb, cdb_len);

    if (xhci_bulk_xfer(0, cbw, 31) != 0) return -1;
    if (data_len > 0) {
        if (!is_in) memcpy(usb_dma_buf + 64, data, data_len);
        if (xhci_bulk_xfer(is_in, usb_dma_buf + 64, data_len) != 0) return -1;
        if (is_in) memcpy(data, usb_dma_buf + 64, data_len);
    }
    if (xhci_bulk_xfer(1, usb_dma_buf, 13) != 0) return -1;
    UsbMscCsw *csw = (UsbMscCsw *)usb_dma_buf;
    return (csw->sig == 0x53425355U && csw->status == 0) ? 0 : -1;
}

static int usb_msc_read_sectors(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, void *buf) {
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)buf;
    while (count > 0) {
        uint16_t chunk = (count > 7) ? 7 : (uint16_t)count;
        uint8_t cdb[10] = { 0x28, 0, (uint8_t)(lba >> 24), (uint8_t)(lba >> 16), (uint8_t)(lba >> 8), (uint8_t)lba, 0, (uint8_t)(chunk >> 8), (uint8_t)chunk, 0 };
        if (usb_msc_scsi_cmd(cdb, 10, 1, dst, chunk * 512) != 0) return -1;
        dst += chunk * 512; lba += chunk; count -= chunk;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int usb_msc_write_sectors(uint64_t lba, uint32_t count, const void *buf) {
    const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)buf;
    while (count > 0) {
        uint16_t chunk = (count > 7) ? 7 : (uint16_t)count;
        uint8_t cdb[10] = { 0x2A, 0, (uint8_t)(lba >> 24), (uint8_t)(lba >> 16), (uint8_t)(lba >> 8), (uint8_t)lba, 0, (uint8_t)(chunk >> 8), (uint8_t)chunk, 0 };
        if (usb_msc_scsi_cmd(cdb, 10, 0, (void *)src, chunk * 512) != 0) return -1;
        src += chunk * 512; lba += chunk; count -= chunk;
    }
    return 0;
}

int usb_msc_init(void) {
    PciDevice dev;
    if (!pci_find_class(0x0C, 0x03, 0x30, &dev)) return 0;
    pci_enable_bus_master_mmio(&dev);
    if (!dev.bar0) return 0;

    xhci_cap = (volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)dev.bar0;
    uint32_t hcs1 = mmio_r32(xhci_cap, 0x04);
    xhci_op = xhci_cap + *(volatile uint8_t *)xhci_cap;
    xhci_db = (volatile uint32_t *)(xhci_cap + (mmio_r32(xhci_cap, 0x14) & ~3U));
    xhci_rt = xhci_cap + (mmio_r32(xhci_cap, 0x18) & ~0x1FU);

    mmio_w32(xhci_op, 0, mmio_r32(xhci_op, 0) & ~1U);
    for (int t = 0; t < 1000000 && !(mmio_r32(xhci_op, 4) & 1); t++);
    mmio_w32(xhci_op, 0, 2U);
    for (int t = 0; t < 1000000 && ((mmio_r32(xhci_op, 0) & 2U) || (mmio_r32(xhci_op, 4) & (1U << 11))); t++);

    memset(dcbaa, 0, sizeof(dcbaa)); memset(cmd_ring, 0, sizeof(cmd_ring)); memset(evt_ring, 0, sizeof(evt_ring));
    cmd_idx = evt_idx = 0; cmd_pcs = evt_ccs = 1;
    mmio_w32(xhci_op, 0x38, hcs1 & 0xFF);
    mmio_w64(xhci_op, 0x30, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)dcbaa);
    mmio_w64(xhci_op, 0x18, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cmd_ring | 1ULL);
    erst[0].base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)evt_ring; erst[0].size = 64;
    mmio_w32(xhci_rt, 0x28, 1); mmio_w64(xhci_rt, 0x38, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)evt_ring); mmio_w64(xhci_rt, 0x30, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)erst);
    mmio_w32(xhci_op, 0, 1U);
    for (int t = 0; t < 1000000 && (mmio_r32(xhci_op, 4) & 1); t++);

    uint8_t ports = (uint8_t)((hcs1 >> 24) & 0xFF), port = 0; uint32_t spd = 0;
    for (uint8_t p = 1; p <= ports; p++) {
        uint32_t off = 0x400 + (p - 1) * 0x10, sc = mmio_r32(xhci_op, off);
        if (sc & 1U) {
            if (!(sc & 2U)) { mmio_w32(xhci_op, off, (sc & 0x0E00C3E0U) | 16U); for (int t = 0; t < 2000000 && !(mmio_r32(xhci_op, off) & 2U); t++); }
            sc = mmio_r32(xhci_op, off);
            if (sc & 2U) { port = p; spd = (sc >> 10) & 0xF; break; }
        }
    }
    if (!port) return 0;

    XhciTrb evt;
    if (xhci_send_cmd(0, 0, (9U << 10), &evt) != 0) return 0;
    active_slot = (uint8_t)((evt.control >> 24) & 0xFF);
    if (!active_slot) return 0;

    memset(dev_ctx, 0, sizeof(dev_ctx)); memset(in_ctx, 0, sizeof(in_ctx)); memset(ep0_ring, 0, sizeof(ep0_ring));
    ep0_idx = 0; ep0_pcs = 1; dcbaa[active_slot] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)dev_ctx;
    uint16_t mps0 = (spd == 4) ? 512 : ((spd == 3) ? 64 : 8);
    in_ctx[1] = 3U; in_ctx[8] = (1U << 27) | (spd << 20); in_ctx[9] = ((uint32_t)port << 16);
    in_ctx[17] = (4U << 3) | ((uint32_t)mps0 << 16); in_ctx[18] = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)ep0_ring | 1U); in_ctx[19] = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)ep0_ring >> 32);
    if (xhci_send_cmd((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)in_ctx, 0, (11U << 10) | ((uint32_t)active_slot << 24), &evt) != 0) return 0;

    memset(usb_dma_buf, 0, 256);
    if (xhci_ctrl_xfer(0x80, 0x06, 0x0200, 0, usb_dma_buf, 64) != 0) return 0;
    int msc = 0; uint8_t ein = 0, eout = 0; uint16_t emps = 512;
    uint8_t *p = usb_dma_buf, *end = usb_dma_buf + 64;
    while (p + 2 <= end && p[0] >= 2) {
        if (p[1] == 4 && p[0] >= 9 && p[5] == 0x08 && p[6] == 0x06 && p[7] == 0x50) msc = 1;
        else if (msc && p[1] == 5 && p[0] >= 7) {
            emps = (uint16_t)p[4] | ((uint16_t)p[5] << 8);
            if (p[2] & 0x80) ein = p[2] & 0x0F; else eout = p[2] & 0x0F;
        }
        p += p[0];
    }
    if (!msc || !ein || !eout) return 0;

    bulk_in_dci = ein * 2 + 1; bulk_out_dci = eout * 2;
    memset(in_ctx, 0, sizeof(in_ctx)); memset(bulk_in_ring, 0, sizeof(bulk_in_ring)); memset(bulk_out_ring, 0, sizeof(bulk_out_ring));
    bin_idx = bout_idx = 0; bin_pcs = bout_pcs = 1;
    uint32_t mdci = (bulk_in_dci > bulk_out_dci) ? bulk_in_dci : bulk_out_dci;
    in_ctx[1] = 1U | (1U << bulk_in_dci) | (1U << bulk_out_dci); in_ctx[8] = (mdci << 27) | (spd << 20); in_ctx[9] = ((uint32_t)port << 16);
    uint32_t oo = (bulk_out_dci + 1) * 8, io = (bulk_in_dci + 1) * 8;
    in_ctx[oo + 1] = (2U << 3) | ((uint32_t)emps << 16); in_ctx[oo + 2] = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)bulk_out_ring | 1U); in_ctx[oo + 3] = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)bulk_out_ring >> 32);
    in_ctx[io + 1] = (6U << 3) | ((uint32_t)emps << 16); in_ctx[io + 2] = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)bulk_in_ring | 1U); in_ctx[io + 3] = (uint32_t)((uintptr_t)bulk_in_ring >> 32);

    if (xhci_send_cmd((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)in_ctx, 0, (12U << 10) | ((uint32_t)active_slot << 24), &evt) != 0) return 0;
    if (xhci_ctrl_xfer(0x00, 0x09, usb_dma_buf[5], 0, 0, 0) != 0) return 0;

    uint8_t cdb[10] = { 0x25, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }, resp[8];
    if (usb_msc_scsi_cmd(cdb, 10, 1, resp, 8) != 0) return 0;
    usb_sectors = (uint64_t)(((uint32_t)resp[0] << 24) | ((uint32_t)resp[1] << 16) | ((uint32_t)resp[2] << 8) | resp[3]) + 1;

    BlockDriver drv = { "USB-MSC(xHCI)", usb_sectors, 512, usb_msc_read_sectors, usb_msc_write_sectors };
    block_register(&drv);
    return 1;
}




================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/fs/fat32.c

#include "fs/fat32.h"
#include "blockdev.h"
#include "string.h"
#include "ctype.h"

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint8_t  jmp[3];
    char     oem[8];
    uint16_t bytes_per_sector;
    uint8_t  sectors_per_cluster;
    uint16_t reserved_sectors;
    uint8_t  num_fats;
    uint16_t root_entry_count;
    uint16_t total_sectors_16;
    uint8_t  media;
    uint16_t fat_size_16;
    uint16_t sectors_per_track;
    uint16_t num_heads;
    uint32_t hidden_sectors;
    uint32_t total_sectors_32;
    uint32_t fat_size_32;
    uint16_t ext_flags;
    uint16_t fs_version;
    uint32_t root_cluster;
    uint16_t fs_info;
    uint16_t backup_boot_sector;
    uint8_t  reserved[12];
    uint8_t  drive_number;
    uint8_t  reserved1;
    uint8_t  boot_signature;
    uint32_t volume_id;
    char     volume_label[11];
    char     fs_type[8];
} Fat32Bpb;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    char     name[11];
    uint8_t  attr;
    uint8_t  ntres;
    uint8_t  crt_time_tenth;
    uint16_t crt_time;
    uint16_t crt_date;
    uint16_t lst_acc_date;
    uint16_t fst_clus_hi;
    uint16_t wrt_time;
    uint16_t wrt_date;
    uint16_t fst_clus_lo;
    uint32_t file_size;
} Fat32ShortEnt;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint8_t  seq;
    uint16_t name1[5];
    uint8_t  attr;
    uint8_t  type;
    uint8_t  checksum;
    uint16_t name2[6];
    uint16_t fst_clus_lo;
    uint16_t name3[2];
} Fat32LfnEnt;

#define FAT32_MAX_FILES 32
#define FAT32_MAX_DIRS  8
static Fat32File file_pool[FAT32_MAX_FILES];
static Fat32Dir  dir_pool[FAT32_MAX_DIRS];

static int      mounted = 0;
static int      is_fat16 = 0;
static uint32_t spc = 0;
static uint8_t  num_fats = 2;
static uint32_t fat_start_lba = 0;
static uint32_t fat_sectors = 0;
static uint32_t root_dir_lba = 0;
static uint32_t root_dir_sectors = 0;
static uint32_t data_start_lba = 0;
static uint32_t root_cluster = 2;
static uint32_t total_clusters = 0;
static uint8_t  sec_buf[512];

static uint64_t cluster_to_lba(uint32_t clus) {
    return (uint64_t)data_start_lba + (uint64_t)(clus - 2) * spc;
}

static uint32_t fat_get_next(uint32_t clus) {
    uint32_t off = is_fat16 ? (clus * 2) : (clus * 4);
    if (block_read(fat_start_lba + (off / 512), 1, sec_buf) != 0) return 0x0FFFFFFF;
    if (is_fat16) {
        /* Normalize FAT16 EOC (0xFFF8..0xFFFF) to 0x0FFFFFFF */
        uint16_t v = *(uint16_t *)(sec_buf + (off % 512));
        return (v >= 0xFFF8U) ? 0x0FFFFFFF : (uint32_t)v;
    }
    return (*(uint32_t *)(sec_buf + (off % 512))) & 0x0FFFFFFF;
}

static int fat_set_next(uint32_t clus, uint32_t val) {
    uint32_t off = is_fat16 ? (clus * 2) : (clus * 4);
    uint32_t rel_sec = off / 512;
    uint32_t ent_off = off % 512;
    for (uint8_t f = 0; f < num_fats; f++) {
        uint64_t lba = (uint64_t)fat_start_lba + (uint64_t)f * fat_sectors + rel_sec;
        if (block_read(lba, 1, sec_buf) != 0) return -1;
        if (is_fat16) {
        /* Normalize FAT16 EOC (0xFFF8..0xFFFF) to 0x0FFFFFFF */
            uint16_t *p = (uint16_t *)(sec_buf + ent_off);
            *p = (val >= 0x0FFFFFF8U) ? 0xFFFFU : (uint16_t)val;
        } else {
            uint32_t *p = (uint32_t *)(sec_buf + ent_off);
            *p = (*p & 0xF0000000U) | (val & 0x0FFFFFFFU);
        }
        if (block_write(lba, 1, sec_buf) != 0) return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void fat_free_chain(uint32_t start_clus) {
    uint32_t c = start_clus;
    while (c >= 2 && c < 0x0FFFFFF8U) {
        uint32_t nxt = fat_get_next(c);
        fat_set_next(c, 0);
        c = nxt;
    }
}

static uint32_t fat_alloc_cluster(void) {
    for (uint32_t c = 2; c < total_clusters + 2; c++) {
        if (fat_get_next(c) == 0) {
            fat_set_next(c, 0x0FFFFFFF);
            memset(sec_buf, 0, 512);
            uint64_t lba = cluster_to_lba(c);
            for (uint32_t s = 0; s < spc; s++) block_write(lba + s, 1, sec_buf);
            return c;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int try_mount_vbr(uint64_t lba) {
    if (block_read(lba, 1, sec_buf) != 0) return 0;
    Fat32Bpb *bpb = (Fat32Bpb *)sec_buf;
    if (bpb->bytes_per_sector != 512 || bpb->sectors_per_cluster == 0) return 0;

    spc           = bpb->sectors_per_cluster;
    num_fats      = bpb->num_fats ? bpb->num_fats : 1;
    fat_start_lba = (uint32_t)lba + bpb->reserved_sectors;
    uint32_t tot  = bpb->total_sectors_16 ? bpb->total_sectors_16 : bpb->total_sectors_32;
    if (tot == 0) return 0;

    if (bpb->fat_size_16 != 0) {
        is_fat16         = 1;
        fat_sectors      = bpb->fat_size_16;
        root_dir_lba     = fat_start_lba + (num_fats * fat_sectors);
        root_dir_sectors = ((uint32_t)bpb->root_entry_count * 32 + 511) / 512;
        data_start_lba   = root_dir_lba + root_dir_sectors;
        root_cluster     = 1;
        total_clusters   = (tot - (data_start_lba - (uint32_t)lba)) / spc;
    } else if (bpb->fat_size_32 != 0) {
        is_fat16         = 0;
        fat_sectors      = bpb->fat_size_32;
        root_dir_lba     = 0;
        root_dir_sectors = 0;
        data_start_lba   = fat_start_lba + (num_fats * fat_sectors);
        root_cluster     = bpb->root_cluster ? bpb->root_cluster : 2;
        total_clusters   = (tot - (data_start_lba - (uint32_t)lba)) / spc;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
    mounted = 1;
    return 1;
}

int fat32_init(void) {
    mounted = 0;
    memset(file_pool, 0, sizeof(file_pool));
    memset(dir_pool, 0, sizeof(dir_pool));

    uint8_t hdr[512];
    if (block_read(1, 1, hdr) == 0 && memcmp(hdr, "EFI PART", 8) == 0) {
        uint64_t plba = *(uint64_t *)(hdr + 72);
        uint32_t npart = *(uint32_t *)(hdr + 80);
        uint32_t esz = *(uint32_t *)(hdr + 84);
        if (npart > 32) npart = 32;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < npart; i++) {
            if (block_read(plba + (i * esz) / 512, 1, sec_buf) == 0) {
                uint64_t flba = *(uint64_t *)(sec_buf + ((i * esz) % 512) + 32);
                if (flba > 0 && try_mount_vbr(flba)) return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if (block_read(0, 1, hdr) == 0 && hdr[510] == 0x55 && hdr[511] == 0xAA) {
        for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
            uint8_t type = hdr[446 + p * 16 + 4];
            uint32_t start = *(uint32_t *)(hdr + 446 + p * 16 + 8);
            if (type != 0 && start > 0 && try_mount_vbr(start)) return 1;
        }
    }
    return try_mount_vbr(0);
}

int fat32_is_mounted(void) { return mounted; }
const char *fat32_get_type_name(void) { return !mounted ? "NONE" : (is_fat16 ? "FAT16" : "FAT32"); }

static int name_eq_nocase(const char *a, const char *b) {
    while (*a && *b) {
        if (tolower((unsigned char)*a) != tolower((unsigned char)*b)) return 0;
        a++; b++;
    }
    return *a == *b;
}

static void decode_short83(const char raw[11], char out[16]) {
    int p = 0, end8 = 7;
    while (end8 >= 0 && raw[end8] == ' ') end8--;
    for (int i = 0; i <= end8; i++) out[p++] = raw[i];
    int end3 = 10;
    while (end3 >= 8 && raw[end3] == ' ') end3--;
    if (end3 >= 8) {
        out[p++] = '.';
        for (int i = 8; i <= end3; i++) out[p++] = raw[i];
    }
    out[p] = 0;
}

static void extract_lfn_part(const Fat32LfnEnt *lfn, char buf[260]) {
    int idx = ((lfn->seq & 0x1F) - 1) * 13;
    if (idx < 0 || idx > 240) return;
    uint16_t chars[13];
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) chars[i] = lfn->name1[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) chars[i + 5] = lfn->name2[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) chars[i + 11] = lfn->name3[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
        if (chars[i] == 0x0000 || chars[i] == 0xFFFF) { buf[idx + i] = 0; return; }
        buf[idx + i] = (char)(chars[i] & 0xFF);
    }
}

static uint8_t lfn_checksum(const char short83[11]) {
    uint8_t sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) sum = ((sum & 1) ? 0x80 : 0) + (sum >> 1) + (uint8_t)short83[i];
    return sum;
}

static void make_short83(const char *name, char out[11], int suffix) {
    memset(out, ' ', 11);
    const char *dot = strrchr(name, '.');
    int base_end = dot ? (int)(dot - name) : (int)strlen(name);
    int j = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < base_end && j < 8; i++) {
        char c = name[i];
        if (c == ' ' || c == '.') continue;
        out[j++] = (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
    }
    if (suffix > 0) {
        int pos = (j > 6) ? 6 : j;
        out[pos] = '~';
        out[pos + 1] = (char)('0' + (suffix % 10));
    }
    if (dot && dot[1]) {
        j = 8;
        for (int i = 1; dot[i] && j < 11; i++) {
            if (dot[i] != ' ') out[j++] = (char)toupper((unsigned char)dot[i]);
        }
    }
}
static int find_in_dir(uint32_t dir_clus, const char *target, Fat32ShortEnt *out_ent,
                       uint32_t *out_sec, uint32_t *out_off, uint32_t *lfn_start_idx) {
    char lfn_buf[260], short_buf[16];
    int has_lfn = 0;
    uint32_t clus = dir_clus, slot_idx = 0, first_lfn_slot = 0;

    while (((is_fat16 && clus == 1) || (clus >= 2 && clus < 0x0FFFFFF8U))) {
        uint64_t lba = (is_fat16 && clus == 1) ? root_dir_lba : cluster_to_lba(clus);
        uint32_t sec_cnt = (is_fat16 && clus == 1) ? root_dir_sectors : spc; for (uint32_t s = 0; s < sec_cnt; s++) {
            if (block_read(lba + s, 1, sec_buf) != 0) return 0;
            for (uint32_t off = 0; off < 512; off += 32, slot_idx++) {
                Fat32ShortEnt *e = (Fat32ShortEnt *)(sec_buf + off);
                uint8_t first = (uint8_t)e->name[0];
                if (first == 0x00) return 0;
                if (first == 0xE5) { has_lfn = 0; continue; }
                if (e->attr == 0x0F) {
                    Fat32LfnEnt *le = (Fat32LfnEnt *)e;
                    if (le->seq & 0x40) {
                        memset(lfn_buf, 0, sizeof(lfn_buf));
                        has_lfn = 1;
                        first_lfn_slot = slot_idx;
                    }
                    if (has_lfn) extract_lfn_part(le, lfn_buf);
                    continue;
                }
                if (e->attr & 0x08) { has_lfn = 0; continue; }
                decode_short83(e->name, short_buf);
                int match = (has_lfn && name_eq_nocase(lfn_buf, target)) ||
                            name_eq_nocase(short_buf, target);
                if (match) {
                    if (out_ent) *out_ent = *e;
                    if (out_sec) *out_sec = (uint32_t)(lba + s);
                    if (out_off) *out_off = off;
                    if (lfn_start_idx) *lfn_start_idx = has_lfn ? first_lfn_slot : slot_idx;
                    return 1;
                }
                has_lfn = 0;
            }
        }
        clus = (is_fat16 && clus == 1) ? 0x0FFFFFFF : fat_get_next(clus);
    }
    return 0;
}

static int write_dir_slot(uint32_t dir_clus, uint32_t slot_idx, const void *entry32) {
    if (is_fat16 && dir_clus == 1) {
        uint32_t sec = slot_idx / 16;
        if (sec >= root_dir_sectors) return 0;
        uint64_t lba = (uint64_t)root_dir_lba + sec;
        uint32_t off = (slot_idx % 16) * 32;
        if (block_read(lba, 1, sec_buf) != 0) return 0;
        memcpy(sec_buf + off, entry32, 32);
        return block_write(lba, 1, sec_buf) == 0;
    }
    uint32_t entries_per_clus = (spc * 512) / 32;
    uint32_t c_num = slot_idx / entries_per_clus;
    uint32_t rem   = slot_idx % entries_per_clus;
    uint32_t c = dir_clus;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < c_num; i++) {
        uint32_t nxt = fat_get_next(c);
        if (nxt >= 0x0FFFFFF8U || nxt < 2) {
            nxt = fat_alloc_cluster();
            if (!nxt) return 0;
            fat_set_next(c, nxt);
        }
        c = nxt;
    }
    uint64_t lba = cluster_to_lba(c) + (rem / 16);
    uint32_t off = (rem % 16) * 32;
    if (block_read(lba, 1, sec_buf) != 0) return 0;
    memcpy(sec_buf + off, entry32, 32);
    return block_write(lba, 1, sec_buf) == 0;
}

static int create_entry_in_dir(uint32_t dir_clus, const char *name, uint8_t attr,
                               uint32_t start_clus, Fat32ShortEnt *out_ent,
                               uint32_t *out_sec, uint32_t *out_off) {
    int nlen = (int)strlen(name);
    if (nlen <= 0 || nlen > 250) return 0;
    int num_lfn = (nlen + 12) / 13;
    int needed  = num_lfn + 1;

    char short83[11];
    int suffix = 0;
    do {
        make_short83(name, short83, suffix++);
        char test_name[16];
        decode_short83(short83, test_name);
        if (!find_in_dir(dir_clus, test_name, 0, 0, 0, 0)) break;
    } while (suffix < 10);

    uint32_t clus = dir_clus, slot = 0, run_start = 0;
    int run_len = 0, found_run = 0;
    while (((is_fat16 && clus == 1) || (clus >= 2 && clus < 0x0FFFFFF8U)) && !found_run) {
        uint64_t lba = (is_fat16 && clus == 1) ? root_dir_lba : cluster_to_lba(clus);
        uint32_t r_cnt = (is_fat16 && dir_clus == 1) ? root_dir_sectors : spc; for (uint32_t s = 0; s < r_cnt && !found_run; s++) {
            if (block_read(lba + s, 1, sec_buf) != 0) return 0;
            for (uint32_t off = 0; off < 512; off += 32, slot++) {
                uint8_t b = sec_buf[off];
                if (b == 0x00 || b == 0xE5) {
                    if (run_len == 0) run_start = slot;
                    if (++run_len >= needed) { found_run = 1; break; }
                } else {
                    run_len = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!found_run) { if (is_fat16 && dir_clus == 1) return 0;
            uint32_t nxt = fat_get_next(clus);
            if (nxt >= 0x0FFFFFF8U || nxt < 2) {
                nxt = fat_alloc_cluster();
                if (!nxt) return 0;
                fat_set_next(clus, nxt);
            }
            clus = nxt;
        }
    }
    if (!found_run) return 0;

    uint8_t csum = lfn_checksum(short83);
    for (int idx = 0; idx < num_lfn; idx++) {
        int seq = num_lfn - idx;
        Fat32LfnEnt le;
        memset(&le, 0xFF, sizeof(le));
        le.seq         = (uint8_t)(seq | ((idx == 0) ? 0x40 : 0));
        le.attr        = 0x0F;
        le.type        = 0;
        le.checksum    = csum;
        le.fst_clus_lo = 0;

        int base = (seq - 1) * 13;
        uint16_t uchars[13];
        for (int k = 0; k < 13; k++) {
            int pos = base + k;
            if (pos < nlen) uchars[k] = (uint8_t)name[pos];
            else if (pos == nlen) uchars[k] = 0x0000;
            else uchars[k] = 0xFFFF;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) le.name1[k] = uchars[k];
        for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) le.name2[k] = uchars[k + 5];
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) le.name3[k] = uchars[k + 11];
        if (!write_dir_slot(dir_clus, run_start + idx, &le)) return 0;
    }

    Fat32ShortEnt se;
    memset(&se, 0, sizeof(se));
    memcpy(se.name, short83, 11);
    se.attr        = attr;
    se.fst_clus_hi = (uint16_t)(start_clus >> 16);
    se.fst_clus_lo = (uint16_t)(start_clus & 0xFFFF);
    uint32_t short_slot = run_start + num_lfn;
    if (!write_dir_slot(dir_clus, short_slot, &se)) return 0;

    if (out_ent) *out_ent = se;
    if (out_sec || out_off) {
        if (is_fat16 && dir_clus == 1) {
            if (out_sec) *out_sec = root_dir_lba + (short_slot / 16);
            if (out_off) *out_off = (short_slot % 16) * 32;
        } else {
            uint32_t entries_per_clus = (spc * 512) / 32;
            uint32_t c = dir_clus;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < short_slot / entries_per_clus; i++) c = fat_get_next(c);
            uint32_t rem = short_slot % entries_per_clus;
            if (out_sec) *out_sec = (uint32_t)(cluster_to_lba(c) + (rem / 16));
            if (out_off) *out_off = (rem % 16) * 32;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int resolve_parent(const char *path, uint32_t *out_parent, char *out_leaf) {
    while (*path == '/' || *path == '\\') path++;
    uint32_t cur = root_cluster;
    char part[256];
    Fat32ShortEnt ent;

    while (*path) {
        int len = 0;
        while (*path && *path != '/' && *path != '\\' && len < 255) part[len++] = *path++;
        part[len] = 0;
        while (*path == '/' || *path == '\\') path++;
        if (*path == 0) {
            *out_parent = cur;
            strcpy(out_leaf, part);
            return 1;
        }
        if (!find_in_dir(cur, part, &ent, 0, 0, 0) || !(ent.attr & 0x10)) return 0;
        uint32_t clus = ((uint32_t)ent.fst_clus_hi << 16) | ent.fst_clus_lo;
        cur = clus ? clus : root_cluster;
    }
    return 0;
}

Fat32File *fat32_open(const char *path, const char *mode) {
    if (!mounted || !path || !mode) return 0;
    int wr = (strchr(mode, 'w') || strchr(mode, 'a') || strchr(mode, '+'));
    uint32_t parent_clus = 0, dsec = 0, doff = 0;
    char leaf[256];
    if (!resolve_parent(path, &parent_clus, leaf)) return 0;

    Fat32ShortEnt ent;
    int exists = find_in_dir(parent_clus, leaf, &ent, &dsec, &doff, 0);
    if (!exists) {
        if (!wr || !create_entry_in_dir(parent_clus, leaf, 0x20, 0, &ent, &dsec, &doff)) return 0;
    } else if (ent.attr & 0x10) {
        return 0;
    }

    uint32_t clus = ((uint32_t)ent.fst_clus_hi << 16) | ent.fst_clus_lo;
    if (exists && mode[0] == 'w') {
        if (clus >= 2) fat_free_chain(clus);
        clus = 0;
        ent.file_size = 0;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < FAT32_MAX_FILES; i++) {
        if (!file_pool[i].in_use) {
            Fat32File *f = &file_pool[i];
            memset(f, 0, sizeof(Fat32File));
            f->in_use        = 1;
            f->writable      = wr;
            f->first_cluster = clus;
            f->cur_cluster   = clus;
            f->size          = ent.file_size;
            f->pos           = (mode[0] == 'a') ? ent.file_size : 0;
            f->dir_sector    = dsec;
            f->dir_offset    = doff;
            return f;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
static uint32_t seek_to_cluster(Fat32File *f, uint32_t target_idx, int alloc_missing) {
    uint32_t c = f->first_cluster;
    uint32_t start_idx = 0;
    if (c < 2) {
        if (!alloc_missing) return 0;
        c = fat_alloc_cluster();
        if (!c) return 0;
        f->first_cluster = c;
    } else if (target_idx >= f->cur_cluster_idx && f->cur_cluster >= 2) {
        c = f->cur_cluster;
        start_idx = f->cur_cluster_idx;
    }
    for (uint32_t idx = start_idx; idx < target_idx; idx++) {
        uint32_t nxt = fat_get_next(c);
        if (nxt >= 0x0FFFFFF8U || nxt < 2) {
            if (!alloc_missing) return 0;
            nxt = fat_alloc_cluster();
            if (!nxt) return 0;
            fat_set_next(c, nxt);
        }
        c = nxt;
    }
    f->cur_cluster = c;
    f->cur_cluster_idx = target_idx;
    return c;
}

size_t fat32_read(void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, Fat32File *f) {
    if (!f || !f->in_use || !ptr || !size || !nmemb || f->pos >= f->size) return 0;
    uint64_t want = (uint64_t)size * nmemb;
    if (f->pos + want > f->size) want = f->size - f->pos;

    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)ptr;
    uint32_t cbytes = spc * 512;
    size_t total = 0;
    while (want > 0) {
        uint32_t clus = seek_to_cluster(f, f->pos / cbytes, 0);
        if (clus < 2) break;
        uint32_t coff = f->pos % cbytes;
        uint32_t boff = coff % 512;
        uint32_t take = (512 - boff > want) ? (uint32_t)want : (512 - boff);
        if (block_read(cluster_to_lba(clus) + (coff / 512), 1, sec_buf) != 0) break;
        memcpy(dst, sec_buf + boff, take);
        dst += take; f->pos += take; total += take; want -= take;
    }
    return total / size;
}

size_t fat32_write(const void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, Fat32File *f) {
    if (!f || !f->in_use || !f->writable || !ptr || !size || !nmemb) return 0;
    uint64_t want = (uint64_t)size * nmemb;
    const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)ptr;
    uint32_t cbytes = spc * 512;
    size_t total = 0;
    while (want > 0) {
        uint32_t clus = seek_to_cluster(f, f->pos / cbytes, 1);
        if (clus < 2) break;
        uint32_t coff = f->pos % cbytes;
        uint32_t boff = coff % 512;
        uint32_t take = (512 - boff > want) ? (uint32_t)want : (512 - boff);
        uint64_t lba = cluster_to_lba(clus) + (coff / 512);
        if (take < 512 && block_read(lba, 1, sec_buf) != 0) break;
        memcpy(sec_buf + boff, src, take);
        if (block_write(lba, 1, sec_buf) != 0) break;
        src += take; f->pos += take; total += take; want -= take;
        if (f->pos > f->size) f->size = f->pos;
    }
    return total / size;
}

int fat32_seek(Fat32File *f, int64_t offset, int whence) {
    if (!f || !f->in_use) return -1;
    int64_t tgt = (whence == 0) ? offset :
                  ((whence == 1) ? (int64_t)f->pos + offset : (int64_t)f->size + offset);
    if (tgt < 0) return -1;
    f->pos = (uint32_t)tgt;
    return 0;
}

int64_t fat32_tell(Fat32File *f) { return (f && f->in_use) ? (int64_t)f->pos : -1; }

void fat32_close(Fat32File *f) {
    if (!f || !f->in_use) return;
    if (f->writable && f->dir_sector > 0 && block_read(f->dir_sector, 1, sec_buf) == 0) {
        Fat32ShortEnt *e = (Fat32ShortEnt *)(sec_buf + f->dir_offset);
        e->fst_clus_hi = (uint16_t)(f->first_cluster >> 16);
        e->fst_clus_lo = (uint16_t)(f->first_cluster & 0xFFFF);
        e->file_size   = f->size;
        block_write(f->dir_sector, 1, sec_buf);
    }
    f->in_use = 0;
}

int fat32_remove(const char *path) {
    if (!mounted || !path) return -1;
    uint32_t pclus = 0, lfn_start = 0;
    char leaf[256];
    if (!resolve_parent(path, &pclus, leaf)) return -1;
    Fat32ShortEnt ent;
    if (!find_in_dir(pclus, leaf, &ent, 0, 0, &lfn_start)) return -1;
    uint32_t fclus = ((uint32_t)ent.fst_clus_hi << 16) | ent.fst_clus_lo;
    if (fclus >= 2) fat_free_chain(fclus);

    int nlen = (int)strlen(leaf);
    uint32_t total_slots = (uint32_t)((nlen + 12) / 13) + 1;
    uint8_t del[32];
    memset(del, 0, 32);
    del[0] = 0xE5;
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < total_slots; s++) write_dir_slot(pclus, lfn_start + s, del);
    return 0;
}

int fat32_mkdir(const char *path) {
    if (!mounted || !path) return -1;
    uint32_t pclus = 0;
    char leaf[256];
    if (!resolve_parent(path, &pclus, leaf)) return -1;
    if (find_in_dir(pclus, leaf, 0, 0, 0, 0)) return -1;

    uint32_t nclus = fat_alloc_cluster();
    if (!nclus) return -1;
    if (!create_entry_in_dir(pclus, leaf, 0x10, nclus, 0, 0, 0)) {
        fat_free_chain(nclus);
        return -1;
    }

    memset(sec_buf, 0, 512);
    Fat32ShortEnt *dot = (Fat32ShortEnt *)sec_buf;
    memcpy(dot->name, ".          ", 11);
    dot->attr = 0x10;
    dot->fst_clus_hi = (uint16_t)(nclus >> 16);
    dot->fst_clus_lo = (uint16_t)(nclus & 0xFFFF);

    Fat32ShortEnt *dotdot = (Fat32ShortEnt *)(sec_buf + 32);
    memcpy(dotdot->name, "..         ", 11);
    dotdot->attr = 0x10;
    uint32_t up = (pclus == root_cluster) ? 0 : pclus;
    dotdot->fst_clus_hi = (uint16_t)(up >> 16);
    dotdot->fst_clus_lo = (uint16_t)(up & 0xFFFF);

    return block_write(cluster_to_lba(nclus), 1, sec_buf);
}

Fat32Dir *fat32_opendir(const char *path) {
    if (!mounted) return 0;
    uint32_t clus = root_cluster;
    if (path) {
        while (*path == '/' || *path == '\\') path++;
        char part[256];
        Fat32ShortEnt ent;
        while (*path) {
            int len = 0;
            while (*path && *path != '/' && *path != '\\' && len < 255) part[len++] = *path++;
            part[len] = 0;
            while (*path == '/' || *path == '\\') path++;
            if (!find_in_dir(clus, part, &ent, 0, 0, 0) || !(ent.attr & 0x10)) return 0;
            clus = ((uint32_t)ent.fst_clus_hi << 16) | ent.fst_clus_lo;
            if (!clus) clus = root_cluster;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < FAT32_MAX_DIRS; i++) {
        if (!dir_pool[i].in_use) {
            memset(&dir_pool[i], 0, sizeof(Fat32Dir));
            dir_pool[i].in_use = 1;
            dir_pool[i].start_cluster = clus;
            dir_pool[i].cur_cluster = clus;
            return &dir_pool[i];
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int fat32_readdir(Fat32Dir *dir, Fat32DirEntry *out) {
    if (!dir || !dir->in_use || !out) return 0;
    char lfn_buf[260];
    int has_lfn = 0;

    while ((is_fat16 && dir->cur_cluster == 1) || (dir->cur_cluster >= 2 && dir->cur_cluster < 0x0FFFFFF8U)) {
        uint64_t lba = (is_fat16 && dir->cur_cluster == 1) ? root_dir_lba : cluster_to_lba(dir->cur_cluster);
        uint32_t d_secs = (is_fat16 && dir->cur_cluster == 1) ? root_dir_sectors : spc; while (dir->sector_idx < d_secs) {
            if (block_read(lba + dir->sector_idx, 1, sec_buf) != 0) return 0;
            while (dir->entry_off < 512) {
                Fat32ShortEnt *e = (Fat32ShortEnt *)(sec_buf + dir->entry_off);
                dir->entry_off += 32;
                uint8_t first = (uint8_t)e->name[0];
                if (first == 0x00) { dir->cur_cluster = 0x0FFFFFFF; return 0; }
                if (first == 0xE5) { has_lfn = 0; continue; }
                if (e->attr == 0x0F) {
                    Fat32LfnEnt *le = (Fat32LfnEnt *)e;
                    if (le->seq & 0x40) { memset(lfn_buf, 0, sizeof(lfn_buf)); has_lfn = 1; }
                    if (has_lfn) extract_lfn_part(le, lfn_buf);
                    continue;
                }
                if (e->attr & 0x08) { has_lfn = 0; continue; }
                if (has_lfn && lfn_buf[0]) strcpy(out->name, lfn_buf);
                else decode_short83(e->name, out->name);
                out->size   = e->file_size;
                out->is_dir = (e->attr & 0x10) ? 1 : 0;
                return 1;
            }
            dir->entry_off = 0;
            dir->sector_idx++;
        }
        dir->sector_idx = 0;
        dir->cur_cluster = (is_fat16 && dir->cur_cluster == 1) ? 0x0FFFFFFF : fat_get_next(dir->cur_cluster);
    }
    return 0;
}

void fat32_closedir(Fat32Dir *dir) {
    if (dir) dir->in_use = 0;
}

#ifndef SONION_PAT_H
#define SONION_PAT_H

#include <stdint.h>

static inline uint64_t rdmsr(uint32_t msr) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdmsr" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi) : "c"(msr));
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static inline void wrmsr(uint32_t msr, uint64_t val) {
    uint32_t lo = (uint32_t)val, hi = (uint32_t)(val >> 32);
    __asm__ volatile ("wrmsr" : : "c"(msr), "a"(lo), "d"(hi));
}

static inline void enable_write_combining(uintptr_t fb_addr, uint64_t fb_bytes) {
    __asm__ volatile ("cli");

    uint64_t cr0, cr3;
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr0, %0" : "=r"(cr0));
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr3, %0" : "=r"(cr3));

    // Temporarily clear CR0.WP (bit 16) so UEFI read-only page tables can be updated safely
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %0, %%cr0" : : "r"(cr0 & ~(1ULL << 16)) : "memory");

    uint64_t pat = rdmsr(0x277);
    pat = (pat & ~(0xFFULL << 8)) | (0x01ULL << 8);
    wrmsr(0x277, pat);

    uint64_t *pml4 = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(cr3 & ~0xFFFULL);
    uint64_t start = fb_addr & ~0x1FFFFFULL;
    uint64_t end   = (fb_addr + fb_bytes + 0x1FFFFFULL) & ~0x1FFFFFULL;

    for (uint64_t addr = start; addr < end; addr += 0x200000ULL) {
        uint64_t pml4_i = (addr >> 39) & 0x1FF;
        uint64_t pdpt_i = (addr >> 30) & 0x1FF;
        uint64_t pd_i   = (addr >> 21) & 0x1FF;

        if (!(pml4[pml4_i] & 1)) continue;
        uint64_t *pdpt = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(pml4[pml4_i] & ~0xFFFULL);
        if (!(pdpt[pdpt_i] & 1) || (pdpt[pdpt_i] & 0x80)) continue;

        uint64_t *pd = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(pdpt[pdpt_i] & ~0xFFFULL);
        if ((pd[pd_i] & 1) && (pd[pd_i] & 0x80)) {
            pd[pd_i] |= (1ULL << 3);
        }
    }

    __asm__ volatile ("mov %0, %%cr3" : : "r"(cr3) : "memory");
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %0, %%cr0" : : "r"(cr0) : "memory");
}

#endif

#ifndef SONION_SCHED_H
#define SONION_SCHED_H

#include <stdint.h>

#define MAX_TASKS 8

enum {
    TASK_UNUSED  = 0,
    TASK_RUNNING = 1,
    TASK_READY   = 2,
    TASK_ZOMBIE  = 3
};

typedef struct {
    int      pid;
    char     name[24];
    int      state;
    int      cpl;
    uint64_t ticks;
    uint32_t mem_kb;
    uint64_t rsp;
    uint8_t  kstack[4096] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
} TaskInfo;

void      sched_init(void);
void      sched_yield(void);
int       sched_register_task(const char *name, int cpl, uint32_t mem_kb);
void      sched_set_state(int pid, int state);
void      sched_tick(void);
int       sched_kill(int pid);
int       sched_count(void);
TaskInfo *sched_get(int idx);
int       sched_current_pid(void);

================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/include/libc/ctype.h
================================================================================

#ifndef _CTYPE_H
#define _CTYPE_H

static inline int isdigit(int c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
static inline int isupper(int c) { return c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'; }
static inline int islower(int c) { return c >= 'a' && c <= 'z'; }
static inline int isalpha(int c) { return isupper(c) || islower(c); }
static inline int isalnum(int c) { return isalpha(c) || isdigit(c); }
static inline int isxdigit(int c){ return isdigit(c) || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F'); }
static inline int isspace(int c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\v' || c == '\f'; }
static inline int isblank(int c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\t'; }
static inline int iscntrl(int c) { return (c >= 0 && c < 32) || c == 127; }
static inline int isprint(int c) { return c >= 32 && c <= 126; }
static inline int isgraph(int c) { return c > 32 && c <= 126; }
static inline int ispunct(int c) { return isprint(c) && !isalnum(c) && !isspace(c); }
static inline int toupper(int c) { return islower(c) ? (c - 32) : c; }
static inline int tolower(int c) { return isupper(c) ? (c + 32) : c; }

#endif

#define EAGAIN          11  /* Resource temporarily unavailable */

#define EACCES          13  /* Permission denied */
#define EFAULT          14  /* Bad address */
#define EBUSY           16  /* Device or resource busy */
#define EEXIST          17  /* File exists */
#define EXDEV           18  /* Invalid cross-device link */
#define ENODEV          19  /* No such device */
#define ENOTDIR         20  /* Not a directory */
#define EISDIR          21  /* Is a directory */
#define EINVAL          22  /* Invalid argument */
#define ENFILE          23  /* Too many open files in system */
#define EMFILE          24  /* Too many open files */
#define ENOTTY          25  /* Inappropriate ioctl for device */
#define EFBIG           27  /* File too large */
#define ENOSPC          28  /* No space left on device */
#define ESPIPE          29  /* Illegal seek */
#define EROFS           30  /* Read-only file system */
#define EMLINK          31  /* Too many links */
#define EPIPE           32  /* Broken pipe */
#define EDOM            33  /* Numerical argument out of domain */
#define ERANGE          34  /* Numerical result out of range */
#define EDEADLK         35  /* Resource deadlock avoided */
#define ENAMETOOLONG    36  /* File name too long */
#define ENOSYS          38  /* Function not implemented */
#define ENOTEMPTY       39  /* Directory not empty */
#define EILSEQ          84  /* Invalid or incomplete multibyte or wide character */

static struct lconv c_locale = {
    .decimal_point     = ".",
    .thousands_sep     = "",
    .grouping          = "",
    .int_curr_symbol   = "",
    .currency_symbol   = "",
    .mon_decimal_point = "",
    .mon_thousands_sep = "",
    .mon_grouping      = "",
    .positive_sign     = "",
    .negative_sign     = "",
    .int_frac_digits   = CHAR_MAX,
    .frac_digits       = CHAR_MAX,
    .p_cs_precedes     = CHAR_MAX,
    .p_sep_by_space    = CHAR_MAX,
    .n_cs_precedes     = CHAR_MAX,
    .n_sep_by_space    = CHAR_MAX,
    .p_sign_posn       = CHAR_MAX,
    .n_sign_posn       = CHAR_MAX
};

char *setlocale(int category, const char *locale) {
    (void)category;
    if (!locale || locale[0] == 0 || strcmp(locale, "C") == 0 || strcmp(locale, "POSIX") == 0) {
        return "C";
    }
    return 0;
}

struct lconv *localeconv(void) { return &c_locale; }

static __sighandler_t sig_handlers[32];

__sighandler_t signal(int sig, __sighandler_t func) {
    if (sig <= 0 || sig >= 32) return SIG_ERR;
    __sighandler_t prev = sig_handlers[sig];
    sig_handlers[sig] = func;
    return prev;
}

int raise(int sig) {
    if (sig <= 0 || sig >= 32) return -1;
    __sighandler_t h = sig_handlers[sig];
    if (h != SIG_DFL && h != SIG_IGN && h != SIG_ERR) {
        sig_handlers[sig] = SIG_DFL;
        h(sig);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include "math.h"
#include "errno.h"

typedef union { double d; uint64_t u; } f64_bits;
typedef union { float  f; uint32_t u; } f32_bits;

double fabs(double x) {
    f64_bits b = { x };
    b.u &= 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL;
    return b.d;
}

float fabsf(float x) {
    f32_bits b = { x };
    b.u &= 0x7FFFFFFFU;
    return b.f;
}

double copysign(double x, double y) {
    f64_bits bx = { x }, by = { y };
    bx.u = (bx.u & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL) | (by.u & 0x8000000000000000ULL);
    return bx.d;
}

float copysignf(float x, float y) {
    f32_bits bx = { x }, by = { y };
    bx.u = (bx.u & 0x7FFFFFFFU) | (by.u & 0x80000000U);
    return bx.f;
}

double fmod(double x, double y) {
    if (y == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isnan(y) || isinf(x)) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (isinf(y)) return x;
    return x - trunc(x / y) * y;
}

float fmodf(float x, float y) { return (float)fmod((double)x, (double)y); }

double remainder(double x, double y) {
    if (y == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isnan(y) || isinf(x)) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (isinf(y)) return x;
    return x - round(x / y) * y;
}

float remainderf(float x, float y) { return (float)remainder((double)x, (double)y); }

double fmax(double x, double y) { if (isnan(x)) return y; if (isnan(y)) return x; return x > y ? x : y; }
float  fmaxf(float x, float y)   { if (isnan(x)) return y; if (isnan(y)) return x; return x > y ? x : y; }
double fmin(double x, double y) { if (isnan(x)) return y; if (isnan(y)) return x; return x < y ? x : y; }
float  fminf(float x, float y)   { if (isnan(x)) return y; if (isnan(y)) return x; return x < y ? x : y; }
double fdim(double x, double y) { return (isnan(x) || isnan(y)) ? NAN : (x > y ? x - y : 0.0); }
float  fdimf(float x, float y)   { return (isnan(x) || isnan(y)) ? NAN : (x > y ? x - y : 0.0f); }
double fma(double x, double y, double z) { return x * y + z; }
float  fmaf(float x, float y, float z)   { return x * y + z; }
double trunc(double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x) || fabs(x) >= 4503599627370496.0) return x;
    return (double)(long long)x;
}

float truncf(float x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x) || fabsf(x) >= 8388608.0f) return x;
    return (float)(long long)x;
}

double floor(double x) {
    double t = trunc(x);
    return (x < t) ? (t - 1.0) : t;
}

float floorf(float x) {
    float t = truncf(x);
    return (x < t) ? (t - 1.0f) : t;
}

double ceil(double x) {
    double t = trunc(x);
    return (x > t) ? (t + 1.0) : t;
}

float ceilf(float x) {
    float t = truncf(x);
    return (x > t) ? (t + 1.0f) : t;
}

double round(double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    return (x >= 0.0) ? floor(x + 0.5) : ceil(x - 0.5);
}

float roundf(float x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    return (x >= 0.0f) ? floorf(x + 0.5f) : ceilf(x - 0.5f);
}

long lround(double x) { return (long)round(x); }
