double frexp(double x, int *exp) {
    f64_bits b = { x };
    int e = (int)((b.u >> 52) & 0x7FF);
    if (e == 0) {
        if (x == 0.0) { *exp = 0; return x; }
        double norm = frexp(x * 18014398509481984.0, exp);
        *exp -= 54;
        return norm;
    }
    if (e == 0x7FF) { *exp = 0; return x; }
    *exp = e - 1022;
    b.u = (b.u & 0x800FFFFFFFFFFFFFULL) | 0x3FE0000000000000ULL;
    return b.d;
}

float frexpf(float x, int *exp) { return (float)frexp((double)x, exp); }

double ldexp(double x, int exp) {
    if (x == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isinf(x) || exp == 0) return x;
    while (exp > 1023)  { x *= 8.98846567431158e307; exp -= 1023; }
    while (exp < -1022) { x *= 2.2250738585072014e-308; exp += 1022; }
    f64_bits scale;
    scale.u = (uint64_t)(exp + 1023) << 52;
    return x * scale.d;
}

float ldexpf(float x, int exp) { return (float)ldexp((double)x, exp); }
double scalbn(double x, int n) { return ldexp(x, n); }
float  scalbnf(float x, int n) { return ldexpf(x, n); }

double modf(double x, double *iptr) {
    double i = trunc(x);
    *iptr = i;
    return isinf(x) ? copysign(0.0, x) : (x - i);
}

float modff(float x, float *iptr) {
    double di;
    double rem = modf((double)x, &di);
    *iptr = (float)di;
    return (float)rem;
}

int ilogb(double x) {
    int e;
    if (x == 0.0) return -2147483647 - 1;
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return 2147483647;
    frexp(x, &e);
    return e - 1;
}

int ilogbf(float x) { return ilogb((double)x); }
double logb(double x) { return (x == 0.0) ? -INFINITY : (double)ilogb(x); }
float  logbf(float x) { return (float)logb((double)x); }
double sqrt(double x) {
    if (x < 0.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (x == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    double res;
    __asm__ volatile ("sqrtsd %1, %0" : "=x"(res) : "x"(x));
    return res;
}

float sqrtf(float x) {
    if (x < 0.0f) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (x == 0.0f || isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    float res;
    __asm__ volatile ("sqrtss %1, %0" : "=x"(res) : "x"(x));
    return res;
}

double cbrt(double x) {
    if (x == 0.0 || isnan(x) || isinf(x)) return x;
    int neg = x < 0.0;
    double ax = fabs(x);
    f64_bits b = { ax };
    b.u = b.u / 3 + 0x2A9F7893E41F8000ULL;
    double y = b.d;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) y = (2.0 * y + ax / (y * y)) / 3.0;
    return neg ? -y : y;
}

float cbrtf(float x) { return (float)cbrt((double)x); }

double hypot(double x, double y) {
    x = fabs(x); y = fabs(y);
    if (isinf(x) || isinf(y)) return INFINITY;
    double mx = fmax(x, y), mn = fmin(x, y);
    if (mx == 0.0) return 0.0;
    double r = mn / mx;
    return mx * sqrt(1.0 + r * r);
}

float hypotf(float x, float y) { return (float)hypot((double)x, (double)y); }

double exp(double x) {
    if (isnan(x)) return x;
    if (x > 709.782712893) { errno = ERANGE; return HUGE_VAL; }
    if (x < -745.133219102) return 0.0;

    int k = (int)round(x * M_LOG2E);
    double r = x - (double)k * M_LN2;

    double term = 1.0, sum = 1.0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 14; i++) {
        term *= r / (double)i;
        sum += term;
    }
    return ldexp(sum, k);
}

float expf(float x) { return (float)exp((double)x); }
double exp2(double x) { return exp(x * M_LN2); }
float  exp2f(float x) { return (float)exp2((double)x); }
double expm1(double x) { return (fabs(x) < 1e-5) ? (x + 0.5 * x * x + (x * x * x) / 6.0) : (exp(x) - 1.0); }
float  expm1f(float x) { return (float)expm1((double)x); }

double log(double x) {
    if (isnan(x)) return x;
    if (x < 0.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (x == 0.0) { errno = ERANGE; return -HUGE_VAL; }
    if (isinf(x)) return INFINITY;

    int e;
    double m = frexp(x, &e);
    if (m < M_SQRT1_2) { m *= 2.0; e--; }

    double u = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0);
    double u2 = u * u;
    double term = u, sum = u;
    for (int k = 3; k <= 21; k += 2) {
        term *= u2;
        sum += term / (double)k;
    }
    return 2.0 * sum + (double)e * M_LN2;
}

float logf(float x) { return (float)log((double)x); }
double log2(double x) { return log(x) * M_LOG2E; }
float  log2f(float x) { return (float)log2((double)x); }
double log10(double x) { return log(x) * M_LOG10E; }
float  log10f(float x) { return (float)log10((double)x); }
double log1p(double x) { return (fabs(x) < 1e-5) ? (x - 0.5 * x * x + (x * x * x) / 3.0) : log(1.0 + x); }
float  log1pf(float x) { return (float)log1p((double)x); }

double pow(double x, double y) {
    if (y == 0.0 || x == 1.0) return 1.0;
    if (isnan(x) || isnan(y)) return NAN;
    if (x == 0.0) {
        if (y < 0.0) { errno = ERANGE; return HUGE_VAL; }
        return 0.0;
    }
    double iy;
    int is_int = (modf(y, &iy) == 0.0);
    if (x < 0.0 && !is_int) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }

    double ax = fabs(x);
    double res = exp(y * log(ax));
    if (x < 0.0 && ((long long)iy & 1LL)) res = -res;
    return res;
}

float powf(float x, float y) { return (float)pow((double)x, (double)y); }
static double reduce_trig(double x, int *quadrant) {
    double k = round(x * M_2_PI);
    *quadrant = ((int)(long long)k) & 3;
    return x - k * M_PI_2;
}

static double sin_kernel(double r) {
    double r2 = r * r;
    return r * (1.0 - r2 / 6.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 20.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 42.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 72.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 110.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 156.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 210.0)))))));
}

static double cos_kernel(double r) {
    double r2 = r * r;
    return 1.0 - r2 / 2.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 12.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 30.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 56.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 90.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 132.0 * (1.0 - r2 / 182.0))))));
}

double sin(double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    int q;
    double r = reduce_trig(x, &q);
    switch (q) {
        case 0: return  sin_kernel(r);
        case 1: return  cos_kernel(r);
        case 2: return -sin_kernel(r);
        default: return -cos_kernel(r);
    }
}

float sinf(float x) { return (float)sin((double)x); }

double cos(double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isinf(x)) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    int q;
    double r = reduce_trig(x, &q);
    switch (q) {
        case 0: return  cos_kernel(r);
        case 1: return -sin_kernel(r);
        case 2: return -cos_kernel(r);
        default: return  sin_kernel(r);
    }
}

float cosf(float x) { return (float)cos((double)x); }

double tan(double x) {
    double c = cos(x);
    if (c == 0.0) return copysign(HUGE_VAL, sin(x));
    return sin(x) / c;
}

float tanf(float x) { return (float)tan((double)x); }

double atan(double x) {
    if (isnan(x)) return x;
    int neg = x < 0.0;
    double ax = fabs(x);
    int inv = ax > 1.0;
    if (inv) ax = 1.0 / ax;

    int reduced = 0;
    const double TAN_PI_6  = 0.57735026918962576451;
    const double TAN_PI_12 = 0.26794919243112270647;
    if (ax > TAN_PI_12) {
        ax = (ax - TAN_PI_6) / (1.0 + ax * TAN_PI_6);
        reduced = 1;
    }

    double a2 = ax * ax;
    double term = ax, sum = ax;
    for (int k = 3; k <= 19; k += 2) {
        term = -term * a2;
        sum += term / (double)k;
    }

    if (reduced) sum += M_PI / 6.0;
    if (inv) sum = M_PI_2 - sum;
    return neg ? -sum : sum;
}

float atanf(float x) { return (float)atan((double)x); }

double atan2(double y, double x) {
    if (isnan(x) || isnan(y)) return NAN;
    if (x > 0.0) return atan(y / x);
    if (x < 0.0 && y >= 0.0) return atan(y / x) + M_PI;
    if (x < 0.0 && y < 0.0)  return atan(y / x) - M_PI;
    if (x == 0.0 && y > 0.0) return  M_PI_2;
    if (x == 0.0 && y < 0.0) return -M_PI_2;
    return 0.0;
}

float atan2f(float y, float x) { return (float)atan2((double)y, (double)x); }

double asin(double x) {
    if (x < -1.0 || x > 1.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    if (x == 1.0) return M_PI_2;
    if (x == -1.0) return -M_PI_2;
    return atan2(x, sqrt(1.0 - x * x));
}

float asinf(float x) { return (float)asin((double)x); }

double acos(double x) {
    if (x < -1.0 || x > 1.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    return M_PI_2 - asin(x);
}

float acosf(float x) { return (float)acos((double)x); }

double sinh(double x) { return 0.5 * (exp(x) - exp(-x)); }
float  sinhf(float x) { return (float)sinh((double)x); }
double cosh(double x) { return 0.5 * (exp(x) + exp(-x)); }
float  coshf(float x) { return (float)cosh((double)x); }
double tanh(double x) {
    if (x > 20.0) return 1.0;
    if (x < -20.0) return -1.0;
    double e2 = exp(2.0 * x);
    return (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0);
}
float  tanhf(float x) { return (float)tanh((double)x); }
double asinh(double x) { return log(x + sqrt(x * x + 1.0)); }
float  asinhf(float x) { return (float)asinh((double)x); }
double acosh(double x) {
    if (x < 1.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    return log(x + sqrt(x * x - 1.0));
}
float  acoshf(float x) { return (float)acosh((double)x); }
double atanh(double x) {
    if (x <= -1.0 || x >= 1.0) { errno = EDOM; return NAN; }
    return 0.5 * log((1.0 + x) / (1.0 - x));
}

================================================================================
FILE: ./kernel/libc/memory.c
================================================================================

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define HEAP_SIZE (16 * 1024 * 1024)

typedef struct BlockHdr {
    size_t size;
    int    free;
    struct BlockHdr *next;
} BlockHdr;

static uint8_t heap_buf[HEAP_SIZE] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
static BlockHdr *heap_head = 0;

static void heap_init_once(void) {
    if (heap_head) return;
    heap_head = (BlockHdr *)heap_buf;
    heap_head->size = HEAP_SIZE - sizeof(BlockHdr);
    heap_head->free = 1;
    heap_head->next = 0;
}

void *malloc(size_t size) {
    if (size == 0) size = 16;
    size = (size + 15ULL) & ~15ULL;
    heap_init_once();

    BlockHdr *cur = heap_head;
    while (cur) {
        if (cur->free && cur->size >= size) {
            if (cur->size >= size + sizeof(BlockHdr) + 32) {
                BlockHdr *split = (BlockHdr *)((uint8_t *)(cur + 1) + size);
                split->size = cur->size - size - sizeof(BlockHdr);
                split->free = 1;
                split->next = cur->next;
                cur->size = size;
                cur->next = split;
            }
            cur->free = 0;
            return (void *)(cur + 1);
        }
        cur = cur->next;
    }
    return 0;
}

void free(void *ptr) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    BlockHdr *hdr = ((BlockHdr *)ptr) - 1;
    hdr->free = 1;

    BlockHdr *cur = heap_head;
    while (cur && cur->next) {
        if (cur->free && cur->next->free) {
            cur->size += sizeof(BlockHdr) + cur->next->size;
            cur->next = cur->next->next;
        } else {
            cur = cur->next;
        }
    }
}

void *calloc(size_t nmemb, size_t size) {
    size_t total = nmemb * size;
    void *p = malloc(total);
    if (p) memset(p, 0, total);
    return p;
}

void *realloc(void *ptr, size_t size) {
    if (!ptr) return malloc(size);
    if (size == 0) { free(ptr); return 0; }

    BlockHdr *hdr = ((BlockHdr *)ptr) - 1;
    if (hdr->size >= size) return ptr;

    void *np = malloc(size);
    if (!np) return 0;
    memcpy(np, ptr, hdr->size);
    free(ptr);
    return np;
}

#include "setjmp.h"

__attribute__((naked)) int setjmp(jmp_buf env) {
    __asm__ volatile (
        "mov %rbx, 0(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %rbp, 8(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %rdi, 16(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %rsi, 24(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %r12, 32(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %r13, 40(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %r14, 48(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov %r15, 56(%rcx)\n\t"
        "lea 8(%rsp), %rax\n\t"
        "mov %rax, 64(%rcx)\n\t"
        "mov (%rsp), %rax\n\t"
        "mov %rax, 72(%rcx)\n\t"
        "xor %eax, %eax\n\t"
        "ret\n\t"
    );
}

__attribute__((naked)) void longjmp(jmp_buf env, int val) {
    __asm__ volatile (
        "mov %edx, %eax\n\t"
        "test %eax, %eax\n\t"
        "jnz 1f\n\t"
        "inc %eax\n\t"
        "1:\n\t"
        "mov 0(%rcx), %rbx\n\t"
        "mov 8(%rcx), %rbp\n\t"
        "mov 16(%rcx), %rdi\n\t"
        "mov 24(%rcx), %rsi\n\t"
        "mov 32(%rcx), %r12\n\t"
        "mov 40(%rcx), %r13\n\t"
        "mov 48(%rcx), %r14\n\t"
        "mov 56(%rcx), %r15\n\t"
        "mov 64(%rcx), %rsp\n\t"
        "jmp *72(%rcx)\n\t"
    );
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <ctype.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include "console.h"
#include "fs/fat32.h"

FILE __sonion_stdin  = { 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 1, 0 };
FILE __sonion_stdout = { 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 1 };
FILE __sonion_stderr = { 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 1 };

static FILE file_table[FOPEN_MAX];

typedef struct {
    char  *buf;
    size_t cap;
    size_t pos;
} FmtOut;

static void fmt_putc(FmtOut *o, char c) {
    if (o->buf && o->pos + 1 < o->cap) {
        o->buf[o->pos] = c;
    }
    o->pos++;
}

static void fmt_pad(FmtOut *o, char ch, int count) {
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) fmt_putc(o, ch);
}

static void fmt_uint(FmtOut *o, uint64_t val, int base, int upper,
                     int width, int prec, int flags, char sign_ch) {
    char tmp[32];
    const char *digits = upper ? "0123456789ABCDEF" : "0123456789abcdef";
    int len = 0;

    if (val == 0 && prec != 0) {
        tmp[len++] = '0';
    } else {
        while (val > 0) {
            tmp[len++] = digits[val % (uint64_t)base];
            val /= (uint64_t)base;
        }
    }

    int zeros = (prec > len) ? (prec - len) : 0;
    int prefix_len = (sign_ch ? 1 : 0);
    if ((flags & 8) && base == 16) prefix_len += 2;
    if ((flags & 8) && base == 8 && zeros == 0 && len > 0) prefix_len += 1;

    int total = prefix_len + zeros + len;
    int pad = (width > total) ? (width - total) : 0;

    if (!(flags & 1) && !(flags & 4)) fmt_pad(o, ' ', pad);
    if (sign_ch) fmt_putc(o, sign_ch);
    if ((flags & 8) && base == 16) {
        fmt_putc(o, '0');
        fmt_putc(o, upper ? 'X' : 'x');
    } else if ((flags & 8) && base == 8 && zeros == 0 && len > 0) {
        fmt_putc(o, '0');
    }
    if (!(flags & 1) && (flags & 4)) fmt_pad(o, '0', pad);
    fmt_pad(o, '0', zeros);
    while (len > 0) fmt_putc(o, tmp[--len]);
    if (flags & 1) fmt_pad(o, ' ', pad);
}

static void fmt_float(FmtOut *o, double val, int width, int prec, int flags, int is_g) {
    if (prec < 0) prec = 6;
    if (is_g && prec == 0) prec = 1;
    if (prec > 9) prec = 9;
    char sign_ch = 0;
    if (val < 0.0) { sign_ch = '-'; val = -val; }
    else if (flags & 2) sign_ch = '+';
    else if (flags & 16) sign_ch = ' ';

    if (isnan(val) || isinf(val)) {
        const char *s = isnan(val) ? "nan" : "inf";
        if (sign_ch) fmt_putc(o, sign_ch);
        while (*s) fmt_putc(o, *s++);
        return;
    }

    double scale = 1.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < prec; i++) scale *= 10.0;
    uint64_t scaled = (uint64_t)(val * scale + 0.5);
    uint64_t iscale = (uint64_t)scale;
    uint64_t ipart  = scaled / iscale;
    uint64_t fpart  = scaled % iscale;

    char ibuf[24];
    int ilen = 0;
    if (ipart == 0) ibuf[ilen++] = '0';
    else while (ipart > 0) { ibuf[ilen++] = (char)('0' + (ipart % 10)); ipart /= 10; }

    int total = (sign_ch ? 1 : 0) + ilen + (prec > 0 ? 1 + prec : 0);
    int pad = (width > total) ? (width - total) : 0;
    if (!(flags & 1) && !(flags & 4)) fmt_pad(o, ' ', pad);
    if (sign_ch) fmt_putc(o, sign_ch);
    if (!(flags & 1) && (flags & 4)) fmt_pad(o, '0', pad);
    while (ilen > 0) fmt_putc(o, ibuf[--ilen]);

    if (prec > 0) {
        char fbuf[16];
        for (int i = prec - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            fbuf[i] = (char)('0' + (fpart % 10));
            fpart /= 10;
        }
        int show = prec;
        if (is_g && !(flags & 8)) {
            while (show > 0 && fbuf[show - 1] == '0') show--;
        }
        if (show > 0) {
            fmt_putc(o, '.');
            for (int i = 0; i < show; i++) fmt_putc(o, fbuf[i]);
        }
    }
    if (flags & 1) fmt_pad(o, ' ', pad);
}

int vsnprintf(char *str, size_t size, const char *fmt, va_list ap) {
    FmtOut o = { str, size, 0 };
    if (!fmt) return 0;

    while (*fmt) {
        if (*fmt != '%') { fmt_putc(&o, *fmt++); continue; }
        fmt++;
        if (*fmt == '%') { fmt_putc(&o, *fmt++); continue; }

        int flags = 0; /* 1:'-', 2:'+', 4:'0', 8:'#', 16:' ' */
        while (*fmt == '-' || *fmt == '+' || *fmt == '0' || *fmt == '#' || *fmt == ' ') {
            if (*fmt == '-') flags |= 1;
            else if (*fmt == '+') flags |= 2;
            else if (*fmt == '0') flags |= 4;
            else if (*fmt == '#') flags |= 8;
            else if (*fmt == ' ') flags |= 16;
            fmt++;
        }

        int width = 0;
        if (*fmt == '*') { width = va_arg(ap, int); fmt++; if (width < 0) { flags |= 1; width = -width; } }
        else while (isdigit((unsigned char)*fmt)) width = width * 10 + (*fmt++ - '0');

        int prec = -1;
        if (*fmt == '.') {
            fmt++; prec = 0;
            if (*fmt == '*') { prec = va_arg(ap, int); fmt++; }
            else while (isdigit((unsigned char)*fmt)) prec = prec * 10 + (*fmt++ - '0');
        }

        int len_mod = 0; /* 1:l, 2:ll, 3:h, 4:hh */
        if (*fmt == 'l') { fmt++; len_mod = 1; if (*fmt == 'l') { fmt++; len_mod = 2; } }
        else if (*fmt == 'h') { fmt++; len_mod = 3; if (*fmt == 'h') { fmt++; len_mod = 4; } }
        else if (*fmt == 'z' || *fmt == 't' || *fmt == 'j') { fmt++; len_mod = 2; }

        char spec = *fmt ? *fmt++ : 0;
        if (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i') {
            int64_t v = (len_mod == 2) ? va_arg(ap, long long) :
                        (len_mod == 1) ? va_arg(ap, long) : va_arg(ap, int);
            char sc = 0; uint64_t uv = (uint64_t)v;
            if (v < 0) { sc = '-'; uv = (uint64_t)(-(v + 1)) + 1ULL; }
            else if (flags & 2) sc = '+';
            else if (flags & 16) sc = ' ';
            fmt_uint(&o, uv, 10, 0, width, prec, flags, sc);
        } else if (spec == 'u' || spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'o') {
            uint64_t uv = (len_mod == 2) ? va_arg(ap, unsigned long long) :
                          (len_mod == 1) ? va_arg(ap, unsigned long) : va_arg(ap, unsigned int);
            int base = (spec == 'o') ? 8 : ((spec == 'u') ? 10 : 16);
            fmt_uint(&o, uv, base, (spec == 'X'), width, prec, flags, 0);
        } else if (spec == 'p') {
            uintptr_t ptr = (uintptr_t)va_arg(ap, void *);
            fmt_uint(&o, (uint64_t)ptr, 16, 0, width, prec, flags | 8, 0);
        } else if (spec == 's') {
            const char *s = va_arg(ap, const char *);
            if (!s) s = "(null)";
            int slen = (int)strlen(s);
            if (prec >= 0 && slen > prec) slen = prec;
            int pad = (width > slen) ? (width - slen) : 0;
            if (!(flags & 1)) fmt_pad(&o, ' ', pad);
            for (int i = 0; i < slen; i++) fmt_putc(&o, s[i]);
            if (flags & 1) fmt_pad(&o, ' ', pad);
        } else if (spec == 'c') {
            char ch = (char)va_arg(ap, int);
            int pad = (width > 1) ? (width - 1) : 0;
            if (!(flags & 1)) fmt_pad(&o, ' ', pad);
            fmt_putc(&o, ch);
            if (flags & 1) fmt_pad(&o, ' ', pad);
        } else if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'F' || spec == 'g' || spec == 'G' || spec == 'e' || spec == 'E') {
            double dv = va_arg(ap, double);
            fmt_float(&o, dv, width, prec, flags, (spec == 'g' || spec == 'G'));
        } else if (spec == 'n') {
            int *np = va_arg(ap, int *);
            if (np) *np = (int)o.pos;
        }
    }

    if (str && size > 0) {
        size_t end = (o.pos < size) ? o.pos : (size - 1);
        str[end] = 0;
    }
    return (int)o.pos;
}

int snprintf(char *str, size_t size, const char *fmt, ...) {
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
    int r = vsnprintf(str, size, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap); return r;
}

}

    int r = vsnprintf(str, (size_t)-1, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap); return r;

int vfprintf(FILE *stream, const char *fmt, va_list ap) {
    char tmp[1024];
    int len = vsnprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), fmt, ap);
    if (len <= 0 || !stream) return len;
    size_t out_len = (len < (int)sizeof(tmp)) ? (size_t)len : (sizeof(tmp) - 1);
    fwrite(tmp, 1, out_len, stream);
    return len;
}

    int r = vfprintf(stdout, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap); return r;
}
int vsscanf(const char *str, const char *fmt, va_list ap) {
    if (!str || !fmt) return EOF;
    const char *s = str;
    int assigned = 0;

    while (*fmt) {
        if (isspace((unsigned char)*fmt)) {
            while (isspace((unsigned char)*fmt)) fmt++;
            while (isspace((unsigned char)*s)) s++;
            continue;
        }
        if (*fmt != '%') {
            if (*s != *fmt) break;
            s++; fmt++; continue;
        }
        fmt++;
        if (*fmt == '%') { if (*s != '%') break; s++; fmt++; continue; }

        int suppress = 0;
        if (*fmt == '*') { suppress = 1; fmt++; }

        int width = 0;
        while (isdigit((unsigned char)*fmt)) width = width * 10 + (*fmt++ - '0');

        int is_long = 0;
        if (*fmt == 'l') { is_long = 1; fmt++; if (*fmt == 'l') { is_long = 2; fmt++; } }
        else if (*fmt == 'h') { fmt++; if (*fmt == 'h') fmt++; }

        char spec = *fmt ? *fmt++ : 0;
        if (spec != 'c' && spec != 'n') {
            while (isspace((unsigned char)*s)) s++;
        }
        if (!*s && spec != 'n') return assigned ? assigned : EOF;

        if (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i' || spec == 'u' ||
            spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'o') {
            char num[64];
            int n = 0, maxw = (width > 0 && width < 63) ? width : 63;
            if ((spec == 'd' || spec == 'i') && (*s == '-' || *s == '+') && n < maxw)
                num[n++] = *s++;
            if (spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'i') {
                if (s[0] == '0' && (s[1] == 'x' || s[1] == 'X') && n + 2 <= maxw) {
                    num[n++] = *s++; num[n++] = *s++;
                }
            }
            while (*s && n < maxw) {
                char c = *s;
                int ok = (spec == 'o') ? (c >= '0' && c <= '7') :
                         (spec == 'x' || spec == 'X' || spec == 'i') ? isxdigit((unsigned char)c) :
                         isdigit((unsigned char)c);
                if (!ok) break;
                num[n++] = *s++;
            }
            num[n] = 0;
            if (n == 0 || (n == 1 && (num[0] == '-' || num[0] == '+'))) break;
            int base = (spec == 'o') ? 8 : ((spec == 'x' || spec == 'X') ? 16 : ((spec == 'i') ? 0 : 10));
            if (!suppress) {
                if (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i') {
                    long long v = strtoll(num, 0, base);
                    if (is_long == 2) *va_arg(ap, long long *) = v;
                    else if (is_long == 1) *va_arg(ap, long *) = (long)v;
                    else *va_arg(ap, int *) = (int)v;
                } else {
                    unsigned long long uv = strtoull(num, 0, base);
                    if (is_long == 2) *va_arg(ap, unsigned long long *) = uv;
                    else if (is_long == 1) *va_arg(ap, unsigned long *) = (unsigned long)uv;
                    else *va_arg(ap, unsigned int *) = (unsigned int)uv;
                }
                assigned++;
            }
        } else if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'F' || spec == 'g' || spec == 'e') {
            char *endp = 0;
            double dv = strtod(s, &endp);
            if (endp == s) break;
            s = endp;
            if (!suppress) {
                if (is_long >= 1) *va_arg(ap, double *) = dv;
                else *va_arg(ap, float *) = (float)dv;
                assigned++;
            }
        } else if (spec == 's') {
            char *dst = suppress ? 0 : va_arg(ap, char *);
            int cnt = 0;
            while (*s && !isspace((unsigned char)*s) && (!width || cnt < width)) {
                if (dst) dst[cnt] = *s;
                s++; cnt++;
            }
            if (cnt == 0) break;
            if (dst) dst[cnt] = 0;
            if (!suppress) assigned++;
        } else if (spec == 'c') {
            char *dst = suppress ? 0 : va_arg(ap, char *);
            int cnt = width ? width : 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
                if (!*s) return assigned ? assigned : EOF;
                if (dst) dst[i] = *s;
                s++;
            }
            if (!suppress) assigned++;
        } else if (spec == '[') {
            int invert = 0;
            if (*fmt == '^') { invert = 1; fmt++; }
            const char *set_start = fmt;
            if (*fmt == ']') fmt++;
            while (*fmt && *fmt != ']') fmt++;
            const char *set_end = fmt;
            if (*fmt == ']') fmt++;
            char *dst = suppress ? 0 : va_arg(ap, char *);
            int cnt = 0;
            while (*s && (!width || cnt < width)) {
                int in_set = 0;
                for (const char *p = set_start; p < set_end; p++) {
                    if (*p == *s) { in_set = 1; break; }
                }
                if (invert ? in_set : !in_set) break;
                if (dst) dst[cnt] = *s;
                s++; cnt++;
            }
            if (cnt == 0) break;
            if (dst) dst[cnt] = 0;
            if (!suppress) assigned++;
        } else if (spec == 'n') {
            if (!suppress) *va_arg(ap, int *) = (int)(s - str);
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    return assigned;
}

FILE *fopen(const char *filename, const char *mode) {
    if (!filename || !mode) { errno = EINVAL; return 0; }
    Fat32File *ff = fat32_open(filename, mode);
    if (!ff) { errno = ENOENT; return 0; }

    for (int i = 0; i < FOPEN_MAX; i++) {
        if (!file_table[i].in_use) {
            FILE *f = &file_table[i];
            memset(f, 0, sizeof(FILE));
            f->in_use   = 1;
            f->kind     = 1;
            f->handle   = ff;
            f->unget_ch = -1;
            f->readable = (strchr(mode, 'r') != 0 || strchr(mode, '+') != 0);
            f->writable = (strchr(mode, 'w') != 0 || strchr(mode, 'a') != 0 ||
                           strchr(mode, '+') != 0);
            return f;
        }
    }
    fat32_close(ff);
    errno = EMFILE;
    return 0;
}

FILE *freopen(const char *filename, const char *mode, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream) return fopen(filename, mode);
    if (stream->kind == 1 && stream->handle) fat32_close((Fat32File *)stream->handle);
    Fat32File *ff = fat32_open(filename, mode);
    if (!ff) { stream->in_use = 0; return 0; }
    stream->in_use = 1; stream->kind = 1; stream->handle = ff;
    stream->eof = 0; stream->err = 0; stream->unget_ch = -1;
    return stream;
}

int fclose(FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use) return EOF;
    if (stream->kind == 1 && stream->handle) {
        fat32_close((Fat32File *)stream->handle);
        stream->handle = 0;
        stream->in_use = 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

int fflush(FILE *stream) { (void)stream; return 0; }
void setbuf(FILE *stream, char *buf) { (void)stream; (void)buf; }
int setvbuf(FILE *stream, char *buf, int mode, size_t size) {
    (void)stream; (void)buf; (void)mode; (void)size; return 0;
}

int remove(const char *filename) { return fat32_remove(filename); }
int rename(const char *oldname, const char *newname) {
    (void)oldname; (void)newname; errno = ENOSYS; return -1;
}
FILE *tmpfile(void) { return fopen("/TMPFILE.BIN", "w+b"); }
size_t fread(void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use || !ptr || !size || !nmemb) return 0;
    if (stream->kind == 0) {
        uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)ptr;
        size_t want = size * nmemb, got = 0;
        while (got < want) {
            int ch = fgetc(stream);
            if (ch == EOF) break;
            dst[got++] = (uint8_t)ch;
        }
        return got / size;
    }
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)ptr;
    size_t want = size * nmemb, extra = 0;
    if (stream->unget_ch >= 0 && want > 0) {
        *dst++ = (uint8_t)stream->unget_ch;
        stream->unget_ch = -1;
        want--; extra = 1;
    }
    size_t r = fat32_read(dst, 1, want, (Fat32File *)stream->handle);
    if (r + extra < size * nmemb) stream->eof = 1;
    return (r + extra) / size;
}

size_t fwrite(const void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use || !ptr || !size || !nmemb) return 0;
    if (stream->kind == 0) {
        console_write((const char *)ptr, size * nmemb);
        return nmemb;
    }
    return fat32_write(ptr, size, nmemb, (Fat32File *)stream->handle);
}

int fgetc(FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use) return EOF;
    if (stream->unget_ch >= 0) {
        int c = stream->unget_ch;
        stream->unget_ch = -1;
        return c;
    }
    if (stream->kind == 0) {
        static char in_buf[512];
        static int in_len = 0, in_pos = 0;
        while (in_pos >= in_len) {
            in_len = 0;
            in_pos = 0;
            while (1) {
                int c = console_getchar(1);
                if (c < 0) {
                    if (in_len == 0) { stream->eof = 1; return EOF; }
                    break;
                }
                if (c == '\r' || c == '\n') {
                    console_putchar('\n');
                    if (in_len < 511) in_buf[in_len++] = '\n';
                    break;
                }
                if (c == '\b' || c == 127) {
                    if (in_len > 0) {
                        in_len--;
                        console_putchar('\b');
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if (c >= 32 && c <= 126 && in_len < 510) {
                    in_buf[in_len++] = (char)c;
                    console_putchar((char)c);
                }
            }
        }
        return (unsigned char)in_buf[in_pos++];
    }
    uint8_t b = 0;
    if (fat32_read(&b, 1, 1, (Fat32File *)stream->handle) != 1) {
        stream->eof = 1;
        return EOF;
    }
    return (int)b;
}

int getc(FILE *stream) { return fgetc(stream); }
int getchar(void) { return fgetc(stdin); }

char *fgets(char *s, int n, FILE *stream) {
    if (!s || n <= 0 || !stream) return 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i + 1 < n) {
        int c = fgetc(stream);
        if (c == EOF) break;
        if (c == '\b' && stream->kind == 0) {
            if (i > 0) i--;
            continue;
        }
        s[i++] = (char)c;
        if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') break;
    }
    if (i == 0) return 0;
    s[i] = 0;
    return s;
}

int fputc(int c, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use) return EOF;
    uint8_t b = (uint8_t)c;
    if (stream->kind == 0) { console_putchar((char)b); return (int)b; }
    return (fat32_write(&b, 1, 1, (Fat32File *)stream->handle) == 1) ? (int)b : EOF;
}

int putc(int c, FILE *stream) { return fputc(c, stream); }
int putchar(int c) { return fputc(c, stdout); }

int fputs(const char *s, FILE *stream) {
    if (!s || !stream) return EOF;
    size_t len = strlen(s);
    return (fwrite(s, 1, len, stream) == len) ? 0 : EOF;
}

int puts(const char *s) {
    if (fputs(s, stdout) == EOF) return EOF;
    return fputc('\n', stdout);
}

int ungetc(int c, FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || c == EOF || stream->unget_ch >= 0) return EOF;
    stream->unget_ch = (unsigned char)c;
    stream->eof = 0;
    return stream->unget_ch;
}

int fseek(FILE *stream, long offset, int whence) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use || stream->kind != 1) return -1;
    stream->unget_ch = -1;
    stream->eof = 0;
    return fat32_seek((Fat32File *)stream->handle, (int64_t)offset, whence);
}

long ftell(FILE *stream) {
    if (!stream || !stream->in_use || stream->kind != 1) return -1L;
    int64_t pos = fat32_tell((Fat32File *)stream->handle);
    if (pos >= 0 && stream->unget_ch >= 0) pos--;
    return (long)pos;
}

void rewind(FILE *stream) {
    if (stream) { fseek(stream, 0L, SEEK_SET); stream->err = 0; }
}

int fgetpos(FILE *stream, fpos_t *pos) {
    if (!pos) return -1;
    long p = ftell(stream);
    if (p < 0) return -1;
    *pos = (fpos_t)p;
    return 0;
}

int fsetpos(FILE *stream, const fpos_t *pos) {
    return pos ? fseek(stream, (long)(*pos), SEEK_SET) : -1;
}

void clearerr(FILE *stream) { if (stream) { stream->eof = 0; stream->err = 0; } }
int feof(FILE *stream) { return stream ? stream->eof : 0; }
int ferror(FILE *stream) { return stream ? stream->err : 0; }

void perror(const char *s) {
    if (s && *s) fprintf(stderr, "%s: ", s);
    fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", strerror(errno));
}

#include "stdlib.h"

static unsigned long long rng_state = 0x5DEECE66DULL;

void srand(unsigned int seed) {
    rng_state = (unsigned long long)seed ^ 0x5DEECE66DULL;
}

int rand(void) {
    rng_state = rng_state * 6364136223846793005ULL + 1442695040888963407ULL;
    return (int)((rng_state >> 33) & RAND_MAX);
}

static int char_to_digit(char c) {
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0';
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') return c - 'a' + 10;
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return c - 'A' + 10;
    return -1;
}

unsigned long long strtoull(const char *nptr, char **endptr, int base) {
    const char *s = nptr;
    while (isspace((uint8_t)*s)) s++;

    int neg = 0;
    if (*s == '-') { neg = 1; s++; }
    else if (*s == '+') { s++; }

    if ((base == 0 || base == 16) && s[0] == '0' && (s[1] == 'x' || s[1] == 'X')) {
        base = 16; s += 2;
    } else if (base == 0) {
        base = (*s == '0') ? 8 : 10;
    }

    unsigned long long acc = 0;
    int any = 0, d;
    while ((d = char_to_digit(*s)) >= 0 && d < base) {
        acc = acc * (unsigned long long)base + (unsigned long long)d;
        any = 1;
        s++;
    }

    if (endptr) *endptr = (char *)(any ? s : nptr);
    return neg ? (unsigned long long)(-(long long)acc) : acc;
}

long long strtoll(const char *nptr, char **endptr, int base) {
    const char *s = nptr;
    while (isspace((uint8_t)*s)) s++;
    int neg = (*s == '-');
    unsigned long long val = strtoull(nptr, endptr, base);
    return neg ? -(long long)val : (long long)val;
}

unsigned long strtoul(const char *nptr, char **endptr, int base) {
    return (unsigned long)strtoull(nptr, endptr, base);
}

long strtol(const char *nptr, char **endptr, int base) {
    return (long)strtoll(nptr, endptr, base);
}

int atoi(const char *s) { return (int)strtoll(s, NULL, 10); }
long atol(const char *s) { return (long)strtoll(s, NULL, 10); }
long long atoll(const char *s) { return strtoll(s, NULL, 10); }

double strtod(const char *nptr, char **endptr) {
    const char *s = nptr;
    while (isspace((uint8_t)*s)) s++;

    double sign = 1.0;
    if (*s == '-') { sign = -1.0; s++; }
    else if (*s == '+') { s++; }

    double val = 0.0;
    int any = 0;
    while (isdigit((uint8_t)*s)) {
        val = val * 10.0 + (*s - '0');
        any = 1;
        s++;
    }

    if (*s == '.') {
        s++;
        double frac = 0.1;
        while (isdigit((uint8_t)*s)) {
            val += (*s - '0') * frac;
            frac *= 0.1;
            any = 1;
            s++;
        }
    }

    if (any && (*s == 'e' || *s == 'E')) {
        s++;
        int exp_sign = 1;
        if (*s == '-') { exp_sign = -1; s++; }
        else if (*s == '+') { s++; }
        int exp = 0;
        while (isdigit((uint8_t)*s)) {
            exp = exp * 10 + (*s - '0');
            s++;
        }
        double p10 = 1.0;
        while (exp--) p10 *= 10.0;
        val = (exp_sign > 0) ? (val * p10) : (val / p10);
    }

    if (endptr) *endptr = (char *)(any ? s : nptr);
    return sign * val;
}

float strtof(const char *nptr, char **endptr) { return (float)strtod(nptr, endptr); }
double atof(const char *s) { return strtod(s, NULL); }

static void swap_bytes(uint8_t *a, uint8_t *b, size_t size) {
    while (size--) {
        uint8_t tmp = *a;
        *a++ = *b;
        *b++ = tmp;
    }
}

void qsort(void *base, size_t nmemb, size_t size, int (*compar)(const void *, const void *)) {
    if (!base || nmemb < 2 || size == 0) return;
    uint8_t *arr = (uint8_t *)base;

    // Shell/Comb-assisted In-Place Sort (zero recursion stack overflow risk in Ring 0)
    size_t gap = nmemb;
    int swapped = 1;
    while (gap > 1 || swapped) {
        gap = (gap * 10) / 13;
        if (gap < 1) gap = 1;
        swapped = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + gap < nmemb; i++) {
            uint8_t *a = arr + i * size;
            uint8_t *b = arr + (i + gap) * size;
            if (compar(a, b) > 0) {
                swap_bytes(a, b, size);
                swapped = 1;
            }
        }
    }
}

void *bsearch(const void *key, const void *base, size_t nmemb, size_t size, int (*compar)(const void *, const void *)) {
    const uint8_t *arr = (const uint8_t *)base;
    size_t lo = 0, hi = nmemb;
    while (lo < hi) {
        size_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        const void *elem = arr + mid * size;
        int cmp = compar(key, elem);
        if (cmp == 0) return (void *)elem;
        if (cmp < 0) hi = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    return NULL;
}

int abs(int j) { return j < 0 ? -j : j; }
long labs(long j) { return j < 0 ? -j : j; }
long long llabs(long long j) { return j < 0 ? -j : j; }

div_t div(int numer, int denom) { div_t r = { numer / denom, numer % denom }; return r; }
ldiv_t ldiv(long numer, long denom) { ldiv_t r = { numer / denom, numer % denom }; return r; }
lldiv_t lldiv(long long numer, long long denom) { lldiv_t r = { numer / denom, numer % denom }; return r; }

#define MAX_ATEXIT 32
static void (*atexit_funcs[32])(void);
static int atexit_count = 0;

int atexit(void (*func)(void)) {
    if (atexit_count >= MAX_ATEXIT) return -1;
    atexit_funcs[atexit_count++] = func;
    return 0;
}

void exit(int status) {
    (void)status;
    while (atexit_count > 0) {
        atexit_funcs[--atexit_count]();
    }
    while (1) __asm__ volatile ("hlt");
}

void abort(void) {
    while (1) __asm__ volatile ("hlt");
}

void *memcpy(void *dst, const void *src, size_t n) {
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)src;
    while (n >= 8) {
        *(uint64_t *)d = *(const uint64_t *)s;
        d += 8; s += 8; n -= 8;
    }
    while (n--) *d++ = *s++;
    return dst;
}

void *memmove(void *dst, const void *src, size_t n) {
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)src;
    if (d < s) return memcpy(dst, src, n);
    if (d > s) {
        d += n; s += n;
        while (n--) *--d = *--s;
    }
    return dst;
}

void *memset(void *dst, int val, size_t n) {
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    uint8_t v8 = (uint8_t)val;
    uint64_t v64 = (uint64_t)v8 * 0x0101010101010101ULL;
    while (n >= 8) {
        *(uint64_t *)d = v64;
        d += 8; n -= 8;
    }
    while (n--) *d++ = v8;
    return dst;
}

int memcmp(const void *s1, const void *s2, size_t n) {
    const uint8_t *a = (const uint8_t *)s1;
    const uint8_t *b = (const uint8_t *)s2;
    while (n--) {
        if (*a != *b) return (int)*a - (int)*b;
        a++; b++;
    }
    return 0;
}

void *memchr(const void *s, int c, size_t n) {
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)s;
    while (n--) {
        if (*p == (uint8_t)c) return (void *)p;
        p++;
    }
    return NULL;
}

char *strtok(char *str, const char *delim) {
    static char *saved = NULL;
    if (str) saved = str;
    if (!saved) return NULL;
    saved += strspn(saved, delim);
    if (!*saved) { saved = NULL; return NULL; }
    char *token = saved;
    saved += strcspn(saved, delim);
    if (*saved) *saved++ = '\0';
    else saved = NULL;
    return token;
}

#include <time.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static inline void cmos_outb(uint16_t p, uint8_t v) {
    __asm__ volatile ("outb %0, %1" : : "a"(v), "Nd"(p));
}
static inline uint8_t cmos_inb(uint16_t p) {
    uint8_t r; __asm__ volatile ("inb %1, %0" : "=a"(r) : "Nd"(p)); return r;
}

static uint8_t rtc_read(uint8_t reg) {
    cmos_outb(0x70, reg);
    return cmos_inb(0x71);
}

static uint8_t bcd_to_bin(uint8_t b) {
    return (uint8_t)((b & 0x0F) + ((b >> 4) * 10));
}

static int is_leap(int year) {
    return (year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0));
}

static const int mdays[12] = { 31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31 };

clock_t clock(void) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdtsc" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi));
    uint64_t tsc = ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
    return (clock_t)(tsc / 2500000ULL);
}

double difftime(time_t t1, time_t t0) { return (double)(t1 - t0); }

time_t mktime(struct tm *tm) {
    if (!tm) return (time_t)-1;
    int year = tm->tm_year + 1900;
    int mon  = tm->tm_mon;
    while (mon < 0)  { mon += 12; year--; }
    while (mon >= 12){ mon -= 12; year++; }

    int64_t days = 0;
    for (int y = 1970; y < year; y++) days += is_leap(y) ? 366 : 365;
    for (int y = year; y < 1970; y++) days -= is_leap(y) ? 366 : 365;

    int yday = 0;
    for (int m = 0; m < mon; m++) {
        int d = mdays[m] + ((m == 1 && is_leap(year)) ? 1 : 0);
        yday += d;
    }
    yday += (tm->tm_mday - 1);
    days += yday;

    tm->tm_yday = yday;
    int wday = (int)((days + 4) % 7);
    if (wday < 0) wday += 7;
    tm->tm_wday = wday;

    return (time_t)(days * 86400LL + tm->tm_hour * 3600LL + tm->tm_min * 60LL + tm->tm_sec);
}

time_t time(time_t *timer) {
    while (rtc_read(0x0A) & 0x80) __asm__ volatile ("pause");
    uint8_t sec  = rtc_read(0x00);
    uint8_t min  = rtc_read(0x02);
    uint8_t hour = rtc_read(0x04);
    uint8_t day  = rtc_read(0x07);
    uint8_t mon  = rtc_read(0x08);
    uint8_t year = rtc_read(0x09);
    uint8_t regb = rtc_read(0x0B);

    if (!(regb & 0x04)) {
        sec  = bcd_to_bin(sec);
        min  = bcd_to_bin(min);
        hour = bcd_to_bin(hour & 0x7F) | (hour & 0x80);
        day  = bcd_to_bin(day);
        mon  = bcd_to_bin(mon);
        year = bcd_to_bin(year);
    }
    if (!(regb & 0x02) && (hour & 0x80)) {
        hour = (uint8_t)(((hour & 0x7F) + 12) % 24);
    }

    struct tm t;
    memset(&t, 0, sizeof(t));
    t.tm_sec  = sec;
    t.tm_min  = min;
    t.tm_hour = hour;
    t.tm_mday = day ? day : 1;
    t.tm_mon  = mon ? (mon - 1) : 0;
    t.tm_year = 100 + year;

    time_t epoch = mktime(&t);
    if (timer) *timer = epoch;
    return epoch;
}

static struct tm static_tm;

struct tm *gmtime(const time_t *timer) {
    if (!timer) return 0;
    int64_t t = *timer;
    int64_t days = t / 86400LL;
    int64_t rem  = t % 86400LL;
    if (rem < 0) { rem += 86400LL; days--; }

    static_tm.tm_hour = (int)(rem / 3600);
    static_tm.tm_min  = (int)((rem % 3600) / 60);
    static_tm.tm_sec  = (int)(rem % 60);

    int wday = (int)((days + 4) % 7);
    if (wday < 0) wday += 7;
    static_tm.tm_wday = wday;

    int year = 1970;
    while (days >= (is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365)) {
        days -= is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365;
        year++;
    }
    while (days < 0) {
        year--;
        days += is_leap(year) ? 366 : 365;
    }
    static_tm.tm_year = year - 1900;
    static_tm.tm_yday = (int)days;

    int mon = 0;
    while (mon < 11) {
        int d = mdays[mon] + ((mon == 1 && is_leap(year)) ? 1 : 0);
        if (days < d) break;
        days -= d;
        mon++;
    }
    static_tm.tm_mon  = mon;
    static_tm.tm_mday = (int)days + 1;
    static_tm.tm_isdst = 0;
    return &static_tm;
}

struct tm *localtime(const time_t *timer) { return gmtime(timer); }

(num_sec,) = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, pe_off + 6)
(opt_sz,) = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, pe_off + 20)
sec_off = pe_off + 24 + opt_sz

max_end = 0
sections = []
for i in range(num_sec):
    s = sec_off + i * 40
    name = data[s:s+8].rstrip(b'\x00').decode('ascii', errors='ignore')
    vsize, vaddr, raw_sz, raw_ptr = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', data, s + 8)
    if name in ('.text', '.rodata', '.rdata', '.data'):
        sections.append((name, vaddr, raw_sz, raw_ptr))
        if vaddr + raw_sz > max_end:
            max_end = vaddr + raw_sz

base_vaddr = min(vaddr for _, vaddr, _, _ in sections)
flat = bytearray(max_end - base_vaddr)
for name, vaddr, raw_sz, raw_ptr in sections:
    off = vaddr - base_vaddr
    flat[off:off + raw_sz] = data[raw_ptr:raw_ptr + raw_sz]

open('build/bios_kernel.bin', 'wb').write(flat)
print(f"[PACK] Built flat kernel ({len(flat)} bytes)")

import os, struct
ksize = os.path.getsize("build/bios_kernel.bin")
chunks = max(1, (ksize + 32767) // 32768)
with open("build/bios_boot.bin", "r+b") as bf:
    bf.seek(2)
    bf.write(struct.pack("<H", chunks))
print(f"[PATCH] Bootloader configured for {chunks} x 32KB chunks ({chunks * 32} KB)")

from pathlib import Path

def replace_once(path, old, new):
    p = Path(path)
    s = p.read_text()
    if new in s:
        print(f"[OK] Already patched: {path}")
        return
    if old not in s:
        raise SystemExit(f"[STOP] Expected code not found in {path}")
    p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
    print(f"[PATCHED] {path}")

files = {
    "kernel/include/desktop.h": r"""#ifndef SONION_DESKTOP_H
#define SONION_DESKTOP_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include "bootinfo.h"

void desktop_init(BootInfo *info, uint32_t *backbuf);

#endif
""",

    "kernel/desktop.c": r"""#include "desktop.h"
#include "gfx.h"

void desktop_init(BootInfo *info, uint32_t *backbuf) {
    if (!info || !backbuf || !info->width || !info->height)
        return;

    gfx_init(info, backbuf);

    /* Base wallpaper */
    gfx_fill(0x000B1220);

    uint32_t w = info->width;
    uint32_t h = info->height;

    /* Abstract wallpaper geometry */
    gfx_fill_rect((int)(w * 3 / 5), 60,
                  (int)(w / 3), (int)(h / 3),
                  0x0015223A);

    gfx_fill_rect((int)(w * 2 / 3), 90,
                  (int)(w / 4), (int)(h / 4),
                  0x001B2C48);

    /* Top status bar */
    gfx_fill_rect(0, 0, (int)w, 34, 0x00101829);
    gfx_fill_rect(0, 33, (int)w, 1, 0x0038BDF8);

    /* Desktop icon placeholders */
    int ix = 28;
    int iy = 64;

    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        uint32_t colors[] = {
            0x0038BDF8,
            0x0022C55E,
            0x00A78BFA
        };

        gfx_fill_rect(ix, iy + i * 100, 48, 48, colors[i]);
        gfx_rect(ix, iy + i * 100, 48, 48, 0x00E2E8F0);
        gfx_fill_rect(ix + 12, iy + i * 100 + 12,
                      24, 24, 0x00E2E8F0);
    }

    /* Bottom application dock */
    int dock_w = (w > 440) ? 400 : (int)w - 32;
    if (dock_w < 0) dock_w = 0;

    int dock_x = ((int)w - dock_w) / 2;
    int dock_y = (h > 100) ? (int)h - 76 : 0;

    gfx_fill_rect(dock_x, dock_y, dock_w, 56, 0x00182235);
    gfx_rect(dock_x, dock_y, dock_w, 56, 0x00475B78);

    /* Dock application icons */
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        int x = dock_x + 14 + i * 72;
        if (x + 40 >= dock_x + dock_w) break;

        uint32_t colors[] = {
            0x0038BDF8,
            0x0022C55E,
            0x00F59E0B,
            0x00A78BFA,
            0x00EF4444
        };

        gfx_fill_rect(x, dock_y + 8, 40, 40, colors[i]);
        gfx_rect(x, dock_y + 8, 40, 40, 0x00E2E8F0);
    }
}
"""
}

for name, content in files.items():

================================================================================
FILE: ./scripts/make_iso.py

import os, struct

SECTOR_SIZE = 512
ISO_BLOCK   = 2048

def pad_to(data, align):
    rem = len(data) % align
    return data if rem == 0 else data + b"\x00" * (align - rem)

def make_short_name(name):
    parts = name.upper().split(".")
    base = "".join(c for c in parts[0] if c.isalnum() or c in "_-~")[:8].ljust(8, " ")
    ext  = "".join(c for c in (parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "") if c.isalnum())[:3].ljust(3, " ")
    return (base + ext).encode("ascii")

def build_fat16_esp(disk_dir, out_esp):
    total_sectors = 32768 # 16 MB
    rsvd_sectors  = 4
    num_fats      = 2
    fat_sectors   = 128
    root_entries  = 512
    root_sectors  = (root_entries * 32) // 512
    spc           = 4
    data_start    = rsvd_sectors + num_fats * fat_sectors + root_sectors

    img = bytearray(total_sectors * SECTOR_SIZE)
    fat = [0] * (fat_sectors * 256)
    fat[0] = 0xFFF8
    fat[1] = 0xFFFF
    next_clus = 2

    vbr = bytearray(512)
    vbr[0:3]   = b"\xEB\x3C\x90"
    vbr[3:11]  = b"SONIONOS"
    struct.pack_into("<H", vbr, 11, 512)
    vbr[13]   = spc
    struct.pack_into("<H", vbr, 14, rsvd_sectors)
    vbr[16]   = num_fats
    struct.pack_into("<H", vbr, 17, root_entries)
    struct.pack_into("<H", vbr, 19, total_sectors)
    vbr[21]   = 0xF8
    struct.pack_into("<H", vbr, 22, fat_sectors)
    struct.pack_into("<H", vbr, 24, 63)
    struct.pack_into("<H", vbr, 26, 255)
    vbr[36]   = 0x80
    vbr[38]   = 0x29
    struct.pack_into("<I", vbr, 39, 0x20261127)
    vbr[43:54] = b"SONIONOS   "
    vbr[54:62] = b"FAT16   "
    vbr[510:512] = b"\x55\xAA"
    img[0:512] = vbr

    def alloc_chain(blob):
        nonlocal next_clus
        cbytes = spc * 512
        nclus = max(1, (len(blob) + cbytes - 1) // cbytes)
        first = next_clus
        for i in range(nclus):
            c = next_clus
            next_clus += 1
            fat[c] = 0xFFFF if i == nclus - 1 else (c + 1)
            chunk = blob[i * cbytes : (i + 1) * cbytes]
            off = (data_start + (c - 2) * spc) * 512
            img[off : off + len(chunk)] = chunk
        return first

    def pack_dir(host_path, parent_clus=0):
        entries = bytearray()
        if parent_clus != 0:
            dot = bytearray(32); dot[0:11] = b".          "; dot[11] = 0x10
            ddot = bytearray(32); ddot[0:11] = b"..         "; ddot[11] = 0x10
            entries += dot + ddot
        for item in sorted(os.listdir(host_path)):
            if item.lower() == "nvvars": continue
            full = os.path.join(host_path, item)
            ent = bytearray(32)
            ent[0:11] = make_short_name(item)
            if os.path.isdir(full):
                ent[11] = 0x10
                sub_bytes = pack_dir(full, 1)
                c = alloc_chain(sub_bytes)
                struct.pack_into("<H", ent, 26, c)
            else:
                ent[11] = 0x20
                with open(full, "rb") as f: data = f.read()
                c = alloc_chain(data) if len(data) > 0 else 0
                struct.pack_into("<H", ent, 26, c)
                struct.pack_into("<I", ent, 28, len(data))
            entries += ent
        return bytes(entries)

    root_bytes = pack_dir(disk_dir, 0)
    root_off = (rsvd_sectors + num_fats * fat_sectors) * 512
    img[root_off : root_off + len(root_bytes)] = root_bytes

    fat_raw = struct.pack("<" + "H" * len(fat), *fat)
    for f_idx in range(num_fats):
        foff = (rsvd_sectors + f_idx * fat_sectors) * 512
        img[foff : foff + len(fat_raw)] = fat_raw

    with open(out_esp, "wb") as f: f.write(img)
    return bytes(img)

def build_hybrid_iso(bios_img_path, esp_bytes, out_iso):
    with open(bios_img_path, "rb") as f: bios_bytes = pad_to(f.read(), ISO_BLOCK)
    esp_padded = pad_to(esp_bytes, ISO_BLOCK)

    bios_lba = 21
    bios_blocks = len(bios_bytes) // ISO_BLOCK
    esp_lba = bios_lba + bios_blocks
    esp_blocks = len(esp_padded) // ISO_BLOCK
    total_blocks = esp_lba + esp_blocks

    iso = bytearray(total_blocks * ISO_BLOCK)

    mbr = bytearray(512)
    part1 = bytearray(16)
    part1[0] = 0x80
    part1[4] = 0x06
    struct.pack_into("<I", part1, 8, esp_lba * 4)
    struct.pack_into("<I", part1, 12, esp_blocks * 4)
    mbr[446:462] = part1
    mbr[510:512] = b"\x55\xAA"
    iso[0:512] = mbr

    pvd = bytearray(ISO_BLOCK)
    pvd[0] = 1; pvd[1:6] = b"CD001"; pvd[6] = 1
    pvd[8:40] = b"SONIONOS".ljust(32, b" ")
    pvd[40:72] = b"SONIONOS_HYBRID".ljust(32, b" ")
    struct.pack_into("<I", pvd, 80, total_blocks); struct.pack_into(">I", pvd, 84, total_blocks)
    struct.pack_into("<H", pvd, 120, 1); struct.pack_into(">H", pvd, 122, 1)
    struct.pack_into("<H", pvd, 124, 1); struct.pack_into(">H", pvd, 126, 1)
    struct.pack_into("<H", pvd, 128, ISO_BLOCK); struct.pack_into(">H", pvd, 130, ISO_BLOCK)
    pvd[156] = 34
    struct.pack_into("<I", pvd, 158, 20); struct.pack_into(">I", pvd, 162, 20)
    struct.pack_into("<I", pvd, 166, ISO_BLOCK); struct.pack_into(">I", pvd, 170, ISO_BLOCK)
    pvd[181] = 2; pvd[188] = 1; pvd[189] = 0
    iso[16 * ISO_BLOCK : 17 * ISO_BLOCK] = pvd

    br = bytearray(ISO_BLOCK)
    br[0] = 0; br[1:6] = b"CD001"; br[6] = 1
    br[7:39] = b"EL TORITO SPECIFICATION".ljust(32, b"\x00")
    struct.pack_into("<I", br, 71, 19)
    iso[17 * ISO_BLOCK : 18 * ISO_BLOCK] = br

    term = bytearray(ISO_BLOCK)
    term[0] = 255; term[1:6] = b"CD001"; term[6] = 1
    iso[18 * ISO_BLOCK : 19 * ISO_BLOCK] = term

    cat = bytearray(ISO_BLOCK)
    val = bytearray(32)
    val[0] = 1; val[1] = 0
    val[4:28] = b"SONIONOS".ljust(24, b"\x00")
    val[30] = 0x55; val[31] = 0xAA
    csum = (0x10000 - (sum(struct.unpack("<16H", val)) & 0xFFFF)) & 0xFFFF
    struct.pack_into("<H", val, 28, csum)
    cat[0:32] = val

    bios_ent = bytearray(32)
    bios_ent[0] = 0x88; bios_ent[1] = 0x00
    struct.pack_into("<H", bios_ent, 2, 0x07C0); struct.pack_into("<H", bios_ent, 6, 1)
    struct.pack_into("<I", bios_ent, 8, bios_lba)
    cat[32:64] = bios_ent

    sec_hdr = bytearray(32)
    sec_hdr[0] = 0x91; sec_hdr[1] = 0xEF
    struct.pack_into("<H", sec_hdr, 2, 1)
    cat[64:96] = sec_hdr

    uefi_ent = bytearray(32)
    uefi_ent[0] = 0x88; uefi_ent[1] = 0x00
    struct.pack_into("<H", uefi_ent, 6, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<I", uefi_ent, 8, esp_lba)
    cat[96:128] = uefi_ent
    iso[19 * ISO_BLOCK : 20 * ISO_BLOCK] = cat

    iso[bios_lba * ISO_BLOCK : (bios_lba + bios_blocks) * ISO_BLOCK] = bios_bytes
    iso[esp_lba * ISO_BLOCK : (esp_lba + esp_blocks) * ISO_BLOCK] = esp_padded

    with open(out_iso, "wb") as f: f.write(iso)
    print(f"[ISO] Built hybrid UEFI+BIOS image: {out_iso} ({len(iso) // 1024} KB)")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    esp = build_fat16_esp("disk", "build/esp.img")
    build_hybrid_iso("build/sonionos_bios.img", esp, "build/sonionOS.iso")

@echo off
setlocal
set SDK_DIR=%~dp0
if "%~1"=="" (
    echo === sonionOS User-Mode C / C++ SDK ===
    echo Usage: sonion-sdk.bat ^<app.c ^| app.cpp^> -o ^<output.son^>
    exit /b 1
)

set SRC=%~1
set OUT=APP.SON
if /i "%~2"=="-o" if not "%~3"=="" set OUT=%~3

if /i "%~x1"==".cpp" (
    echo [SONION-SDK] Compiling C++ source: %SRC%
    g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -ffreestanding -fno-stack-protector -mno-stack-arg-probe -mno-red-zone -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -U_WIN32 -U_WIN64 -I"%SDK_DIR%include" -c "%SRC%" -o "%TEMP%\sonion_app.o"
) else (
    echo [SONION-SDK] Compiling C source: %SRC%
    gcc -O2 -ffreestanding -fno-stack-protector -mno-stack-arg-probe -mno-red-zone -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -U_WIN32 -U_WIN64 -I"%SDK_DIR%include" -c "%SRC%" -o "%TEMP%\sonion_app.o"
)
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1

ld --disable-dynamicbase --image-base 0x0 -T "%SDK_DIR%lib\child.ld" -o "%TEMP%\sonion_app.elf" "%SDK_DIR%lib\crt0.o" "%TEMP%\sonion_app.o" "%SDK_DIR%lib\stdio.o" "%SDK_DIR%lib\time.o" "%SDK_DIR%lib\memory.o" "%SDK_DIR%lib\string.o" "%SDK_DIR%lib\stdlib.o" "%SDK_DIR%lib\math.o" "%SDK_DIR%lib\setjmp.o" "%SDK_DIR%lib\locale_signal.o"
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1

objcopy -O binary "%TEMP%\sonion_app.elf" "%OUT%"
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
echo [SONION-SDK] Built Ring 3 .SON executable: %OUT%

================================================================================
FILE: ./sdk/examples/lua_cli.c

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "lua/lua.h"
#include "lua/lualib.h"
#include "lua/lauxlib.h"

int main(void) {
    lua_State *L = luaL_newstate();
    if (!L) { printf("[LUA.SON] Failed to allocate Lua VM!\n"); return 1; }
    luaL_openlibs(L);

    printf("=== Standalone Lua 5.5.1 (.SON Ring 3 Process) ===\n");
    printf("Type a .lua file (e.g. hello.lua), Lua code, or 'exit':\n");

    char line[256];
    while (1) {
        printf("lua> ");
        fflush(stdout);
        if (!fgets(line, sizeof(line), stdin)) break;
        size_t n = strlen(line);
        while (n > 0 && (line[n - 1] == '\n' || line[n - 1] == '\r')) line[--n] = 0;
        if (n == 0) continue;
        if (strcmp(line, "exit") == 0 || strcmp(line, "quit") == 0) break;

        int err = (n > 4 && strcmp(line + n - 4, ".lua") == 0)
                  ? luaL_dofile(L, line)
                  : luaL_dostring(L, line);
        if (err != LUA_OK) {
            printf("lua error: %s\n", lua_tostring(L, -1));
            lua_pop(L, 1);
        }
    }
    lua_close(L);
    return 0;
}

#ifndef _CTYPE_H
#define _CTYPE_H

static inline int isdigit(int c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
static inline int isupper(int c) { return c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'; }
static inline int islower(int c) { return c >= 'a' && c <= 'z'; }
static inline int isalpha(int c) { return isupper(c) || islower(c); }
static inline int isalnum(int c) { return isalpha(c) || isdigit(c); }
static inline int isxdigit(int c){ return isdigit(c) || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F'); }
static inline int isspace(int c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\v' || c == '\f'; }
static inline int isblank(int c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\t'; }
static inline int iscntrl(int c) { return (c >= 0 && c < 32) || c == 127; }
static inline int isprint(int c) { return c >= 32 && c <= 126; }
static inline int isgraph(int c) { return c > 32 && c <= 126; }
static inline int ispunct(int c) { return isprint(c) && !isalnum(c) && !isspace(c); }
static inline int toupper(int c) { return islower(c) ? (c - 32) : c; }
static inline int tolower(int c) { return isupper(c) ? (c + 32) : c; }

#endif

================================================================================
FILE: ./sdk/include/pat.h
================================================================================

#ifndef SONION_PAT_H
#define SONION_PAT_H

#include <stdint.h>

static inline uint64_t rdmsr(uint32_t msr) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdmsr" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi) : "c"(msr));
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static inline void wrmsr(uint32_t msr, uint64_t val) {
    uint32_t lo = (uint32_t)val, hi = (uint32_t)(val >> 32);
    __asm__ volatile ("wrmsr" : : "c"(msr), "a"(lo), "d"(hi));
}

static inline void enable_write_combining(uintptr_t fb_addr, uint64_t fb_bytes) {
    __asm__ volatile ("cli");

    uint64_t cr0, cr3;
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr0, %0" : "=r"(cr0));
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %%cr3, %0" : "=r"(cr3));

    // Temporarily clear CR0.WP (bit 16) so UEFI read-only page tables can be updated safely
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %0, %%cr0" : : "r"(cr0 & ~(1ULL << 16)) : "memory");

    uint64_t pat = rdmsr(0x277);
    pat = (pat & ~(0xFFULL << 8)) | (0x01ULL << 8);
    wrmsr(0x277, pat);

    uint64_t *pml4 = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(cr3 & ~0xFFFULL);
    uint64_t start = fb_addr & ~0x1FFFFFULL;
    uint64_t end   = (fb_addr + fb_bytes + 0x1FFFFFULL) & ~0x1FFFFFULL;

    for (uint64_t addr = start; addr < end; addr += 0x200000ULL) {
        uint64_t pml4_i = (addr >> 39) & 0x1FF;
        uint64_t pdpt_i = (addr >> 30) & 0x1FF;
        uint64_t pd_i   = (addr >> 21) & 0x1FF;

        if (!(pml4[pml4_i] & 1)) continue;
        uint64_t *pdpt = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(pml4[pml4_i] & ~0xFFFULL);
        if (!(pdpt[pdpt_i] & 1) || (pdpt[pdpt_i] & 0x80)) continue;

        uint64_t *pd = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(pdpt[pdpt_i] & ~0xFFFULL);
        if ((pd[pd_i] & 1) && (pd[pd_i] & 0x80)) {
            pd[pd_i] |= (1ULL << 3);
        }
    }

    __asm__ volatile ("mov %0, %%cr3" : : "r"(cr3) : "memory");
    __asm__ volatile ("mov %0, %%cr0" : : "r"(cr0) : "memory");
}

#endif

    int tm_yday;
    int tm_isdst;
};

#ifndef SONION_USYSCALL_H
#define SONION_USYSCALL_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include "sysinfo_page.h"
#include "sysinfo_page.h"

#define SYS_EXIT       0
#define SYS_WRITE      1
#define SYS_GETCHAR    2
#define SYS_CLEAR      3
#define SYS_OPEN       4
#define SYS_READ       5
#define SYS_FWRITE     6
#define SYS_SEEK       7
#define SYS_TELL       8
#define SYS_CLOSE      9
#define SYS_MKDIR      10
#define SYS_REMOVE     11
#define SYS_OPENDIR    12
#define SYS_READDIR    13
#define SYS_CLOSEDIR   14
#define SYS_TIME       15
#define SYS_CLOCK      16
#define SYS_REBOOT     17
#define SYS_POWEROFF   18
#define SYS_DISK_INFO  19
#define SYS_EXEC       20
#define SYS_BATCH      21

typedef struct {
    int      in_use;
    int      writable;
    uint32_t first_cluster;
    uint32_t cur_cluster;
    uint32_t cur_cluster_idx;
    uint32_t size;
    uint32_t pos;
    uint32_t dir_sector;
    uint32_t dir_offset;
} Fat32File;

typedef struct {
    char     name[256];
    uint32_t size;
    int      is_dir;
} UserDirEntry;

static inline int64_t syscall3(uint64_t n, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2, uint64_t a3) {
    int64_t ret;
    __asm__ volatile (
        "syscall"
        : "=a"(ret)
        : "a"(n), "D"(a1), "S"(a2), "d"(a3)
        : "rcx", "r11", "memory"
    );
    return ret;
}

static inline void sys_exit(int code) { syscall3(SYS_EXIT, (uint64_t)code, 0, 0); while (1); }
static inline void sys_write(const char *s, size_t len) { syscall3(SYS_WRITE, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)s, len, 0); }
static inline int  sys_getchar(int blocking) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_GETCHAR, (uint64_t)blocking, 0, 0); }
static inline void sys_clear(void) { syscall3(SYS_CLEAR, 0, 0, 0); }
static inline int  sys_open(const char *p, const char *m) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_OPEN, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m, 0); }
static inline int64_t sys_read(int fd, void *b, size_t n) { return syscall3(SYS_READ, (uint64_t)fd, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)b, n); }
static inline int64_t sys_fwrite(int fd, const void *b, size_t n) { return syscall3(SYS_FWRITE, (uint64_t)fd, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)b, n); }
static inline int  sys_seek(int fd, int64_t off, int w) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_SEEK, (uint64_t)fd, (uint64_t)off, (uint64_t)w); }
static inline int64_t sys_tell(int fd) { return syscall3(SYS_TELL, (uint64_t)fd, 0, 0); }
static inline void sys_close(int fd) { syscall3(SYS_CLOSE, (uint64_t)fd, 0, 0); }
static inline int  sys_mkdir(const char *p) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_MKDIR, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p, 0, 0); }
static inline int  sys_remove(const char *p) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_REMOVE, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p, 0, 0); }
static inline int  sys_opendir(const char *p) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_OPENDIR, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p, 0, 0); }
static inline int  sys_readdir(int dd, UserDirEntry *e) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_READDIR, (uint64_t)dd, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e, 0); }
static inline void sys_closedir(int dd) { syscall3(SYS_CLOSEDIR, (uint64_t)dd, 0, 0); }
static inline uint64_t u_rdtsc(void) {
    uint32_t lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile ("rdtsc" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi));
    return ((uint64_t)hi << 32) | lo;
}

static inline int64_t sys_clock(void) {
    const volatile SonionSysInfo *si = (const volatile SonionSysInfo *)(uintptr_t)SYSINFO_PAGE_ADDR;
    if (si->magic == SYSINFO_MAGIC && si->tsc_per_ms > 0) {
        return (int64_t)((u_rdtsc() - si->boot_tsc) / si->tsc_per_ms);
    }
    return syscall3(SYS_CLOCK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static inline int64_t sys_time(void) {
    const volatile SonionSysInfo *si = (const volatile SonionSysInfo *)(uintptr_t)SYSINFO_PAGE_ADDR;
    if (si->magic == SYSINFO_MAGIC && si->tsc_per_ms > 0) {
        uint64_t ms = (u_rdtsc() - si->boot_tsc) / si->tsc_per_ms;
        return (int64_t)(si->unix_base + (ms / 1000ULL));
    }
    return syscall3(SYS_TIME, 0, 0, 0);
}
static inline void sys_reboot(void) { syscall3(SYS_REBOOT, 0, 0, 0); }
static inline void sys_poweroff(void) { syscall3(SYS_POWEROFF, 0, 0, 0); }
static inline void sys_disk_info(uint64_t *buf) { syscall3(SYS_DISK_INFO, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)buf, 0, 0); }
static inline int64_t sys_batch(void *ops, uint64_t count) { return syscall3(SYS_BATCH, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ops, count, 0); }
static inline int  sys_exec(const char *p) { return (int)syscall3(SYS_EXEC, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p, 0, 0); }

static inline uint16_t get_current_cpl(void) {
    uint16_t cs;
    __asm__ volatile ("movw %%cs, %0" : "=r"(cs));
    return cs & 3;
}

#endif

/*
** $Id: lapi.h $
** Auxiliary functions from Lua API
** See Copyright Notice in lua.h
*/

#ifndef lapi_h
#define lapi_h


#include "llimits.h"
#include "lstate.h"


#if defined(LUA_USE_APICHECK)
#include <assert.h>
#define api_check(l,e,msg)	assert(e)
#else	/* for testing */
#define api_check(l,e,msg)	((void)(l), lua_assert((e) && msg))
#endif



/* Increments 'L->top.p', checking for stack overflows */
#define api_incr_top(L)  \
    (L->top.p++, api_check(L, L->top.p <= L->ci->top.p, "stack overflow"))


/*
** macros that are executed whenever program enters the Lua core
** ('lua_lock') and leaves the core ('lua_unlock')
*/
#if !defined(lua_lock)
#define lua_lock(L)	((void) 0)
#define lua_unlock(L)	((void) 0)
#endif



/*
** If a call returns too many multiple returns, the callee may not have
** stack space to accommodate all results. In this case, this macro
** increases its stack space ('L->ci->top.p').
*/
#define adjustresults(L,nres) \
    { if ((nres) <= LUA_MULTRET && L->ci->top.p < L->top.p) \
	L->ci->top.p = L->top.p; }


/* Ensure the stack has at least 'n' elements */
#define api_checknelems(L,n) \
       api_check(L, (n) < (L->top.p - L->ci->func.p), \
                         "not enough elements in the stack")


/* Ensure the stack has at least 'n' elements to be popped. (Some
** functions only update a slot after checking it for popping, but that
** is only an optimization for a pop followed by a push.)
*/
#define api_checkpop(L,n) \
	api_check(L, (n) < L->top.p - L->ci->func.p &&  \
                     L->tbclist.p < L->top.p - (n), \
			  "not enough free elements in the stack")

#endif

/*
** $Id: lctype.h $
** 'ctype' functions for Lua
** See Copyright Notice in lua.h
*/

#ifndef lctype_h
#define lctype_h

#include "lua.h"


/*
** WARNING: the functions defined here do not necessarily correspond
** to the similar functions in the standard C ctype.h. They are
** optimized for the specific needs of Lua.
*/

#if !defined(LUA_USE_CTYPE)

#if 'A' == 65 && '0' == 48
/* ASCII case: can use its own tables; faster and fixed */
#define LUA_USE_CTYPE	0
#else
/* must use standard C ctype */
#define LUA_USE_CTYPE	1
#endif

#endif


#if !LUA_USE_CTYPE	/* { */

#include <limits.h>

#include "llimits.h"


#define ALPHABIT	0
#define DIGITBIT	1
#define PRINTBIT	2
#define SPACEBIT	3
#define XDIGITBIT	4


#define MASK(B)		(1 << (B))


/*
** add 1 to char to allow index -1 (EOZ)
*/
#define testprop(c,p)	(luai_ctype_[(c)+1] & (p))

/*
** 'lalpha' (Lua alphabetic) and 'lalnum' (Lua alphanumeric) both include '_'
*/
#define lislalpha(c)	testprop(c, MASK(ALPHABIT))
#define lislalnum(c)	testprop(c, (MASK(ALPHABIT) | MASK(DIGITBIT)))
#define lisdigit(c)	testprop(c, MASK(DIGITBIT))
#define lisspace(c)	testprop(c, MASK(SPACEBIT))
#define lisprint(c)	testprop(c, MASK(PRINTBIT))
#define lisxdigit(c)	testprop(c, MASK(XDIGITBIT))


/*
** In ASCII, this 'ltolower' is correct for alphabetic characters and
** for '.'. That is enough for Lua needs. ('check_exp' ensures that
** the character either is an upper-case letter or is unchanged by
** the transformation, which holds for lower-case letters and '.'.)
*/
#define ltolower(c)  \
  check_exp(('A' <= (c) && (c) <= 'Z') || (c) == ((c) | ('A' ^ 'a')),  \
            (c) | ('A' ^ 'a'))


/* one entry for each character and for -1 (EOZ) */
LUAI_DDEC(const lu_byte luai_ctype_[UCHAR_MAX + 2];)


#else			/* }{ */

/*
** use standard C ctypes
*/

#include <ctype.h>


#define lislalpha(c)	(isalpha(c) || (c) == '_')
#define lislalnum(c)	(isalnum(c) || (c) == '_')
#define lisdigit(c)	(isdigit(c))
#define lisspace(c)	(isspace(c))
#define lisprint(c)	(isprint(c))
#define lisxdigit(c)	(isxdigit(c))

#define ltolower(c)	(tolower(c))

#endif			/* } */

#endif

/*
** $Id: ldo.h $
** Stack and Call structure of Lua
** See Copyright Notice in lua.h
*/

#ifndef ldo_h
#define ldo_h


#include "llimits.h"
#include "lobject.h"
#include "lstate.h"
#include "lzio.h"


/*
** Macro to check stack size and grow stack if needed.  Parameters
** 'pre'/'pos' allow the macro to preserve a pointer into the
** stack across reallocations, doing the work only when needed.
** It also allows the running of one GC step when the stack is
** reallocated.
** 'condmovestack' is used in heavy tests to force a stack reallocation
** at every check.
*/

#if !defined(HARDSTACKTESTS)
#define condmovestack(L,pre,pos)	((void)0)
#else
/* realloc stack keeping its size */
#define condmovestack(L,pre,pos)  \
  { int sz_ = stacksize(L); pre; luaD_reallocstack((L), sz_, 0); pos; }
#endif

#define luaD_checkstackaux(L,n,pre,pos)  \
	if (l_unlikely(L->stack_last.p - L->top.p <= (n))) \
	  { pre; luaD_growstack(L, n, 1); pos; } \
	else { condmovestack(L,pre,pos); }

/* In general, 'pre'/'pos' are empty (nothing to save) */
#define luaD_checkstack(L,n)	luaD_checkstackaux(L,n,(void)0,(void)0)



#define savestack(L,pt)		(cast_charp(pt) - cast_charp(L->stack.p))
#define restorestack(L,n)	cast(StkId, cast_charp(L->stack.p) + (n))


/* macro to check stack size, preserving 'p' */
#define checkstackp(L,n,p)  \
  luaD_checkstackaux(L, n, \
    ptrdiff_t t__ = savestack(L, p),  /* save 'p' */ \
    p = restorestack(L, t__))  /* 'pos' part: restore 'p' */


/*
** Maximum depth for nested C calls, syntactical nested non-terminals,
** and other features implemented through recursion in C. (Value must
** fit in a 16-bit unsigned integer. It must also be compatible with
** the size of the C stack.)
*/
#if !defined(LUAI_MAXCCALLS)
#define LUAI_MAXCCALLS		200
#endif


/* type of protected functions, to be ran by 'runprotected' */
typedef void (*Pfunc) (lua_State *L, void *ud);

LUAI_FUNC l_noret luaD_errerr (lua_State *L);
LUAI_FUNC void luaD_seterrorobj (lua_State *L, TStatus errcode, StkId oldtop);
LUAI_FUNC TStatus luaD_protectedparser (lua_State *L, ZIO *z,
                                                  const char *name,

/*
** $Id: lgc.h $
** Garbage Collector
** See Copyright Notice in lua.h
*/

#ifndef lgc_h
#define lgc_h


#include <stddef.h>


#include "lobject.h"
#include "lstate.h"

/*
** Collectable objects may have one of three colors: white, which means
** the object is not marked; gray, which means the object is marked, but
** its references may be not marked; and black, which means that the
** object and all its references are marked.  The main invariant of the
** garbage collector, while marking objects, is that a black object can
** never point to a white one. Moreover, any gray object must be in a
** "gray list" (gray, grayagain, weak, allweak, ephemeron) so that it
** can be visited again before finishing the collection cycle. (Open
** upvalues are an exception to this rule, as they are attached to
** a corresponding thread.)  These lists have no meaning when the
** invariant is not being enforced (e.g., sweep phase).
*/


/*
** Possible states of the Garbage Collector
*/
#define GCSpropagate	0
#define GCSenteratomic	1
#define GCSatomic	2
#define GCSswpallgc	3
#define GCSswpfinobj	4
#define GCSswptobefnz	5
#define GCSswpend	6
#define GCScallfin	7
#define GCSpause	8


#define issweepphase(g)  \
	(GCSswpallgc <= (g)->gcstate && (g)->gcstate <= GCSswpend)


/*
** macro to tell when main invariant (white objects cannot point to black
** ones) must be kept. During a collection, the sweep phase may break
** the invariant, as objects turned white may point to still-black
** objects. The invariant is restored when sweep ends and all objects
** are white again.
*/

#define keepinvariant(g)	((g)->gcstate <= GCSatomic)


/*
** some useful bit tricks
*/
#define resetbits(x,m)		((x) &= cast_byte(~(m)))
#define setbits(x,m)		((x) |= (m))
#define testbits(x,m)		((x) & (m))
#define bitmask(b)		(1<<(b))
#define bit2mask(b1,b2)		(bitmask(b1) | bitmask(b2))
#define l_setbit(x,b)		setbits(x, bitmask(b))
#define resetbit(x,b)		resetbits(x, bitmask(b))
#define testbit(x,b)		testbits(x, bitmask(b))


/*
** Layout for bit use in 'marked' field. First three bits are
** used for object "age" in generational mode. Last bit is used
** by tests.
*/
#define WHITE0BIT	3  /* object is white (type 0) */
#define WHITE1BIT	4  /* object is white (type 1) */
#define BLACKBIT	5  /* object is black */
#define FINALIZEDBIT	6  /* object has been marked for finalization */

#define TESTBIT		7



#define WHITEBITS	bit2mask(WHITE0BIT, WHITE1BIT)


#define iswhite(x)      testbits((x)->marked, WHITEBITS)
#define isblack(x)      testbit((x)->marked, BLACKBIT)
#define isgray(x)  /* neither white nor black */  \
	(!testbits((x)->marked, WHITEBITS | bitmask(BLACKBIT)))

#define tofinalize(x)	testbit((x)->marked, FINALIZEDBIT)

#define otherwhite(g)	((g)->currentwhite ^ WHITEBITS)
#define isdeadm(ow,m)	((m) & (ow))
#define isdead(g,v)	isdeadm(otherwhite(g), (v)->marked)

#define changewhite(x)	((x)->marked ^= WHITEBITS)
#define nw2black(x)  \
	check_exp(!iswhite(x), l_setbit((x)->marked, BLACKBIT))

#define luaC_white(g)	cast_byte((g)->currentwhite & WHITEBITS)


/* object age in generational mode */
#define G_NEW		0	/* created in current cycle */
#define G_SURVIVAL	1	/* created in previous cycle */
#define G_OLD0		2	/* marked old by frw. barrier in this cycle */
#define G_OLD1		3	/* first full cycle as old */
#define G_OLD		4	/* really old object (not to be visited) */
#define G_TOUCHED1	5	/* old object touched this cycle */
#define G_TOUCHED2	6	/* old object touched in previous cycle */

#define AGEBITS		7  /* all age bits (111) */

#define getage(o)	((o)->marked & AGEBITS)
#define setage(o,a)  ((o)->marked = cast_byte(((o)->marked & (~AGEBITS)) | a))
#define isold(o)	(getage(o) > G_SURVIVAL)


/*
** In generational mode, objects are created 'new'. After surviving one
** cycle, they become 'survival'. Both 'new' and 'survival' can point
** to any other object, as they are traversed at the end of the cycle.
** We call them both 'young' objects.
** If a survival object survives another cycle, it becomes 'old1'.
** 'old1' objects can still point to survival objects (but not to
** new objects), so they still must be traversed. After another cycle
** (that, being old, 'old1' objects will "survive" no matter what)
** finally the 'old1' object becomes really 'old', and then they
** are no more traversed.
**
** To keep its invariants, the generational mode uses the same barriers
** also used by the incremental mode. If a young object is caught in a
** forward barrier, it cannot become old immediately, because it can
** still point to other young objects. Instead, it becomes 'old0',
** which in the next cycle becomes 'old1'. So, 'old0' objects is
** old but can point to new and survival objects; 'old1' is old
** but cannot point to new objects; and 'old' cannot point to any
** young object.
**
** If any old object ('old0', 'old1', 'old') is caught in a back
** barrier, it becomes 'touched1' and goes into a gray list, to be
** visited at the end of the cycle.  There it evolves to 'touched2',
** which can point to survivals but not to new objects. In yet another
** cycle then it becomes 'old' again.
**
** The generational mode must also control the colors of objects,
** because of the barriers.  While the mutator is running, young objects
** are kept white. 'old', 'old1', and 'touched2' objects are kept black,
** as they cannot point to new objects; exceptions are threads and open
** upvalues, which age to 'old1' and 'old' but are kept gray. 'old0'
** objects may be gray or black, as in the incremental mode. 'touched1'
** objects are kept gray, as they must be visited again at the end of
** the cycle.
*/


/*
** {======================================================
** Default Values for GC parameters
** =======================================================
*/

/*
** Minor collections will shift to major ones after LUAI_MINORMAJOR%
** bytes become old.
*/
#define LUAI_MINORMAJOR         70

/*
** Major collections will shift to minor ones after a collection
** collects at least LUAI_MAJORMINOR% of the new bytes.
*/
#define LUAI_MAJORMINOR         50

/*
** A young (minor) collection will run after creating LUAI_GENMINORMUL%
** new bytes.
*/
#define LUAI_GENMINORMUL         20


/* incremental */

/* Number of bytes must be LUAI_GCPAUSE% before starting new cycle */
#define LUAI_GCPAUSE    250

/*
** Step multiplier: The collector handles LUAI_GCMUL% work units for
** each new allocated word. (Each "work unit" corresponds roughly to
** sweeping one object or traversing one slot.)
*/
#define LUAI_GCMUL      200

/* How many bytes to allocate before next GC step */
#define LUAI_GCSTEPSIZE	(200 * sizeof(Table))


#define setgcparam(g,p,v)  (g->gcparams[LUA_GCP##p] = luaO_codeparam(v))
#define applygcparam(g,p,x)  luaO_applyparam(g->gcparams[LUA_GCP##p], x)

/* }====================================================== */


/*
** Control when GC is running:
*/
#define GCSTPUSR	1  /* bit true when GC stopped by user */
#define GCSTPGC		2  /* bit true when GC stopped by itself */
#define GCSTPCLS	4  /* bit true when closing Lua state */
#define gcrunning(g)	((g)->gcstp == 0)


/*
** Does one step of collection when debt becomes zero. 'pre'/'pos'
** allows some adjustments to be done only when needed. macro
** 'condchangemem' is used only for heavy tests (forcing a full
** GC cycle on every opportunity)
*/

#if !defined(HARDMEMTESTS)
#define condchangemem(L,pre,pos,emg)	((void)0)
#else
#define condchangemem(L,pre,pos,emg)  \
	{ if (gcrunning(G(L))) { pre; luaC_fullgc(L, emg); pos; } }
#endif

#define luaC_condGC(L,pre,pos) \
	{ if (G(L)->GCdebt <= 0) { pre; luaC_step(L); pos;}; \
	  condchangemem(L,pre,pos,0); }

/* more often than not, 'pre'/'pos' are empty */
#define luaC_checkGC(L)		luaC_condGC(L,(void)0,(void)0)


#define luaC_objbarrier(L,p,o) (  \
	(isblack(p) && iswhite(o)) ? \
	luaC_barrier_(L,obj2gco(p),obj2gco(o)) : cast_void(0))

#define luaC_barrier(L,p,v) (  \
	iscollectable(v) ? luaC_objbarrier(L,p,gcvalue(v)) : cast_void(0))

#define luaC_objbarrierback(L,p,o) (  \
	(isblack(p) && iswhite(o)) ? luaC_barrierback_(L,p) : cast_void(0))

#define luaC_barrierback(L,p,v) (  \
	iscollectable(v) ? luaC_objbarrierback(L, p, gcvalue(v)) : cast_void(0))

LUAI_FUNC void luaC_fix (lua_State *L, GCObject *o);
LUAI_FUNC void luaC_freeallobjects (lua_State *L);
LUAI_FUNC void luaC_step (lua_State *L);
LUAI_FUNC void luaC_runtilstate (lua_State *L, int state, int fast);
LUAI_FUNC void luaC_fullgc (lua_State *L, int isemergency);
LUAI_FUNC GCObject *luaC_newobj (lua_State *L, lu_byte tt, size_t sz);
LUAI_FUNC GCObject *luaC_newobjdt (lua_State *L, lu_byte tt, size_t sz,
                                                 size_t offset);
LUAI_FUNC void luaC_barrier_ (lua_State *L, GCObject *o, GCObject *v);
LUAI_FUNC void luaC_barrierback_ (lua_State *L, GCObject *o);
LUAI_FUNC void luaC_checkfinalizer (lua_State *L, GCObject *o, Table *mt);
LUAI_FUNC void luaC_changemode (lua_State *L, int newmode);


#endif
